Payroll History Form in Employee Portal

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202411/Payroll_History_Form.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202411/Payroll_History_Form.htm

Payroll History Form in Employee Portal

Managers can now use the Payroll History form to view and download reports on completed payrolls in Employee Portal. To access this form, select Payroll History from the menu while in Manager mode.

[Image: screenshot]

The Payroll History form displays a list of payrolls by year. To filter the results, select a Year and a Payroll Type in the selection fields. Managers can review summary information for payrolls on this form. Select a pay date to display additional details for the payroll from that date.

On the Payroll Summary form accessed by selecting a pay date, managers can review an overview of the payroll, details for specific employees on the payroll, and a list of associated reports and files.

[Image: screenshot]

The Overview tab displays a chart of how pay was allocated for this payroll and a details breakdown of the payroll statistics. Select options in the View By field to view the pay distribution by different variables, including departments, pay codes, and positions. This information can be downloaded by selecting the Download button.

[Image: screenshot]

The Payroll Details tab displays information for each employee on the payroll. Managers can review specific information about the hours worked, gross pay, taxes, deductions, and other information. This information can be downloaded by selecting the Download button.

[Image: screenshot]

The Reports & Files tab displays reports or files associated with the payroll, including the title, classification, file type, and status. Finalized files can be viewed or downloaded by selecting the corresponding buttons in the Action column.

Note: Note: Managers must have full access to the Payroll History Process ID in Prism to access the Payroll History form in Employee Portal. Managers must have full access to Payroll Summary in Prism to access the Payroll Summary tab and access to Payroll Reports to access the Reports & Files tab.

JIRA # ADMP-629

Retirement Summary Form

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202411/Retirement_Summary_Form.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202411/Retirement_Summary_Form.htm

Retirement Summary Form

Employees can now view and update their retirement contributions using the new Retirement Summary form in Employee Portal. Using this form, employees can see their retirement contributions per year, view the contribution rate, and change their contribution rates.

To access this form, select Benefit > Retirement Summary. The Retirement form displays.

[Image: screenshot]

The contribution rate displays for both pre-tax and Roth retirement accounts. In addition, the Retirement Summary section displays statistics for their yearly contribution. Select the Year field to view previous years.

Employees can select the Update Rates button to display the Update Contributions form. On this form, employees can change their contribution rates to Pre-Tax and Roth retirement accounts.

[Image: screenshot]

To make a change, select Amount for a flat amount or Percentage for a percentage of the paycheck. In the Amount field, enter the flat contribution or percentage to be contributed to retirement.

Note: Note: This value is contributed per pay period. Employees contributing a flat amount should calculate the amount of each paycheck to contribute accordingly.

Important: Clients can enable this feature for specific clients using the Configuration Template or the Client Override. Deselect the Retirement Contributions Read Only toggle on the Configuration Template form to allow employees from updating their retirement contribution rates from this form.

Once the change is complete, click Review. An acknowledgment displays, where the employee can add a digital signature indicating that they intend to make this change. Check the box and select Submit to submit the change for processing to make the change on the next payroll.

JIRA # EP-7960

Download and Print Total Compensation Statements

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/QR2025_03/Download_Total_Comp_Statement.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/QR2025_03/Download_Total_Comp_Statement.htm

Download and Print Total Compensation Statements

Employees can now download and print their compensation information as a report from the Total Compensation Statement form in Employee Portal. Reports can be downloaded as both PDF and CSV files.

The PDF version of the report includes the company, employee name, year, and quarter, as well as the total compensation package, including pay, benefits, and taxes. The report also includes a graph of this information, and tables containing total values for each attribute.

The CSV version of the report includes categories for pay, benefits, and taxes, amounts, employee contributions, employer contributions, and descriptions.

This feature is available on both desktop and mobile devices.

Job Candidates in Employee Portal New Hire

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/QR2025_03/Job_Candidates_In_EP.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/QR2025_03/Job_Candidates_In_EP.htm

Job Candidates in Employee Portal New Hire

Managers can now view and select job candidates from the PrismHR system on the New Hire form in Employee Portal. By selecting a job candidate, the manager no longer needs to re-enter the candidate’s information during the new hire process.

The Candidates tab on the New Hire Dashboard now displays the name, candidate number, application date, and location of job candidates in the system. Managers can select candidates to hire directly from this tab. In addition, managers can search for candidates by name using the Search field.

To hire a candidate:

  1. Select New Hire Dashboard.

  2. Select the Candidates tab.

  3. Select the candidate to hire, or search for the client by name using the Search field.

  4. Click Hire Candidate. The New Hire Form displays, with the candidate’s information prepopulated in the appropriate fields.

  5. Continue the New Hire process with the candidate’s information to initiate the hiring process.

Using this new tab, managers can review candidates in Employee Portal and transfer their information directly to the New Hire process when they select a candidate.

Payroll Vouchers in Employee Portal

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/QR2025_03/Payroll_Vouchers_In_EP.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/QR2025_03/Payroll_Vouchers_In_EP.htm

Payroll Vouchers in Employee Portal

Managers can now view Employee Payroll Vouchers from posted payrolls in Employee Portal. Using this new form, managers can review extensive information about payroll vouchers for individual employees to verify the payroll.

To access a Payroll Voucher:

  1. Select Payroll History.

  2. Select the Pay Date for the voucher. The Payroll form displays.

  3. Select the Payroll Details form to view the individual employees on the payroll.

  4. Select the Voucher number for the employee to review. The Payroll Voucher form displays.

[Image: screenshot]

This form displays the following information:

  • The Overview tab displays broad information about the payment, taxes, deductions, and dates.
  • The Pay tab displays a detailed breakdown of the hours paid, rates, and codes for each day.
  • The Deductions tab contains a breakdown of all deductions applied to the payroll voucher, such as medical, dental, and 401k contributions.
  • The Benefits tab displays information about the benefits contributions applied to the payroll voucher, as well as matching applied by the company.
  • The Tax tab displays taxes applied to the payroll, including federal and local taxes.
  • The Time Off tab displays any PTO hours included in the payroll voucher.
  • The Banking tab displays transit and account numbers for payments made as part of the payroll voucher.

Using this new form, managers can verify payroll vouchers directly from Employee Portal, while retaining the same functionality and security from core Prism.

Legacy Configuration Template Sunsetting

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_06/Legacy_Configuration_Sunset.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_06/Legacy_Configuration_Sunset.htm

Legacy Configuration Template Sunsetting

The June release marks the final step of transition from legacy configuration templates. As part of this process, several changes will occur:

  • With this release, all references to legacy templates will be removed from the system. Legacy templates will no longer be listed on the Configuration Templates form.
  • Clients assigned to legacy templates have already been operating under the functionality for the New UEX’s Default UEX template. These clients will be formally assigned to the Default UEX template.
  • The end-user experience will not change. Since the clients formally assigned to the Default UEX have been running with that functionality in practice, the user experience remains the same during this transition.

Note: Note: Formally assigning these clients to the Default UEX template will cause an increased client count for that template. This is expected behavior, and does not indicate any changes in the end-user experience.

JIRA # EP-8385, EP-8388

Direct Deposit on My Approvals

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_07/Direct_Deposit_My_Approvals.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_07/Direct_Deposit_My_Approvals.htm

Direct Deposit on My Approvals

In response to rising incidents of fraud involving unauthorized changes to employee banking details, an additional layer of security is now available for direct deposit accounts being added or removed from an Employee record.

[Image: screenshot]

Service providers can add a Direct Deposit Approval policy on the Approval Policies form in Prism. When this policy is enabled and an employee adds or removes a direct deposit account, an approval process triggers. This new process mirrors existing HR approval workflows and offers flexibility in routing: approvals can be directed to an employee’s manager, service provider, or another designated approver based on organizational preferences.

Managers can now view Direct Deposit approval requests on the My Approvals form or the My Approvals widget in Employee Portal, review the employee’s information, and approve or deny the change.

Note: Note: Bank account numbers are masked by default on this form to protect user security.

Employees can view their pending direct deposit approval requests on the Direct Deposits form in Employee portal. A message displays on the direct deposit, indicating that the change is still awaiting manager approval. Employees can make changes on this form, which will overwrite the current approval request.

[Image: screenshot]

This enhancement helps ensure that any changes to sensitive financial data are reviewed and verified to protect the security of employees.

Subscribe to PTO Calendar Option

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_07/Subscribe_To_Calendar.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_07/Subscribe_To_Calendar.htm

Subscribe to PTO Calendar Option

The PTO Calendar in Employee Portal now features a Subscribe to Team Calendar option, which can be used to generate a subscription link to the calendar. After copying the link, users can add the link into calendars such as Google or Outlook to monitor the PTO Calendar from those applications.

Note: Note: This feature must be enabled by Service Providers for Configuration Templates or Client Overrides.

Note: Note: The Subscribe to PTO Calendar feature is not currently available to On-Prem Clients.

To enable the Subscribe to Team Calendar feature:

  1. In PrismHR, navigate to Employee Experience Configuration > Employee Portal > Configuration Templates or Employee Experience Configuration > Employee Portal > Client Overrides.

  2. Click Edit.

  3. Select the Enable PTO Calendar Sharing option.

  4. Click Save.

To obtain the PTO Calendar link:

  1. In Employee Portal, select the PTO Team Calendar.

  2. Click Subscribe to Calendar. The Subscribe to Team Calendar window displays.

  3. Copy the link provided.

  4. Use the provided link in your calendar application of choice.

For more information about using this feature with different calendar options, refer to the Subscribing to the PTO Calendar article on the CRC.

JIRA # EP-8497

Clock Number Field on Employee Details

Clock Number Field on Employee Details

Worksite managers can now enter an employee’s clock number on the Employee Details section of the New Hire form. The Clock Number field is synchronized with the field of the same name in core Prism.

Additional Gender Options for Dependents

Additional Gender Options for Dependents

Employees can now select additional gender options for the personal details of their listed dependents. Employees can now select Non-Binary or Decline To State as options for the Gender field.

Note: Note: These options must be enabled by a Service Provider on the System Parameters form.

JIRA # EP-9402

[Image: screenshot]

(Global Classic Light) icon for Menu items in Employee Portal on Configuration Templates.

Salary Hour Reduction Calculation on Timesheet

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_08/Salary_Hour_Reduction.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_08/Salary_Hour_Reduction.htm

Salary Hour Reduction Calculation on Timesheet

When a salaried employee has default hours for a pay code, and a manager then adds hours on another pay code, a message now displays indicating these hours will affect the salary amount.

The message reads “These hours will affect the salary amount. Should the standard hours in column X be reduced by Y hours?” If the manager selects Yes, the hours in the previous pay code are automatically reduced so that the total hours matches the employee’s default amount.

JIRA # EP-9271

========================================================================

Configuration Template Option for Managers to Enter New Hire SSN/DoB

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_08/SSN%20DOB%20Toggle.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_08/SSN DOB Toggle.htm

Configuration Template Option for Managers to Enter New Hire SSN/DoB

Clients can now allow managers to proceed through the New Hire process more swiftly using a new option on the Configuration Template and Client Override forms. When the Manager SSN/DoB Entry on New Hire option is selected on these forms, managers can type in the new employee’s social security number and date of birth on the New Hire form in Employee Portal.

When the manager adds the SSN and DoB directly on the New Hire form, the new employee does not need to log in to Employee Portal and add in that information themselves. Instead, the employee Prehire record and Employee ID Number are generated immediately in the system, and the employee can proceed immediately with the Onboarding Workflow.

Once a manager enters the new hire’s SSN and DoB, both of these fields are set to read-only, and the SSN field is masked for security purposes. If these fields need to be changed, the New Hire record should be deleted and remade. In addition, this option does not impact existing records. If a new hire record was added without an SSN or DoB, the record should be deleted and recreated to access this feature.

In addition, when this option is selected, the Employee ID now displays on the New Hire Dashboard, and the Kiosk Code and Invite Link columns no longer display.

Note: Note: This option should only be selected when trusted managers have access to the new employee’s SSN and DoB.

JIRA # EP-9440, EP-9442, EP-9443, EP-9450, EP-9454, WSP-2378

========================================================================

Additional Gender Options for Dependents

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_09/Gender_Options_Dependents.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_09/Gender_Options_Dependents.htm

Additional Gender Options for Dependents

Employees can now select a Gender Designation for their dependents, just as they can for themselves. This update enhances personalization and supports inclusive data representation across the platform.

Note: Note: This feature is configurable. Service Providers can enable or disable it using the Hide Gender Designation setting in the Configuration Template.

JIRA # EP-9403

========================================================================

Additional Pronoun Options for Dependents

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_09/Pronoun_Options_Dependents.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_09/Pronoun_Options_Dependents.htm

Additional Pronoun Options for Dependents

Employees can now specify Preferred Pronouns for their dependents, just as they can for themselves. This enhancement supports more inclusive and personalized experiences across the employee experience.

Note: Note: This feature is configurable. Service Providers can enable or disable it using the Hide Pronoun setting within the Configuration Template.

JIRA # EP-9404

========================================================================

Display Report Center in Employee Portal

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_09/Report_Center_In_EP.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_09/Report_Center_In_EP.htm

Display Report Center in Employee Portal

Service Providers can now embed reports and dashboards from Report Center into Employee Portal as menu items. The new Report Center (Embed) option now displays as a Menu Component option on the Configuration Templates form and the Client Override form. Select this option to display the Embed Code field and enter a URL to link a report from Report Center.

Using this option, Service Providers can embed a workbook or dashboard from the Next Gen Report Center directly into Employee Portal for managers. Managers can click the menu option to view the report. Managers can access the full range of Report Center’s features for selecting Views and utilizing Explore mode in the workbook if they have the appropriate permissions.

Using this feature, Service Providers can select specific workbooks and dashboards to grant to managers directly through Employee Portal, customize the available workbooks and dashboards for specific clients, and leverage the functionality of Report Center while controlling how much data is available to their customers.

JIRA # EP-9468, EP-9469, EP-9466, EP-9467, RC-6682, RC-6683, RC-6659

========================================================================

Employee Photo on My Employees Widget

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/My_Employees_Photo.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/My_Employees_Photo.htm

Employee Photo on My Employees Widget

Managers can now see employee photos next to their names on the My Employees widget. This enhancement mirrors the appearance of the My Approvals widget and the Birthday & Anniversary widget.

JIRA # EP-9495

========================================================================

Bulk Delete for New Hire Dashboard

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/New_Hire_Bulk_Delete.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/New_Hire_Bulk_Delete.htm

Bulk Delete for New Hire Dashboard

Managers can now delete records in bulk using the New Hire Dashboard. Checkboxes now display next to each new hire entry on the dashboard, and managers can click the Delete New Hires button with multiple entries selected to delete up to 10 entries at once. In addition, the Select All checkbox allows managers to select all entries currently displayed. With this enhancement, managers can clean out unnecessary new hire entries more swiftly.

JIRA # EP-8978

========================================================================

Editing Employee Record During Onboarding Disabled

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/New_Hire_Disable.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/New_Hire_Disable.htm

Editing Employee Record During Onboarding Disabled

When a new employee’s Onboarding Prehire record is created in the system, the fields on the Employee New Hire Form are now locked for the duration of the onboarding process. A banner now displays above the New Hire Dashboard entry for an employee indicating that the employee is undergoing the onboarding process. This change prevents conflicting edits to the employee record during the onboarding process.

JIRA # EP-9093

========================================================================

Enhancements to New Hire Form

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/New_Hire_Enhancements.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/New_Hire_Enhancements.htm

Enhancements to New Hire Form

The New Hire Dashboard in Employee Portal has been enhanced to ensure that fields and requirements on the form match the New Hire form in Prism.

The New Hire form in Employee Portal has been updated with a new layout. Fields are now grouped into four categories, which includes Employee Personal Info, Employment Details, Benefit Details, and Employee Pay Details. Fields have been repositioned as a result of this change, but no fields have been removed, and the page retains all existing functionality.

The Employee Type field has been renamed Employment Type, and the Pay Rate Basis field has been renamed Pay Rate Basis/Period. In addition, the SSN/DOB selector has been updated to use a button format.

JIRA # EP-9609

========================================================================

Enhancement to Direct Deposits Form

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/Payroll_Deduction_Improvement.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/Payroll_Deduction_Improvement.htm

Enhancement to Direct Deposits Form

The Direct Deposits form in Employee Portal now allows an employee to view and update their Checking and Savings accounts when other account types (such as Deductions) have been applied by a Service Provider. When the employee accesses the Direct Deposits form, account types other than checking and savings are hidden for security purposes.

Note: Note: This update covers direct deposit types other than Checking and Savings. The information for these deposit types are covered on the employee record on the Deposit tab of the Employee Details form in Prism Core.

JIRA # EP-4474

========================================================================

Payroll Approval Reports in Employee Portal

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/Payroll_Reports_Files.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/Payroll_Reports_Files.htm

Payroll Approval Reports in Employee Portal

Managers can now view certain reports on processed payrolls directly from Employee Portal. Select a payroll on the Payroll Approvals form and select the Reports & Files to display a list of the reports available to view or download.

The Payroll reports added to this form include the following:

  • Gross to Net Report
  • Check Journal Report
  • Deduction Register Report
  • Payroll Register Report
  • Deduction Code Summary Report
  • Client Allocation Report
  • Payroll Allocation Report

These forms use the default parameters as established in the core Prism application. Select View to display the report in a new tab, or select Download to download the report.

JIRA # EP-9324

========================================================================

Customize Push Notifications

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/Push_Notifications.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/Push_Notifications.htm

Customize Push Notifications

Employees can now customize their push notification preferences for the PrismONE Mobile App. The new App Settings form includes the Notifications setting, which allows employees to opt in or out of specific types of notifications, including messages, time sheet notices, and PTO notices.

Note: Note: Push notifications are enabled by default, and employees are instructed on how they can opt in or out of notifications on their first login.

JIRA # APP-45, APP-128

========================================================================

PrismONE ID support for PrismONE Mobile App

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/Redirect_After_Logout.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/Redirect_After_Logout.htm

PrismONE ID support for PrismONE Mobile App

This release includes login support for employees with existing PrismONE ID accounts. The new login process includes full multi-factor authentication support for both authenticator apps and SMS/Text messages.

With PrismONE ID, employees no longer need to log in to Employee Portal or scan a QR code. Once authenticated, users can quickly and easily log in using a PIN or biometric data, and their credentials are retained until the standard expiration date.

In addition, employees who work for multiple companies can now easily switch between accounts during login or within the app using the new “Sign In to Another Account” option.

With these enhancements, employees can access Employee Portal more quickly and securely using the PrismONE Mobile App.

JIRA # APP-93

========================================================================

Present Resident and Worksite Location Tax Form Options

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/Tax_Form_Options.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2025/R2025_10/Tax_Form_Options.htm

Present Resident and Worksite Location Tax Form Options

Employees who live in one state and work in another can now select state tax forms for both states to comply with payroll regulations. When the employee goes to update their tax forms in Employee Portal, the option available now include both their home address and their worksite location.

JIRA # EP-9243

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/EP_Fixes_MR_202401.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/EP_Fixes_MR_202401.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-1960 When a manager viewed an employee’s I9 form for approval, the employee hire date displayed as “NaN/NaN/Nan”. This is fixed.
EERT-2119 Attempting to email a Benefits Confirmation Statement to an employee from the Employee Confirmation Statements form or the Other tab of the Employee Details form caused an error message to display. This is fixed.
EERT-2230 When an employee completed the Benefit Summary form during Benefits Enrollment, the form was not properly marked as completed, and the EP Benefit Enrollment Widget would continue to show that there were incomplete forms. This is fixed.
EERT-2232 When a user attempts to use special characters that are now permitted on the I9 Section 2 form, an error message displays to indicate this. However, the error message would overlap existing text on the screen, rendering both illegible. This is fixed.
EERT-2236 During the onboarding process, when a user enters a telephone number that begins with a 1 before the area code, the system interpreted the 1 as part of the area code and truncated the phone number, resulting in incorrect information. This is fixed. The system now accepts both 9-digit and 10-digit numbers. If the user types in more digits, an error displays so that they can fix the issue, rather than truncating the number.
EERT-2246 When a user selected to receive electronic W-2 forms during onboarding and accessed the W-2 form in Employee Portal, a message would display incorrectly informing the user that they had not enrolled in electronic W-2 forms. The employee was prompted to enroll in electronic W-2 forms, despite already being enrolled. This is fixed. Employee Portal now displays the employee’s electronic form enrollment status properly.
EERT-2249 When a user signed up for Voluntary Life or AD&D plans during Benefits Enrollment, the employee could enter 0 in the amount field and allocate zero dollars a month to a plan. This is fixed.
EERT-2277 When a user received an MFA code that started with 0 and entered the code to log in to Employee Portal, an error message displayed indicating an invalid code. The user could request a new code and still log in successfully. This is fixed. MFA codes beginning with 0 are now properly accepted.
EERT-2305 When a user attempted to save a change to an alert in Employee Portal, errors could occur which caused the system to stall or prevented the change from being saved. This is fixed.
EP-6530 When a user viewed the Messages form in the new UEX and only a single page of information displayed, the text displayed “Viewing 1 of NaN”. This is fixed. The text now properly displays “1 of 1” for a single page of Messages.
EP-6713 When an employee clicked the checkbox for Select All on the Messages form, messages would not be selected. However, clicking the text for Select All did select all messages. This is fixed. The checkbox now properly selects all messages, and the text no longer functions as a button.
EP-6807 When a worksite manager attempted to assign themselves as the PTO Approver for a New Hire employee on their team, they were unable to do so if any security restrictions were set. The manager could assign themselves as the PTO Approver if no security restrictions were set. This is fixed. Worksite managers can now assign themselves as PTO Approvers for their own teams.
EP-7059 When a user attempted to load the EP dashboard after login, when the Contact Us widget was enabled and the Photo option was not selected in the Display field, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EP-7279 When a user makes changes to a client override on the Client Overrides form, the changes were not immediately applied. Users needed to clear their caches before the changes displayed. This is fixed.
EP-7315 When a company using the new UEX set up a redirect on the login, and an employee logged in using the Legacy UEX, the redirect did not function properly, and the employee would be sent to the Employee Portal dashboard. This is fixed.

========================================================================

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/EP_Fixes_MR_202402.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/EP_Fixes_MR_202402.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2309 The Employee Portal PTO Estimator did not properly account for Semi-Monthly pay schedule payrolls, causing the estimate to be incorrect. This is fixed.
EERT-2316 When a client with no rehire approval policy created a rehire approval in Employee Portal, the approval record would sometimes be left in the “P” (Pending) status, and the approval was not automatically cleared from the system. This is fixed.
EERT-2332 When an employee submits a PTO request and there were multiple pay groups in a payroll batch, an error message displayed, but the message did not include the proper text message. In addition, if there were multiple pay groups in a payroll batch with different pay period start dates, employees could incorrectly submit a PTO request for a date after the first pay period start date. This is fixed. Employees are now informed that the payroll period date requested has been closed. In addition, employees can no longer submit a PTO request for a date after the first pay period start date.
EERT-2339 When a user attempted to upload a document to or delete a document from the legacy version of the Document Repository, an error occurred, and the action could not be completed. This is fixed.

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/EP_Fixes_QR_202406.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/EP_Fixes_QR_202406.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2417 When a newly terminated employee unaware of the termination accessed Employee Portal to update their work email address, a message displayed indicating that work emails cannot be set for a terminated employee. This is fixed. Terminated employees are now informed that they cannot update their email at this time and instructed to contact their HR manager.
EERT-2424 When a user displayed taxes on the Tax Withholding form in Employee Portal, and Block Withholding is selected as an Override type on the Tax tab on the Client Details form, some states did not properly display the Exempt From State Withholding? Field. This is fixed.
EERT-2429 When an employee viewed a life event on the Life Events widget that was initiated by a service provider or manager, the event would incorrectly display as being initiated by the employee. In addition, the Completed By field displayed incorrect information when benefit rules were used to determine the completion date. This is fixed.
EERT-2445 When a manager attempted to edit an employee record using the New Hire Dashboard, and the manager security settings only included Full Access for a single entity, an error occurred. If the manager had Full Access to at least two entities in their security settings, they could edit employee records normally. This is fixed.
EERT-2454 When an employee attempted to cancel a leave request on the Paid Time Off form that had already been approved then clicked No on the confirmation message, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EERT-2459 When an employee navigated to the Tax Withholding form in Employee Portal, an error message displayed for certain employees. This is fixed.
EERT-2464 When an employee attempted to log in to Employee Portal in the new UEX using an iPhone and the employee’s browser version was from before 2022, an error message displayed. However, the error message did not provide sufficient information. The error message now specifies that the employee needs to update their browser to access Employee Portal.
EERT-2465 When a manager added an employee through the New Hire Dashboard and the employee began working through Onboarding, the Hire Status field did not properly update and continued showing the employee in Not Started status. This is fixed.
EP-7650 On the Benefits tab on the Total Compensation dashboard, the Description column did not properly display. This is fixed.
EP-7654 On the Taxes Breakdown tab on the Total Compensation form in Employee Portal, the company contributions to taxes were erroneously labeled “-employee”. This is fixed.
EP-7947 When a worksite manager attempted to review pending leave requests in Employee Portal, the Leave Date field did not properly display on the requests. This is fixed.

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/EP_Fixes_QR_202409.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/EP_Fixes_QR_202409.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
ADMP-429 When a rehired employee went through the new hire process in Employee Portal, the new hire questions did not display in the proper format. This is fixed.
ADMP-545 When a manager applied a leave request for an employee in Employee Portal and a second leave request for that employee was approved, the Updated Hours field on the Leave Details form displayed incorrect information. This was only a display issue, and the information was applied correctly on the time sheet. This is fixed.
ADMP-556 When a user set the language in Employee Portal, the Leave Request Summary Table status column was not resized to accommodate the translated text. This is fixed.
ADMP-565 When a time sheet containing only a single employee was set to Ready for Time Entry status, and a user finalized the time sheet, the Payroll Status field incorrectly displayed as blank. Closing the form and returning to page caused the field to correctly display as Time Sheet Entry in Progress. This is fixed.
EERT-2554 When a PTO plan had a Usage Waiting period selected on the PTO Benefit Plan form, the waiting period was not applied properly to leave requests, and employees could request time off during the waiting period. This is fixed.
EERT-2559 When a new employee was hired through the New Hire Dashboard in Employee Portal, a prehire record was not created, and the employee could not begin the Onboarding process. This is fixed.
EERT-2596 For certain clients, employees were unable to update their residential address in Employee Portal, and the Verify Address button remained greyed out even when changes were applied to the Address form. This is fixed.
EP-8011 When an employee attempted to view their annual salary on the Employment Summary form in Employee Portal, the salary did not display if the employee did not have an assigned manager. This is fixed.
EP-8183 When a terminated employee logged in to Employee Portal to view exiting documents, the user could view documents as though they were still an active employee. This is fixed.
EP-8202 When a user attempted to preview a document included on an alert on the Alerts form, an error occurred. This is fixed.

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/EP_Fixes_QR_202411.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/EP_Fixes_QR_202411.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
ADMP-662 When a Pay Code was set in Prism to allow description overrides, several forms in Employee Portal did not properly display the override description, including the Time Sheet Summary form, Detail Time Sheet Entry form, and Time Sheet Review form. This is fixed.
ADMP-693 When a Service Provider imported a new hire record from Employee Portal into Prism, the Hired By field on the employee record in Employee Portal displayed as blank. This is fixed.
ADMP-694 When a Service Provider imported a new hire record from Employee Portal into Prism, and the PTO approver was a Worksite Trusted Advisor, the Welcome email sent to the new hire did not display the HR Supervisor’s name. This is fixed.
ADMP-713 When a Worksite Manager attempted to rehire an employee using the Rehire HR Action in Employee Portal, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EERT-2641 When an employee was enrolled in a benefit plan and calculated accrual amounts in Employee Portal on the Paid Time Off form, the Estimate PTO feature did not properly account for Seniority Level when calculating future PTO accrual amounts. This is fixed.
EERT-2655 When calculating accrual amounts in Employee Portal, the Estimate PTO feature on the Paid Time Off form did not properly account for the Benefit Start Date on the Employee PTO Registers form in PrismHR, resulting in incorrect calculations. This is fixed.
EERT-2681 When an employee in a PTO plan with a seniority tier greater than 82 months attempted to use the PTO Estimator feature to determine their PTO, the estimator did not calculate hours correctly. This is fixed.
EP-7754 When a user edited a menu for a template on the Configuration Templates form in the New UEX, the clock icon from the legacy UEX was not available as a menu icon. This is fixed.
EP-8326 When an employee was within the usage wait period for PTO and attempted to view their accrued PTO, no hours displayed. This is fixed. Employees can now view their accrued PTO while they are within the usage wait period.
EP-8467 When a Trusted Advisor selected SMS/Text as their MFA option and attempted to log in to Employee Portal, only the option to send an email for MFA displayed. This is fixed.

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_MR_202501.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_MR_202501.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2625 When a user hired an employee via the New Hire Dashboard in Employee Portal, the Benefit Group field on the New Hire Form did not exclude retirement-only benefit groups. This is fixed. Users will no longer see retirement-only benefit groups in this field.
EERT-2635 When a worksite manager who works for two companies attempted to create a segment on the Segments form, the company name on the segment could switch or disappear, and an error message could display that prevented creating the segment. This is fixed.
EERT-2643 When an user searched for employees using the Add Employees form on the Segments form, the search results did not display a complete list of matching employees if the user searched by last name. This is fixed.
EERT-2645 When a Worksite Manager attempted to terminate an employee who never completed registration for Employee Portal, the termination failed. This is fixed. The employee is now terminated even if they have not completed their registration.
EERT-2653 When a manager approved a PTO request using Employee Portal, the manager’s name did not display as the PTO Approver on the record. This is fixed.
EERT-2671 When an employee had accrued the maximum amount of PTO allowed for their plan, the PTO estimator continued to display future accruals that exceeded the maximum. This is fixed.
EERT-2676 When an employee’s preferred language was set to English, text in the footer of an Alert displayed the Spanish version. This is fixed. When an employee’s preferred language is set to English, all sections of the Alert now display in English.
EERT-2698 When a manager attempted to send a password reset link to an employee using Employee Portal, an error message displayed. This occurred for both email and SMS reset links. This is fixed.
EERT-2732 When a manager changed employee summary information using Employee Portal, the employee’s last hire, original hire, and last review dates would increase by one day. This is fixed.
EERT-2757 When a user viewed upcoming paychecks in the Pay Widget in Employee Portal, the widget should only display the date of the next regularly scheduled payroll. However, if a manual payroll was processed, that date would display instead. This is fixed.
EP-5424 When a user attempted to sort the Activity tab on the Employee Portal Alert form, only the Company Name column sorted properly. This is fixed.
EP-7574 When a user attempted to switch their preferred language to Spanish, an error occurred if the Enable Additional Languages option was not enabled on the Global Configuration form, even though Employee Portal does not use this configuration option. This is fixed. Employee Portal now properly disregards the Enable Additional Languages option on the Global Configuration form.
EP-8478 When a user attempted to duplicate a segment on the Segments form, an error occurred for certain segments. This is fixed.
EP-8576 When a Worksite Trusted Advisor made changes to the Employment Summary form in Employee Portal and attempted to save the changes, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EP-8732 When a worksite manager who has access to a client but is not an employee of that client attempted to log in to Employee Portal via SSO, an error occurred. This is fixed.

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_MR_202502.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_MR_202502.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2605 When a Worksite Manager initiated a leave request in Employee Portal on behalf of an employee, and the leave request was approved, the approval confirmation email was sent to the Worksite Manager instead of the employee. This is fixed.
EERT-2637 When new hire questions were marked as mandatory on the New Hire Questions form, this requirement was not properly enforced, and new hires could navigate through the process while leaving the questions blank. This is fixed.
EERT-2691 When records on the New Hire Entry form in Employee Portal contained fields with too many characters, the fields displayed incorrectly for certain screen settings. This is fixed.
EERT-2768 When a user views upcoming paychecks in the Pay Widget in Employee Portal, the widget should only display the date of the next regularly scheduled payroll. However, when a Manual or Special payroll batch was processed for an employee, that date displayed instead. This is fixed.
EERT-2777 When a manager edited the Last Hire Date, Last Review Date, or Next Review Date on the Employment Summary or Personal Info form in Employee Portal, the date saved as the day before what was entered. This is fixed.

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_QR_202503.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_QR_202503.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2706 When a user selected Appy to Clients on the Configuration Template form, performed a search, then cleared the search, previous selections from the Apply to Clients feature were deselected. This is fixed.
EERT-2726 When the early W-2 election configuration was not set up on the W-2 Election Text form, the early W-2 election sections still displayed on the W-2 form in Employee Portal. This is fixed.
EERT-2776 When a manager made a change to the Employment Summary form in Employee Portal, the employee’s email address was deleted. In addition, accidental deletions prior to 2025 displayed the email address as being deleted by an unknown user. This is fixed.
EP-8810 When an employee displayed the Retirement Summary form in Employee Portal, the Contribution Rates fields displayed future-dated effective rates instead of the current effective rates. This is fixed. When future-dated rates are entered in the system, they do not display in Employee Portal until the date they are supposed to come into effect.

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R202505.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R202505.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2667 When a client with a single Employer ID attempted to enter a new hire using the New Hire Dashboard in Employee Portal, an error message occurred indicating that the Employer ID was required, even though that field was automatically populated. This is fixed.
EERT-2742 When an employee had a direct deposit account using the Percentage method and switched to the Fixed method, the employee could still enter a Maximum amount and save the record. This is fixed. The Maximum field is now disabled when the employee switches to the Fixed method.
EERT-2766 In the Pay widget in Employee Portal, if the latest pay date displayed on the last day of the year, the pay date displayed as the following year. For example, 12/31/2024 would display as 12/31/2025. This is fixed.
EERT-2829 When a user created a segment on the Segments form and clicked Add Employees on the form, the search results displayed the list of employees correctly. However, clicking Add Employees again caused the search results to display incorrectly. This is fixed.
EERT-2853 When the system parameters were set on the Termination Parameters form to allow termination dates to be more than a set number of days in the future if the user confirms a message, when the user selected Yes on the termination message, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EERT-2861 When a Worksite Location had the Remote Location option enabled in Prism, tax forms in Employee Portal still used the worksite location geocode instead of the employee’s resident geocode for tax calculations. This is fixed.
EERT-2864 When an employee’s User Role was set to hide the Employee Portal username on the Employee Details form, the name did not display on the form in PrismHR, but worksite managers could see the name on the Employee Details form in Employee Portal. This is fixed.
EERT-2866 For some clients, documents displayed using the pre-UEX Default template instead of the Default UEX template, even if the company was assigned to use the Default UEX template. This is fixed.
EERT-2870 When an employee submitted a PTO request that was not a whole number the PTO Calendar list view in Employee Portal displayed the request as only a whole number with .00 in the decimal place. For example, a request of 1.5 hours displayed as 1.00 hours. This is fixed.
EERT-2882 When the Email Address, Mobile Phone, and Employee Number fields were marked as required fields on the New Hire and Dependent Field Overrides form in Prism, the New Hire Dashboard did not properly make these fields required. This is fixed.
EP-8493 When a user searched the Client Override form by Client Number, the Status filter did not properly filter results. This is fixed.
EP-8828 If a segment had more than 334 employees included, Service Providers were unable to open the segment on the Segments form and received an error message indicating that they did not have access to all clients on the segment. This is fixed.
EP-8966 When a manager attempted to navigate the My Employees form using the keyboard, the employee was unable to select employees from the list or view additional pages of employees. This is fixed.
EP-9072 When a client enabled the Redirect After Logout feature on a Configuration Template for Employee Portal to implement a Vanity URL, the system did not redirect users to the specified URL correctly. This is fixed.
EP-9177 When a Worksite Manager attempted to save a Segment that has the same name as another Segment in Employee Portal, an error occurred. This is fixed. The Worksite Manager now receives a message indicating that the segment name already exists.

========================================================================

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R202506.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R202506.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2773 If a cross hire employee record existed on multiple clients, and the employee updated their Mailing Address through Employee Portal, the Mailing Address field was only updated for the client that the employee was currently logged in to. This is fixed. The Mailing Address field now updates for the employee record across all clients that they have access to.
EERT-2793 When an employee was going through the Onboarding process with a status of Onboarding in Progress - Payroll Suppressed (save is disabled), the manager could still make changes to the employee’s record through the My Employees form in Employee Portal. This is fixed. Editing the employee record is now disabled until the Onboarding process is complete or suspended with payroll active.
EERT-2817 When a manager attempted to filter results on the PTO Team Calendar form using the PTO Type field, the results were not filtered properly when the PTO Type field was changed multiple times. This is fixed.
EERT-2819 On the Total Compensation Report, when an employee has a negative amount for the Employer contribution, the text did not display properly and overlapped with the displayed chart. This is fixed.
EERT-2826 When a user removed the date of birth from an employee record on the Personal Info tab in Employee Portal and attempted to save the changes, an error occurred. This is fixed. The Date of Birth field is required, and a message now displays indicating that the required field must be filled out before the record can be saved.
EERT-2887 When a worksite manager did not have access to view pay rates and entered time values on the Detail Time Sheet Entry form in Employee Portal, the time sheet displayed a $0 pay rate until the manager tabbed through the details and saved the entry. This is fixed. Both the hours and associated pay rate now populate properly on the time sheet.
EERT-2901 When a manager used Employee Portal to enter a rehire record and did not have access to Employee Pay on their user role, a message displayed incorrectly indicating required fields were missing information, even though no such fields displayed. This is fixed. Managers no longer require Employee Pay permissions to enter a rehire through Employee Portal.
EERT-2905 On the Employee PTO Calendar in Employee Portal, PTO requests for partial days displayed a value rounded to the nearest fifteen minutes instead of the exact hour and minute value entered on the request. This is fixed.
EERT-2916 When a user attempted to delete clients from the Segments form, the form only displayed up to 10 clients. This is fixed.
EP-5296 When a user entered a date or partially filled out the Direct Deposit Acceptance Text form in Prism, then left the screen without clicking Save or Cancel, Employee Portal would display a blank Acceptance Text message when a user updated their Direct Deposit form. This is fixed.
EP-9300 When a user accessed an employee’s Employee Portal using the proxy login feature, the proxy user could view the employee’s PrismONE Mobile QR Code. This is fixed. Proxy users can no longer view the PrismONE Mobile QR Code, just like 3rd party widgets.

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R202507.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R202507.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2834 When a user downloaded the Client Allocation Report as a CSV file from Employee Portal, the data did not match the values in the same report downloaded as a CSV file from Prism. This is fixed.
EERT-2918 When bank accounts were added or changed in Employee Portal, the accounts were not properly set to Pending status, and prenotes were not created properly. This is fixed.
EERT-3001 If a user added, removed, or updated Direct Deposit accounts in the Employee Portal when no approval policy was in place, any unchanged accounts were reverted to Prenote (Pending) status. This is fixed.
EP-9023 When a manager attempted to edit a new hire’s First or Last Name from the New Hire Dashboard while the new employee was in Onboarding, the manager’s edits were not properly saved. This is fixed. Managers can now make edits on the New Hire form to the First and Last Name while the employee is going through the Onboarding process. > Note: Note: If a manager changes the employee’s First Name and Last Name, the onboarding process must be restarted. A message prompt displays when a manager attempts to edit these fields to require confirmation before the edit is saved.
EP-9111 When a user made changes to information on the Direct Deposit form in Employee Portal, navigated to another menu, and selected Yes, I want to leave on the confirmation message, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EP-9322 When a manager added a new hire’s personal and work email addresses and saved the form, the work email was incorrectly saved with the personal email address. This is fixed.

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R202508.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R202508.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2915 When a user entered emergency contact information onto the Emergency Contacts form in Employee Portal, the phone number was not properly formatted. This is fixed.
EERT-2948 When a worksite manager attempted to add a rehire through Employee Portal, the rehire process could not be completed if the manager did not have access to the Employee Pay on their User Role and if the Rehire User Role process has the Pay Rate Hidden option selected. This is fixed.
EERT-2954 Worksite Trusted Advisors were able to access Segments in Prism, however, they were not able to save any changes they made. This is fixed. Worksite Trusted Advisors now only have access to Segments in Employee Portal. Changes to Segments in Employee Portal can be saved normally.
EERT-2971 When an employee Status was set to Selectable by Service Provider Only, Worksite Managers and Worksite Trusted Advisors could still select that Status for a new hire on the New Hire Dashboard. This is fixed.
EERT-2984 When a Worksite Manager attempted to rehire an employee who had not yet registered in Employee Portal, an error occurred. This is fixed. Employees with or without an Employee Portal User ID can now be rehired.
EERT-2997 When a manager added a cross-hire employee on the New Hire Dashboard, and the cross-hire employee already had an Employee Portal username from another company, the prehire record was not generated properly, and the onboarding workflow did not initiate. This is fixed.
EP-8338 When an employee acknowledged an alert, the Proof of Signature section of the form cut off a portion of the text in the final, saved version of the document. This is fixed.
EP-9365 When a Service Provider used the Proxy Login feature to log in as an Employee, the Service Provider could edit rates on the Retirement Summary form. This is fixed. The Retirement Summary form is now set to read-only during a Proxy Login session.
EP-9374 When an employee was actively employed by two clients and completed their federal and state tax withholding forms, the employee record was not properly updated for both clients. This is fixed.
EP-9392 When a user viewed the Veteran Status form on a mobile device, portions of the text were cut off. This is fixed.

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R202509.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R202509.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2923 When a user entered their last name with a space at the end in Employee Portal, the system did not properly truncate the extra end space, which could create errors due to the name not matching other content. This is fixed.
EERT-2939 When a user viewed the Direct Deposit Acceptance text on the Direct Deposit form in Employee Portal, the conditions section of the form displayed incorrectly as HTML code instead of the terms and conditions. This is fixed.
EERT-2951 When a manager used the Time Sheet Entry form in Employee Portal to enter hours with a non-productive pay code, the Hours Worked field was incorrectly filled in automatically with the amount. This is fixed. Non-productive pay codes do not add to the Hours Worked field.
EERT-2959 On the Add/Edit Dependent form in Benefits Enrollment, the Primary Phone, Work Phone, and Email forms did not use the standard formatting used throughout the rest of Employee Portal. This is fixed.
EERT-3003 When a Worksite Manager viewed the Approvals form in Employee Portal, client approvals did not display properly, even though those approvals did display in Prism. This is fixed.
EERT-3017 When a user attempted to add a Direct Deposit account through Employee Portal, and the method and amount were the same as an inactive Direct Deposit account on the employee record, the system displayed a message indicating the new account was saved but did not actually save the record correctly. This is fixed.
EP-8824 When a user who could only navigate via the keyboard attempted to complete the I-9 form, numerous options could not be reached via keyboard navigation, including scrolling, buttons to approve or deny forms, or the Electronic Signature. This is fixed. Accessibility has been improved to ensure that keyboard-only users navigate, fill in, close, approve, and deny I-9 forms.
APP-52 When a user clicked a link on a 3rd party widget in the PrismONE Mobile App on an Android device, the links did not function properly. This is fixed.
APP-62 When users logging in with the PrismONE Mobile App attempted to punch in using the TimeCo widget or menu item, an error occurred. This is fixed.
APP-71 When a user entered their PIN incorrectly, reauthenticated their User ID, and logged in from another device, attempting to log in from the first device triggered the reauthentication requirement again. This is fixed.

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
APP-124 When users accessed the PrismONE mobile app with certain Android devices, the header menu bar overlapped with some native phone elements, such as the clock and battery life indicator. This is fixed.
EERT-2970 When a user viewed the Pay tab on the Total Compensation Report in Employee Portal, if the bar graph for a row was shorter than the dollar amount text, the dollar amount text overflowed on the graph and overlapped with the name of the row. This is fixed.
EERT-2995 When users viewed the Time Sheet Entry form in Employee Portal and attempted to view the next page, the pagination did not function properly, and the user could only view the first page on the form. This is fixed.
EP-9658 When a user’s session timed out in Employee Portal, the Redirect After Logout feature did not properly redirect the user. This is fixed.

Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R_202504.htm Path: EP/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/EP_Fixes_R_202504.htm

Fixes

When technical difficulties surface, we strive to resolve them right away. The following are recent known issues that we’ve fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2576 When an employee viewed tax information using Employee Portal, the Additional Withholding (per paycheck) override type would display for all options instead of the selected override type. This is fixed.
EERT-2583 When an employee was hired by a manager using the New Hire Dashboard in Employee Portal, and the employee attempted to register using a mobile device, the registration form did not display properly. This is fixed.
EERT-2599 If a Worksite Manager had full security access to at least one field on the Contact Info form in Employee Portal, but work email addresses were hidden for the worksite manager’s user role, the worksite manager was unable to edit contact information on an employee’s record. This is fixed.
EERT-2608 When a user set up a Direct Deposit account with the Remainder method, then added an additional Direct Deposit account with the 100% value, the 100% account was not saved properly. This is fixed. The user is now shown a message that indicates the issue, which reads “The sum of your accounts is more than 100%. Please make the amount values less or equal to 100%.”
EERT-2684 If the maximum number of direct deposit accounts allowed for an employee was reduced using the Direct Deposit Form Settings form, and an employee’s direct deposit accounts exceeded the new limit, attempting to access the employee’s Direct Deposits form resulted in an error. This is fixed.
EERT-2705 When a Worksite Manager attempted to access the My Approvals form to view an approval, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EERT-2750 If an Onboarding workflow is suspended and the option to allow the employee to access Employee Portal is selected, the employee status remains open on the New Hire Dashboard instead of being marked as Completed. This is fixed.
EERT-2756 If an Employee Status Code did not allow Termination as an Allowed Action Code on the Employee Statuses form, employees with that status code could still be terminated through Employee Portal. This is fixed. A message now displays indicating the HR action is not allowed for that employment status or type, and the Termination action is not performed.
EERT-2760 When a segment targeting active employees was assigned to a manager menu item in Employee Portal, worksite trusted advisors were unable to see the menu item since they lacked an employee record. This is fixed.
EERT-2788 When a user reviewed Benefit Groups on the New Hire Dashboard in Employee Portal, benefit groups past their stop dates still displayed. This is fixed.
EERT-2808 When a Service Provider enabled payday notifications on the Client Details form, notifications still displayed as disabled in Employee Portal. Employees could still enable the notifications by opting in on the Employee Portal form, but it could not be enabled by default. This is fixed.
EERT-2811 When an employee received PTO from two different plans, the PTO Estimator calculated upcoming PTO incorrectly. This is fixed.
EP-6833 On the PTO Approvals form, the Comments field did not have a character limit, and comments with too many characters would display as cut off mid-sentence on the Approvals Summary record. This is fixed. The field is now limited to 200 characters.
EP-7455 When a service provider edited the Birthdays & Anniversaries widget on a Configuration Template, the Widget Visibility field displayed options to have the widget display for employees, despite the widget being restricted to only display for managers in Employee Portal. This is fixed. The Widget Visibility field now properly reflects that this is a manager-only widget.

PrismONE ID Now Available

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/IAM/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202409/PrismONE_Now_Available.htm Path: IAM/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202409/PrismONE_Now_Available.htm

PrismONE ID Now Available

PrismONE ID is a new cutting-edge Identity Management solution designed specifically for the PrismHR product suite that streamlines access across all PrismHR applications by enabling users to authenticate with a single, unified identity. From simplifying user management and enhancing security to ensuring integration and a consistent user experience across all PrismHR products, this next-generation solution will help users save time.

Existing PrismHR users already have PrismONE ID their activated.

Enabling PrismONE ID is accomplished by applying a series of feature codes that will either invite or require users to self-register, just after logging into PrismHR or Employee Portal (EP). For more information on PrismONE ID, consult the implementation guide on the CRC.

Map California Wage Notice to PDF Fields

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/OBE/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/MR_202402/New_CA_Wage_Form.htm Path: OBE/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/MR_202402/New_CA_Wage_Form.htm

Map California Wage Notice to PDF Fields

You can now map the updated 2024 California Wage Notice form to PDF fields on a custom form. This can be used to write data to the new Emergency or Disaster Disclosure section of the California form. This data is populated based on the responses to the following new hire questions:

  • There is a state or federal emergency or disaster declaration issued within 30 days of the employee’s first day of employment.
  • Please enter the state or federal emergency or disaster declaration to report on the form.

To add these questions to a form, access the PDF Fields Map tab after uploading a PDF and click Edit for the field to which you want to map the questions. The Edit PDF Fields Map window displays. On this window, select the following:

Map (Source) Function
disaster_question Check box for a state or federal emergency or disaster declaration.
emergency_or_disaster_declaration Text box to enter the state or federal emergency of disaster declaration.

After making a selection, click Apply Changes. The window closes, and the information from PrismHR that corresponds to the selected source is automatically entered in the field when the form is accessed in Onboarding.

Updated Wording for Sending Benefit Confirmation Statement Emails

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/OBE/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202403/Benefit_Confirmation_Statement_Wording.htm Path: OBE/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202403/Benefit_Confirmation_Statement_Wording.htm

Updated Wording for Sending Benefit Confirmation Statement Emails

Previously, the subject line of the Benefits Confirmation Statement email message template on the Email Services form required the word “Secure” at the end of the subject line. However, this created confusion regarding whether the email message was sent via a secure gateway, or if the email message was secured with encryption. The wording requirement on the subject line has been removed.

Email messages sent using this form use a secure SMTP gateway when sent. Prism email messages are not inherently encrypted.

Global Employee Dependent Required Fields Settings Enforcement

With this ticket, logic was applied to ensure that dependent fields flagged as required on the New Hire and Dependent Required Fields (Global) form are enforced on the Add Dependent form in Benefits Enrollment when you attempt to save the form. This change affects the following fields:

  • Address (Address Line 1, City, State and ZIP Code are affected by this change. Address Line 2 is always optional and is never treated as a required field in the system.)
  • Birth Date
  • Gender
  • Relation
  • Social Security Number

To achieve settings enforcement of required dependent fields on the Add Dependent form, the following changes were made:

  • Dependent field data entry boxes are indicated with an asterisk.
  • Attempting to save the Add Dependent form without completing one or more required fields results in an error message listing each incomplete field as shown in the example below.

New UI for Symmetry Payroll Forms

The all-new Symmetry user interface for onboarding forms now includes additional features, including performance and security improvements, and language support.

The new UI features improved responsiveness for all screen dimensions, improving performance for employees completing forms on all devices. In addition, the new UI is updated to the latest JavaScript libraries to prevent security vulnerabilities and keep the onboarding form process secure.

Furthermore, the update includes additional language support for onboarding forms. Employees can translate forms into Spanish, French, or English, regardless of the original published language from the jurisdiction, improving the accessibility of all forms in the onboarding process.

New Notifications for Time-Based Hire Date

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/OBE/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202403/Notification_Time_Based_Hire.htm Path: OBE/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202403/Notification_Time_Based_Hire.htm

New Notifications for Time-Based Hire Date

Service Providers can now configure a new trigger and notifications in Onboarding and Benefits Enrollment based on time-based conditions for the hiring date. Using this feature, service providers can set up triggers on the Notification Templates form so that new hires are sent notifications a certain number of days before or after the hiring date.

Hiring managers can use these conditions for situations where the employee should start onboarding before or after a specific hiring date. For example, an employee might be hired, but have to wait for equipment before they can start work, and the onboarding process can be delayed until they can obtain their equipment and begin working.

To add time-based triggers to an existing notification:

  1. Select Onboarding and Benefits > Notification Templates.

  2. Select the Template Id to modify.

  3. In the Notification Triggers section, select Time Based for the Trigger Type.

  4. In the Trigger Condition field, select X Days before hire date or X Days after hire date.

  5. In the Number of Days field, enter the number of days before or after the hire date to send the notification.

  6. Click Save.

Using these new trigger conditions, Service Providers can enter a new hire into the system prior to their hire date, but notify the new employee to begin onboarding or benefits enrollment on their actual hire date.

JIRA # OBE-7807, OBE-7813, OBE-7991

Preferred Name in Onboarding and Benefits Enrollment

A new hire’s preferred name now displays throughout Onboarding and Benefits enrollment, which the system uses in place of their legal first name in the user menu, header, and other forms. The electronic signature continues to use the new hire’s legal name.

When a manager enters a new hire’s preferred name in the Preferred Name field during the Onboarding process, that name now displays throughout the process. The new hire can now see the preferred name on the Employee Information form. In addition, the new hire can add a name if the field is blank, or change the name to update the record.

An additional substitution variable which can be used when building message templates is now available. The following variable and its formatting are now available:

Preferred Name <>

When generating a message, the system replaces the variable with data for the specified employee.

Upload Two-Sided Supporting Documents

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/OBE/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202403/Two_Sided_Documents.htm Path: OBE/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202403/Two_Sided_Documents.htm

Upload Two-Sided Supporting Documents

This enhancement includes support for employers who are qualified to use the alternate procedure in E-Verify to submit two-sided supporting documentation. This procedure allows two-sided or multi-page documentation to be provided as proof of I-9 Employement Eligibility. For example, a new hire can submit scanned pages from their passport as proof of eligibility.

Note: Note: To be considered qualified, the employer must be in good standing with E-Verify. For more information about eligibility, refer to the Qualifications section below.

Submitting Two-Sided Documentation

When a new hire selects a two-sided document to upload in the Select a Document to Upload field on the I-9 Employment Eligibility form, the new hire can now upload separate files for the front and back of the document. This support is also provided when selecting a US passport as documentation, with separate uploads for the Passport ID page and the Passport Barcode page.

Reviewing Two-Sided Supporting Documents

Employers can now review two-sided documents to verify their authenticity on the Employment Eligibility Verification form, which is accessed through the My Approvals form in Employee Portal. If the employee submitted two-sided documents, the Employment Eligibility Verification form now displays individual tabs for each side of the document to be reviewed.

Note: Note: Employers can review two-sided documents on both desktop and mobile devices.

Declining to Upload and In-Person Documents

Employers can elect to decline to upload documents during the Onboarding process and choose to present their documentation to the employer in person. During the Onboarding process, the new hire can select the I will present documentation to my employer in person option on the I-9 Employment Eligibility form to decline the document upload.

Qualifications

To be considered qualified, the employer must be in good standing with E-Verify. According to the US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), good standing refers to an employer who is enrolled in E-Verify with respect to all hiring sites in the United States that use the alternative procedure, in compliance with all requirements, and continues to participate in good standing in E-Verify at any time they use the alternate procedure. For more information about the alternate procedure qualifications, refer to the USCIS documentation here.

Edit Dependents in Enrollment Workflow

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/OBE/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202406/Edit_Dependents_Workflow.htm Path: OBE/Release-Notes/Enhancements/2024/QR_202406/Edit_Dependents_Workflow.htm

Edit Dependents in Enrollment Workflow

Clients can now enable employees to make changes to their dependents during the benefit enrollment process. Previously, employees could only add dependents during benefit election, but had to navigate to the Employee Portal to make changes to dependents. Using this option, clients can allow employees to make changes directly to save time.

Note: Note: When the employee edits a dependent and changes the relationship, date of birth, gender, full-time student flag, tobacco user flag, or disabled flag, the employee’s workflow is reset, and the employee receives a notification indicating that they must recomplete their elections.

To enable editing dependents during the workflow at a global level, navigate to Workflow Setup / Benefits Specific / Enrollment Options and select the Allow Edit Dependents in Enrollment Workflow field.

To enable editing dependents during the workflow at a client level, navigate to Client / Change / Client Details, navigate to the Benefits tab, and select the Allow Edit Dependents in Enrollment Workflow? field.

Note: Note: These fields are disabled by default and must be enabled at the global or client level to allow employees to edit their dependents during the workflow.

When this field is checked, the Edit button is available on the Dependents form in the benefits enrollment workflow. When the field is not checked, the Edit button does not display on the Dependents form in the UI.
