Payroll Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/MR202410/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_MR202410.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/MR202410/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_MR202410.htm

Payroll Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-18151 The Restartable Payroll engine sometimes displayed an error message, “Cannot read employee payroll voucher,” when the system was calculating payrolls. This is fixed.
PD-18153 The Restartable Payroll engine did not reorder charge dates chronologically for Detail Time entries on the voucher when an employee was subject to Alabama State Income Tax and the later charge date was entered in the detailed time entry first, which incorrectly calculated the Alabama Overtime exempt amount. > Note: Note: When the LEGACY-PAYROLL-GLOBAL custom feature code was enabled, the system correctly reordered detail time entries and the taxes were calculated correctly. This is fixed.
PD-18156 The premium overtime pay code did not honor the pay period end date when the Restartable Payroll engine was used with the FLSA ruleset that included a premium pay code for overtime. > Note: Note: When the LEGACY-PAYROLL-GLOBAL custom feature code was enabled, the Legacy Payroll engine honored the work weekday override on the pay group. The Restartable Payroll engine now uses the Work Week Ends On date override on the employee’s pay group to charge the premium overtime pay code.
PD-18218 The Restartable Payroll engine did not suppress benefits when the Suppress Benefits Calculation field was enabled on the Payroll Option Templates form. > Note: Note: When the LEGACY-PAYROLL-GLOBAL custom feature code was enabled in this scenario, the system suppressed benefits. This is fixed.
PD-18238 The Restartable Payroll engine did not generate the correct results when the Adjust Taxes to Cover Cash Shortfall field on the Payroll tab in the Client Details form was set to Adjust taxes before deductions. > Note: Note: When the LEGACY-PAYROLL-GLOBAL custom feature code was enabled in this scenario, this issue did not occur. This is fixed.
RRT-5852 The system did not accurately track employees with multiple pay codes in the Payroll Allocation Report if one of the departments was null in the Allocations table. This is fixed.
WSP-770 The Delete button was active for users whose role was set to Inquiry on the Check Acknowledgement Report Parameters form. > Note: Note: Clicking Delete and selecting Yes in the prompt did not actually delete the record. This is fixed.
WSP-830 The system sometimes generated false errors in client accounting when users ran the Payroll Validation Report. This is fixed.
WSP-842 When running a payroll, the system did not correctly calculate the withholding based on the Ending Pay date and calculation Status on the Tax Calculation Overrides form. This is fixed.
WSP-988 Users were unable to access the timesheet and restart the payroll process after a wire transfer was marked as received. Users can now access timesheet-entry and initialization again for a payroll with wire-pending status and is marked as payment received on the Payments Pending form.

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/MR202412/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_MR202412.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/MR202412/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_MR202412.htm

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-18590 The system did not correctly format the email produced when users imported new hires in the Portal New Hire Import form. > Note: Note: New hires entered manually were not affected by this scenario. This is fixed.
RRT-6023 The system did not recognize the ALLOWZEROSSNS custom feature code that was enabled when users tried to save the new 000 Employee SSN number on the Employee Details form and displayed an error message. This is fixed.

Payroll Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/MR202412/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_MR202412.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/MR202412/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_MR202412.htm

Payroll Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-18246 The system did not display an error message for an unapproved payroll with an initialized voucher that exceeded the maximum check amount when users tried to recalculate it using the Restartable Payroll feature in the Process Payroll or SuperBatch form. > Note: Note: When the LEGACY-PAYROLL-GLOBAL custom feature code was enabled in this scenario, this issue did not occur. This is fixed.
PD-18247 The system generated a negative deduction (credits/refunds) as an A voucher when users tried to generate a live check using Restartable Payroll for a manual payroll that contained a .01 timesheet detail entry and a negative one-time deduction. > Note: Note: When the LEGACY-PAYROLL-GLOBAL custom feature code was enabled in this scenario, this issue did not occur. The system now generates an R voucher where the check number displays on the Banking tab in the Payroll Voucher form.
PD-18280 The system did not display benefit adjustments on the Deductions tab in the Payroll Voucher form after users calculated a regularly scheduled payroll using the Restartable Payroll feature. > Note: Note: When the LEGACY-PAYROLL-GLOBAL custom feature code was enabled in this scenario, this issue did not occur. This is fixed.
PD-18321 The system did not create a voucher when users calculated a payroll using the Restartable Payroll feature that contained one employee who had two detail entries that overwrote each other. > Note: Note: When the LEGACY-PAYROLL-GLOBAL custom feature code was enabled in this scenario, this issue did not occur. This is fixed.
PD-18509 The system displayed employees who had zero pay vouchers when users calculated a special payroll using the Restartable Payroll feature. > Note: Note: When the LEGACY-PAYROLL-GLOBAL custom feature code was enabled in this scenario, this issue did not occur. This is fixed.
WSP-1215 Users were unable to download reports, except for the Voucher Summary Report, before posting results when they accessed step 5, Calculate Taxes, in the Check History Import process after the voucher information displayed. This is fixed.

General Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202403/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_QR202403.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202403/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_QR202403.htm

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-14807 The system did not match the bulk role descriptions to the user role in the Bulk Role Update form. This is fixed.
PD-15636 The system did not delete pending payrolls when users changed the client’s status in the Client Status Change form. This is fixed.
PD-15955 A phantom checkbox displayed at the bottom of the list in the Messages form if there were less than 99 messages. This is fixed.
PD-16176 Users who proxied in as managers were unable to view planned time off requests if they were logged in directly as a manager. This is fixed.
PD-16325 The system did not display an error message during an employee fields import if the employee’s record did not have the FICA Exempt field enabled on the Tax tab in the Employee Details form and users tried to enter a thru date. In this scenario the following error message now displays, “The FICA Exempt field must be Yes to add a thru date.”
PD-16326 The system allowed users to save a blank user record in the User Roles panel in the Users form. The system now removes any blank user roles in the Users form when users save the record.
PD-16578 The system did not calculate union deductions correctly when users updated an employee’s Labor Union Affiliation in the Employee Fields Import form. This is fixed.
PP-767 When a user accesses the Client Benefits Overview form with more than 500 benefit groups available, severe performance delays would occur. This is fixed. Plans terminated over a year ago will now be skipped on this form to improve performance.
PP-936 The column headers on the Enhanced Dashboard were misaligned after an update to the form. This is fixed.
PP-1131 When a user attempted to search for an employee with an invalid record due to modifications or deletion, the search process would sometimes lag out and cause processing delays. This is fixed.
PP-1177 When a user attempted to export the Employee Master Report or the Emergency Contact Report as an XLS file, an error occurred. This is fixed.
PP-1205 When a user reviewed records on the SuperBatch form, records could not be properly sorted by Pay Date. This is fixed.
PP-1208 The Billing Zip Code field on the COBRA Participant Record form was not listed as a required field. If a user left the field blank, an invalid entry was saved on the record. This is fixed.
PP-1214 Multi-factor authentication would sometimes send two separate authentication emails to the user’s email account. This is fixed.
PP-1246 When a user received a warning message while attempting to archive a PTO Register that had already been archived, the warning message displayed incorrect text. This is fixed.
PP-1247 Users could assign roles to individuals who lacked the proper permissions by manually entering the user name on the Backup Account Assignments form. This is fixed. The Backup Account Assignments form now restricts users from being assigned to roles when they lack the proper security permissions.
PP-1261 When printing a report or converting a report to a PDF format, a user could enter special characters into the Print From Page and Print To Page fields, which created an error. This is fixed.
PP-1267 When an employee clicked the Select Geocode button on the Employee Address form to locate a geocode, the selection window did not properly display. This is fixed.
RRT-5610 When there were multiple unbundled billing rules that specified the same Position Code, Pay Class, and Pay Code, but different Location Codes, the system did not follow the sales tax setup in the Sales Tax Codes form and incorrectly calculated the sales tax. In this scenario, after users applied an unbundled billing rule and the system calculated the sales tax, other unbundled billing rules matching the description above had incorrectly calculated sales tax, which was added to the sales tax total even though those later billing rules specified a Location Code that was different from the Location Code in the timesheet earnings. This is fixed.

Payroll Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202403/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_QR202403.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202403/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_QR202403.htm

Payroll Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-15516 When a check import was processed with an HSA deduction where the type was set as a Flexible Spending Account, the system created a record for the year in which the check import was dated. (This was incorrect because a client might have both a Section 125 plan and an HSA plan.) When using a check import to record HSA deductions, the process now creates and updates the employee flexible spending record. In addition, this process now validates whether the deduction code in the import is linked to a Section 125 plan on the client or to the HSA plan listed on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form. Therefore: - When using the HSA plan, the system creates a record with the plan year HS21, HS22, HS23. - When using the Section 125 plan, the record remains 2021, 2022, 2023.
  • When using the HSA plan, the system creates a record with the plan year HS21, HS22, HS23.

General Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202406/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_QR202406.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202406/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_QR202406.htm

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-16526 The system displayed an error message in the Delete Pending Client form when users added a client to a segment, moved that client to Pending status, and then deleted it, so they could no longer open the segment. This is fixed.
PD-16573 The system displayed a warning that didn’t apply when users enrolled an employee in a PTO Benefit Plan with YTD Hours Calculated in the Employee PTO Register Enrollment form. The system now validates against the correct seniority level when users enroll employees.
PD-16854 The default MFA message that displayed in the Message Templates form when no custom MFA message had been configured was grammatically incorrect. This is fixed.
PD-16858 After users selected an Employee and Register Type on the Employee PTO Register, they had to click the Actions menu twice to open it. This is fixed.
PD-16863 The list of options in the Leave Employment Status field on the Leave of Absence form did not display in alphabetical order. This is fixed.
PD-16864 The system did not display the Reason column in the Status Type History form after users reactivated an employee. This is fixed.
PD-16997 The Employee Details option did not display on the Actions menu in the Employee Benefits Enrollment form for users whose role was set to Inquiry access for the Employee Details form. This is fixed.
PD-17003 Users were unable to delete a Client Acct Template from a worksite location in the Worksite Locations form after processing a payroll. This is fixed.
PD-17026 The system did not display the net amount of earnings when it calculated the salary amount for an employee with the Calc Salary by Date Range field enabled on the Retirement Exports form for the Pinnacle template. This is fixed.
PD-17073 The text box for the Rebate Bill Code field on the Deduction Codes form did not line up with the field. This is fixed.
PD-17109 The system did not update the PTO register’s Benefit Start Date on the Employee PTO Register form when users switched between Register Types. This is fixed.
PD-17130 The system included the December accrual amount in the PTO Register Types form for the First of Following Month Trigger Method in the carryover for a year’s YTD PTO accrual that was not the current year, which effectively doubled the last month of the year’s PTO accrual. This is fixed.
PD-17218 An error message did not display when users entered a new hire with direct deposit set to Active and then saved the record with missing information, such as the account number. The appropriate error message now displays in this scenario.
PD-17233 The system allowed users to save information in the EEO Ethnic Codes form without selecting the EEO Report code, which is a required field. This is fixed.
PD-17234 After users processed the W-2 Box Report successfully and clicked Report in the Job Progress window, clicked Report to view the report output results and closed that window, then clicked Close in the Job Progress window, the report output redisplayed with no results (the output was blank). This is fixed.
PD-17241 The system displayed the wrong error message, “Please raise a Custom Programming Request,” when users tried to delete a new hire on the Delete Unused Employee form after entering a transfer in the Transfer Tax Basis form. The correct error message now displays in this scenario, “Please submit a Professional Services Engagement Request.”
PD-17242 The system displayed the School District Number in the Registration Number field on the Property tab in the Employee Details form, which overrode any existing value for that field. This is fixed.
PD-17254 The system did not display audit record updates in the File Audit form when users created W-2s and changed the W2C web access to No for the employer. This is fixed.
PD-17260 The system did not include all required fields for the state of Maine in the New Hire Reporting form’s downloadable output file. This is fixed.
PP-605 When a user searched for an employee on the Find Changes to an Employee form, the search resulted in slowed performance. This is fixed.
PP-1084 In some cases, the External Journal Post form resulted in slow performance when search results returned a large number of records. This is fixed.
PP-1157 When a client attempted to add a large number of employees to the Payroll Control Quick Load form, an error occurred. This is fixed.
PP-1314 When a user reviewed the File Audit form, mass pay rate changes displayed “Background Process” instead of the user who made the change. This is fixed. The audit log now shows the User ID.
PP-1328 When a user added a phone number with too many digits to the Emergency Contact section of an employee record, the system saved the improper number and did not inform the user of the error. This is fixed. The user is now notified that the phone number has too many digits and must be corrected.
PP-1374 When a user made changes on the Client Benefit form to the ACA table, the File Audit form displayed incorrect information for changes to the Year and ACA Large Employer fields. This is fixed.
PP-1379 When a user selected Add All on a selection form which displayed items 100 at a time, only the first 100 items would be added. For example, on the Select Pay Code form, clicking Add All would add the first hundred pay codes displayed. This is fixed.
PP-1387 When a user selects multiple clients using the Client ID selector on the Unbundled Billing Rules Import form, then uses the selector to remove some of the selected clients, the clients were not properly removed from the list and an error message displayed. This is fixed.
PP-1479 When a user entered a ZIP code on the New Hire form and selected a GeoCode from the dropdown menu, the City, State, and Country fields did not automatically populate. In addition, state forms based on these fields were not properly flagged as required. This is fixed. Selecting a geocode now populates the corresponding fields properly and flags the required forms.
WSP-342 The system evaluated Misc GL segments for departments, divisions, locations, positions, and projects on payroll invoices. The system now suppresses evaluation of the wildcards when building account codes for payroll invoices.

Payroll Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202406/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_QR202406.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202406/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_QR202406.htm

Payroll Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-16034 The system incorrectly pointed to the Employee Master, an HRPyramid term, instead of the Employer Details form, in the error message that displayed when users tried to process a payroll that contained a state tax number that was not listed in the State Tax panel for the state where the employee works and resides. The correct error message now displays, “State income tax is being calculated for but a State Tax Number has not been setup on the Employer Details record for Employer ID . State tax number must be setup for this employer before this payroll can proceed.” > Note: Note: This update includes restartable payrolls.
PD-16572 The system did not round per pay periods as expected for a salaried employee in the Time Sheet Entry form when their pay was split between two or more pay codes. When pay codes are marked to round to the pay period, the system now forces the total amount of the salaried employee’s pay to round this way, as long as the total hours equal their standard pay.
PD-16806 The system doubled Workers’ Compensation Basis Pay when users created an on-demand check using the On Demand Check Processing form. The Workers’ Compensation Basis Pay now equals the Pay Amount of an on-demand check.
PD-16914 The values in the Description columns overlapped into the Amount column in the output for the Payroll Variance Reports form, which made it difficult to read. The values in the Description columns were truncated, so they no longer overlap into the next column.
PD-16991 User were unable to edit the Leave to Timesheet and Notes fields in the Leave request assignment form when a new leave request for the pay period of a current payroll was approved after an approved leave request was already accepted into a timesheet. This is fixed.
PD-17033 The Commission pay method that displayed in the Pay Method column after selecting the Filter icon in the Time Sheet Entry form was spelled incorrectly. This is fixed.
PD-17064 The system displayed a form, Tax Override, when users selected Add To Favorites in the Actions menu on the Manual Check Entry form. (This favorite was still saved.) The system now only displays a banner, “Form added to favorites,” when users select Add To Favorites in the Manual Check Entry form.
PD-17237 The system allowed worksite managers to save information in the Payroll Control form without setting a date in the required Remote Cutoff Date field. This is fixed.
PD-17255 When users paid using a pay code set to Pay Code is Exempt from All Taxes on the Tax Exemptions form, the system calculated the Employer NM Assessment Fee even though there were no taxable wages. This is fixed.
PD-17311 The system displayed a blank payday notification when the Current Type in the Message Templates form was set to TEXT. The system now displays payday notifications that match the email template, with the pay details.
RRT-5794 The system did not display the pay rates for some commissioned employees in the timesheet and for the employee’s pay in the Time Sheet Entry form. (The system calculated the payroll without errors and created a zero voucher.) This is fixed.

General Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202409/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_QR202409.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202409/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_QR202409.htm

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-14382 The system displayed the Add to Favorites option on the Actions menu in the Commission Maintenance form even though the current user already set the form as a favorite. This is fixed. Only the Remove from Favorites option now displays in this scenario.
PD-16457 Worksite trusted advisors were unable to access the same Data Retriever Benefits and Salary History as a worksite manager with the same user role. This is fixed.
PD-16471 Worksite managers were unable to view leave requests in the Planned Time Off Requests form when they were logged in at the same time a service provider proxied in as that worksite manager. This is fixed.
PD-16994 Worksite managers and worksite trusted advisors were allowed to enter a Work Group, Location, Department, or Division in the PTO Auto-Enrollment Rule Maintenance form that they were not allowed to access. This is fixed.
PD-17085 An error message displayed when users selected the User Fields option on the Actions menu in the Employee Details form. This is fixed.
PD-17091 Only one status code displayed in the Termination Status field even though more than one status code shared the same full description and abbreviated description. This is fixed.
PD-17115 The Delete button was enabled for users whose user role was set to Inquiry mode for the Employer Details form. (Note: The system did not delete the record in this scenario.) The Delete button is now disabled in this scenario.
PD-17227 The system did not display a scroll bar in the User Fields form, so users were unable to access all available user-defined fields. The appropriate error message now displays in this scenario.
PD-17243 The values in the ZIP Code, City, County, and Geocode fields on the Address tab in the Employee Details form reverted to their previous values after users clicked Close in the Select Geocode window. (Note: This also occurred in the Latitude and Longitude fields on the Worksite Locations form.) This is fixed.
PD-17272 The system displayed an error message when users processed backdated leave requests if the Other Income field on the Tax tab in the Employee Details form listed an amount. This is fixed.
PD-17299 The system added default timesheet hours to an employee’s record when a future pay rate history adjustment was made in the Pay History Adjustment form. This is fixed.
PD-17339 Error messages in the Employer W/C Accrual Modifiers form did not display in a consistent format. The error message now includes the line number, column number, and error message details.
PD-17350 After users deleted a client in the Delete Pending Client form, worksite managers and worksite trusted advisors with access to that client could still view it in the Current Access panel on the Users form. This is fixed.
PD-17433 The Employee Fields Import form did not retain decimal points in the spreadsheet when it pulled data from the Default T/S Hours field on the Pay tab in the Employee Details form. This is fixed.
PD-17523 The system displayed the original total on the invoice after recalculating payroll for users who selected the Create REAL Invoice Breaks option on the Billing tab in the Client Details form. This is fixed.
PD-17552 The system did not display an error message when users did not have access to the client based on Client Access Group security settings when they either entered or selected a client in the Cash Receipts form. An error message now displays in this scenario on the Cash Receipts form and during the import process.
PD-17610 The system displayed an error message, “User is already assigned as a primary,” only for the Payroll and Human Resources Account Assignment Roles when users entered the same service provider user ID for the same role as a Backup Account Assignment role. The system now displays that error message for the following Account Assignment Roles: - Benefits - Risk - Sales - Coordinator - Broker - I-9 Approver
  • Benefits
  • Risk
  • Sales
  • Coordinator
  • Broker
  • I-9 Approver | PD-17626 | Users who had access to all clients in the Client Access Group were unable to access users set up as a HRP OE/BE Administrator user type in the Users form. | The system now treats the HRP OE/BE Administrator user type as a service provider user type. | | PP-1082 | When a user attempted to display the External Invoice Post form for a large number of clients, the form did not load properly and prompted the user to exit the form. | This is fixed. Performance has been improved for the External Invoice Post form, especially for users with a large number of clients. | | PP-1381 | When a user selected COBRA Participant Large Dataset in the Clients Assigned To selector for the Group Benefit Plans form, the dataset did not load proplerly for groups with a large number of clients. | This is fixed. | | PP-1478 | When an employee entered an address with certain ZIP codes, the matches that displayed as options listed the incorrect city. | This is fixed. | | PP-1520 | When a user saved changes on the Employee Details form or Client Details form and saved the information, the save notification caused the search box to be hidden for several seconds. | This is fixed. The search box is no longer hidden when a user saves information on these forms. | | PP-1531 | When a user reviewed information on the SuperBatch form and scrolled through a long list of entries, the automatic refresh of the form could change the user’s position on the form, which could lead to errors or mistakes. | This is fixed. When the form refreshes, the user’s position on the form is now retained. | | PP-1546 | When a user performed multiple searches on the Employee Voucher form, the search instances could continue processing without returning results, impacting performance. | This is fixed. | | PP-1614 | When a user entered a geocode on the Employee Address form, the School District No. field as not filled in properly. | This is fixed. | | RRT-5867 | When users either entered a company ID after entering an employer ID or entered an employer ID after entering a company ID in the Quarterly Tax Report, the system displayed messages that referenced the “employee ID” when it should have referenced the “employer ID.” | This is fixed. | | RRT-5878 | When users exported the Employee Master Report to Excel by selecting XLS at the top of the report, some column heading were not properly marked to clearly explain the data element being presented. | This is fixed. Also, column headings that include DD identify Direct Deposit details. | | WSP-546 | The background process updated several deduction codes even though users didn’t initiate the changes. | The audit log no longer displays these updates. | | WSP-713 | The system displayed an error message that a value was already entered when users tabbed through the Group Benefit Plans form. | This is fixed. | ========================================================================

Payroll Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202409/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_QR202409.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202409/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_QR202409.htm

Payroll Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-13566 The Restartable Payroll process did not clear initialized vouchers when it returned to the timesheet entry, which created a deadlock condition when an employee existed in two payrolls, particularly if that employee switched to a new pay group. The system now displays an error during the Restartable Payroll process when an employee is already being paid by the company while in a payroll with a status other than TS.ENTRY, TSOKCOMP, TS.READY, or COMP.
PD-14846 A duplicate Okay to Rehire field labeled as “New Type” displayed for approval-pending employee terminations on the Approval form, when accessed from the Approvals Pending form. The New Type field no longer displays in this scenario.
PD-15269 The XLS output in the confirmation report for imports using the Data Import Tool did not match the on-screen output. This is fixed.
PD-17135 The system assigned an incorrect pay period from the Pay Period field on the Pay tab in the Employee Details form when changing an employee to a different pay group on the Mass Change Pay Group form. This is fixed.
PD-17278 Users were able to reprint a voided third party check in the Third Party Check Posted Batch form. The Show Batch Accounting, Reprint Checks, and Remit Advice Report buttons are now disabled for voided batches.
PD-17325 When users imported changes to an existing rule in the Unbundled Billing Rules Import form, blank fields indicated “Value Removed” regardless of whether or not the field was already blank. “Value Removed” only displays if the system actually removes/clears the field in the transaction report.
PD-17360 The system displayed blank pages in the middle of data when users printed the Fax Back Report or converted it to PDF format for printing. This is fixed.
PD-17384 Users were able to exit the Payroll Reversal process before it finished by clicking the Close (X) button, so they did not answer all the void questions as part of this process and did not view any errors or warnings that might have displayed. The Payroll Reversal form no longer displays a Close (X) button, so users can only close this form after the process is complete.
PD-17403 A blank green bar displayed on the SuperBatch form when a service provider or worksite manager approved a payroll. The following now occurs: - When a worksite manager or worksite trusted advisor approves a payroll from the Approvals Pending form, a blank green bar no longer displays. - When a service provider approves a payroll in the SuperBatch form by clicking the Ellipsis icon and selects Payroll Approval, a blank green bar no longer displays.
  • When a worksite manager or worksite trusted advisor approves a payroll from the Approvals Pending form, a blank green bar no longer displays.
  • When a service provider approves a payroll in the SuperBatch form by clicking the Ellipsis icon and selects Payroll Approval, a blank green bar no longer displays. | PD-17441 | Service providers were unable to enter deduction codes in the Scheduled Deductions and Recurring Deductions forms that did not appear on the Client Control Deduction Codes list even though the ALLPAYCODESINT custom feature code was enabled. | The ALLPAYCODESINT custom feature code now includes deduction codes as well as pay codes. | | PD-17540 | The system displayed the DBAMOUNTNL (debit amount new line) and CRAMOUNTNL (credit amount new line) custom accounting data codes in the PEO Client Accounting form as “<>” and “<>” in the .csv output instead of the actual amounts. | This is fixed. | | PD-17627 | The system did not move payrolls calculated in SuperBatch for self-service clients to the “Payroll is ready to finalize” step and the Review icon was dimmed. | This is fixed. | | RRT-5888 | When certain users displayed the Additional Income Tax Override Report, the text of some fields would erroneously display a strikethrough. | This is fixed. | | WSP-673 | The system displayed a false error message about workers’ compensation override rates in the Payroll Validation Report. | This is fixed. | ========================================================================

General Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202411/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_QR202411.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2024/QR202411/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_QR202411.htm

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-14919 The system did not validate the Ethnic Code description on the EEO Ethnic Codes form, which displayed an error message on the Personal Info page in Employee Portal when no Ethic Code description was saved. The Ethnic Code field is now a required field.
PD-17522 The system displayed an extra period in the HOME.PHONE2 field for the Prism-Expanded Field Mapping ID when it was imported using the New Employee Import form. This is fixed.
PD-17795 PTO approvers who are worksite managers displayed as Last Name First Name in the PTO Approver column in the Data Retriever output report. These PTO approvers now display as First Name Last Name in the PTO Approver column.
PD-17800 The system did not redisplay unposted payrolls in the Cash Receipts form when users clicked Clear. This is fixed.
PD-17869 The system displayed an error in the Total Compensation Dashboard when users accessed an employee who was enrolled in an ancillary plan, even after they added the missing Benefit Plan ID. This is fixed.
PD-17976 The system did not clear the Last Billed Date in the new client when an employee was transferred using the Transfer Employee to New Client form. Instead, the system copied the date from the previous client. This is fixed.
PP-1532 When two users ran the ACA Third Party 1095 Export process at the same time for different clients, the process could mix the data and include results for both clients in a single download. This is fixed.
PP-1656 If an employee’s preferred first name included special characters, an error occurred when attempting to access the employee’s Time Sheet. This is fixed.
PP-1678 When an incorrect client number was added to an employee record, the employee no longer displayed in search results. This is fixed.
PP-1694 When a user attempted to view a voucher on the Employee Payroll Vouchers selection form for the Employee Details form, the first time the user selected the voucher, it did not display. Selecting the voucher a second time displayed the voucher successfully. This is fixed.
RRT-5944 If users had more than one user role, Custom Field Security Settings sometimes did not work correctly. This is fixed.
RRT-5953 The Informer row filter prevented users from viewing reports that listed closed/approved payroll calculations made by service providers even though they had access to the associated forms. This is fixed.
WSP-546 The background process updated several deduction codes even though users didn’t initiate the changes. The audit log no longer displays these updates.

PD-17065 The system disabled the Save button on the Manual Check Entry form when users zoomed in or out of the browser window after selecting Calculate Totals. This is fixed.
PD-17442 After filtering the Unpaid Employees Report by Employee Type, that type did not stay in place after running and then closing the on-screen report. This is fixed.
PD-17543 The system successfully imported an event code that was attached to a bill code that did not exist in the Account Template in the PEO Client Accounting form when using the Miscellaneous Invoices import template. The system now displays an error message if the import cannot succeed because the event code is attached to a bill code that does not exist in the Account Template.

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-17719 An approved leave request displayed as paid in the Planned Time Off Requests form in the following scenario: - PTO Absence Code had Auto Accept enabled or disabled. - Employee in the payroll had an approved leave accepted in the timesheet before calculation. - After payroll calculation, the same employee then had another leave submitted and approved for the same pay period. - The payroll was finalized. - The leave that was requested and approved after the payroll calculation displayed as paid in the Planned Time Off Requests form, but it was not paid to the employee. (The timesheet and voucher did not display that the PTO was paid.) The approved leave request does not display as paid in the Planned Time Off Requests form in this scenario.
  • PTO Absence Code had Auto Accept enabled or disabled.
  • Employee in the payroll had an approved leave accepted in the timesheet before calculation.
  • After payroll calculation, the same employee then had another leave submitted and approved for the same pay period.
  • The payroll was finalized.
  • The leave that was requested and approved after the payroll calculation displayed as paid in the Planned Time Off Requests form, but it was not paid to the employee. However, if that employee had enough leave requests which required scrolling through the list, other employees also displayed. | This is fixed. | | PP-1713 | When a user changed the custom background color for an account from the Global Configuration form, both the window background color and the report results window color changed. | This is fixed. | | PP-1738 | When a user added a new date to an existing holiday calendar on the Payroll Holidays form, the Date Picker Calendar did not appear. Users had to enter the date in the blank field manually. | This is fixed. | | PP-1755 | When a user searched for vouchers and changed the pay years on the Payroll Vouchers form, the search resulted in slowed performance. | This is fixed. | | PP-1756 | Reviewing or approving PTO approvals on the Approvals Pending form resulted in slow performance. | This is fixed. | | RRT-6002 | The system displayed an employee’s full Social Security Number in the Minnesota EFT Addenda Format in an ACH file even though the State of Minnesota TTP Addendum Requirements state that only the last four digits of the SSN is required. | This is fixed. | | RRT-6052 | When worksite managers entered a rehire with the approval policy assigned to a different worksite manager, the system automatically processed the approval instead of submitting it for approval to a service provider. | This is fixed. | | RRT-6058 | During the register rebuild process, the system duplicated the Successor Deferrals each time the rebuild was run, which resulted in the employee reaching the limits for the year ahead as displayed on the PYTD Retirement Contribution Summary Report. (This issue did not occur on the Employee Retirement Plan Register form.) | The system now processes the Successor Deferral fields correctly in the Employee 401k Register file. | | RRT-6130 | When a user entered HTML code in the Message Body field on the Notification Templates form, an error occurred indicating invalid entry formats, and the user was logged out of the system. | This is fixed. The notification templates continue to support HTML formatting. | | WSP-978 | The system did not retain data security for worksite managers when users canceled changing a worksite manger to a worksite employee after selecting the Change to a Worksite Employee option on the Actions menu in the Manager User Setup form. | This is fixed. | | WSP-1028 | Employees enrolled in a plan for the current year who had hours that were paid did not display on the PTO Recalculation form. | This is fixed. | | WSP-1032 | The system displayed an error message when users tried to import negative cash receipts using the Cash Receipts Import form. | This is fixed. | | WSP-1148 | The system displayed an “invalid record” error for certain tax codes when users attempted to update an existing template’s Tax G/L on the G/L Import Entry form. (This behavior existed for all states and when the Overwrite Existing Account Codes field was either enabled or disabled.) > Note: Note: This issue did not occur when users updated the Tax G/L accounts directly on the G/L Setup form. | This is fixed. | ========================================================================

Payroll Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/MR202501/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_MR202501.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/MR202501/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_MR202501.htm

Payroll Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-16299 The system displayed a warning that there was a duplicate holiday date when users clicked Tab in the Holiday Date field on the Payroll Holidays form to add a new date. This is fixed.
PD-17620 The system did not display a warning when users entered Hours Paid in a Detail or Summary Time Sheet Entry for an absence pay code that exceeded the value entered in the Maximum Hours That Can Be Used in a Block field on the PTO Benefit Plans form. The following warning now displays and the system removes the entered hours if you exceed the maximum hours, “Maximum number of hours for this leave cannot be greater than .”
PD-18104 The system did not use the higher overtime rate calculation based on the employee’s prevailing wage or the employee’s rate when importing pay with the OTPREVAILINGWAGE custom feature code enabled. > Note: Note: This scenario did not apply during manual pay imports. This is fixed.
PD-18278 The system did not allow users to assign deduction codes to a percent of earnings calculation method in the Deduction Codes form. A new option, % of Earnings, now displays in the Calculation Method field so users can apply deductions codes to this calculation method.
PD-18340 When users deleted a column from the Unbundled Billing Rules Import file and subsequent columns in the file did not contain any data, the system did not import the billing rule (as expected) but no error report displayed and the Transaction Report recorded that it was saved. The Transaction Report records that the billing rule was skipped and creates an error report.
PD-18343 When pay codes included the Round to Period Pay if Salaried Employee option set in the Pay Codes form, the Time Sheet Report did not include the rounded values during payroll processing. This is fixed.
PD-18519 When users set up suppression on an Employer FUTA while importing in the Check History Import form, the system incorrectly generated vouchers with pre-tax deductions for Employer FUTA for employees with pre-tax deductions. When suppressing Employer FUTA during an import in the Check History Import form and the import file includes employee pre-tax deductions, the system prevents the calculation of any employee 00-17 tax entries for all employees, including those with pre-tax deductions.
PD-18628 The system displayed an error message when users ran the Pay Schedule Report for a 2025 pay schedule set to the pay period of Monthly (find last occurrence of day of week in month). (No error message displayed when users ran the report for a 2024 pay schedule set to Monthly.) This is fixed.
RRT-5810 The system changed an employee’s default hours to zero (0) on the timesheet after users updated an employee’s tax withholding form in the Employee Portal when the payroll was in the Payroll Calculation Ready state. This is fixed.
RRT-6092 Users were unable to void a converted check while reversing an employee voucher in the Employee Payroll Voucher Reversal form even though they acknowledged it as a converted check and that no billing would be generated. This is fixed.
WSP-772 The Pay Group fields remained on the Payroll Approval form after users submitted an approval. This is fixed.
WSP-1070 The system displayed validation errors in the Payroll Validation Report for benefit plans that had the One Month Prepay field selected on the Benefit Plan Setup form, but the Require Prepay Benefit Account No. field was not set on the System Parameters form. This is fixed.
WSP-1108 The system updated the Last Pay Period Hours field on a timesheet even though the employee termination process failed for an employee with a type that did not allow for termination. This is fixed.
WSP-1124 Users could not close the Recalculate Tax on Vouchers History form by clicking the Close button. Instead, they had to click the “X” button in the form to close it. Additionally, after closing the Recalculate Tax on Vouchers History form the Reporting Entity field no longer displayed any options, so users were unable to use this form until they cleared it by clicking Cancel. This is fixed.
WSP-1149 The system did not display a message in the table on the Confirm Pending Reversal Global form after the process finished running but there were no records to display when users entered dates and selected Find Employees. A message now displays, “No records found.”
WSP-1294 The system was previously updated to prohibit adjusting more than one school district at a time on the Tax Adjustment Import form, but this validation was never implemented. The system now validates that users can only adjust one school district at a time and displays an error message if they try to adjust more than one at a time.

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/MR202502/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_MR202502.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/MR202502/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_MR202502.htm

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-18836 The system did not display a warning message when users selected the Prior Year Accrual option in the Trigger Method field on the PTO Register Types form and saved the record. In this scenario a warning message now displays, “Warning: This trigger method will only work with linked accruals.”
RRT-6114 When users selected External W-2 Benefit Import from the W-2 Processing\ W-2 Processes menu an error message displayed, “Cannot find the data file in the IMPORT.DATA directory. This is fixed.
RRT-6128 When users made a future-dated position change for employees, the system pulled the change into the timesheet when processing a pay import. This is fixed.
RRT-6142 The system displayed the “Please wait” message when users tried to generate the PEO Client Accounting G/L Detail Report, which prevented them from running this report. This is fixed.
RRT-6168 The system did not populate the Prenote Date on the Deposit tab in the Employee Details form after users added a Direct Deposit in Employee Portal. This is fixed.
WSP-1076 Users were unable to view employee details after selecting the Employees Assigned To option on the Actions menu in several forms because the links that displayed in the Employee ID column were not accessible. This is fixed.

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/MR202502/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_MR202502.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/MR202502/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_MR202502.htm

Payroll Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-15126 When users entered a negative tax adjustment for an Employer Paid tax in the Tax Adjustments form with the Corporate option selected as the Product Version, the Accounting tab on the adjustment voucher displayed two debits instead of a debit and a credit. This is fixed.
PD-18944 When users enabled the Round to Period Pay If Salaried Employee field on the Pay Codes form for the pay code listed on the timesheet, the system displayed negative or incorrect amounts in the Time Sheet Report for some of the salaried employees listed under the flagged codes. > Note: Note: The vouchers displayed the correct amounts. This is fixed.
WSP-1189 Users who were logged in as a service provider with Full access to the SuperBatch form but were not the assigned payroll processor were unable access the user ID/name of users with the Payroll Processor (Print/Mail) Account Management Role who had active payrolls to print when using the Payroll Processor option on the Superbatch form. This is fixed.
WSP-1340 The system validated the Client Accounting template setup for Deduction Codes that did not have a Rebate Bill Code configured on the Deduction Codes form when users ran the Payroll Validation Report, which produced false errors. If there is no Rebate Bill Code for the Deduction Code, the system now skips validating the accounting in the client template when users run the Payroll Validation Report.

General Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/QR202503/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_QR202503.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/QR202503/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_QR202503.htm

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-17700 An error message displayed asking users to save changes when they accessed the Benefits or Payroll tab on the Client Details form and then clicked the Client Status icon on the Detail tab, but no changes were made. The error message now displays as “Updates have been made to Client Details which can include system default values for new fields added to the form.” Users must save updates in the Client Details form before they are allowed to change the Client Status.
PD-18065 When an employee record had an associated Manager listed on the Work tab in the Employee Details form, the system displayed information from the Manager’s employee record in the Local Tax Filings panel on the non-manager’s Tax tab. (This continued occurring even when users attempted to clear the rows in the Local Tax Filings panel.) This is fixed.
PD-18067 When users clicked the edit icon for the line description in the Billing Formats form that did not already have an associated bill code, the system displayed a dialog box, “There are no bill codes for this item. Please select a bill code.” However, after they tried to sort by the bill code or description, the system displayed an error. This is fixed.
PD-18108 Selecting the Division Code field in the Divisions form displayed obsolete codes in the selector list when the Obsolete field was set to No and users sorted that list. This is fixed.
PD-18113 When users ran ACH processing for a payroll where the ACH Originator Third Party Download was set to Wells Fargo and the PC File Name field contained an entry, the system produced an ACH file for download that still reflected the naming convention that used the PRISM placeholder value of the configured PC filename value (that is, PRISM_….txt). The system now produces an ACH file for download that contains the PC filename used in the ACH Originator configuration.
PD-18444 When configuring a user in the Users form, if users entered an employee ID prior to selecting the User Type as a Worksite Trusted Advisor, the system changed the Employee ID field to a read-only field. However, the employee ID remained in the field and the user record was saved with the employee linked to the worksite trusted advisor. After selecting the Worksite Trusted Advisor as the User Type, the system clears any value entered in the Employee ID field and changes that field to a read-only (non-selectable) field.
PD-18457 When users posted cash receipts in the Cash Receipts Import form, the system ignored the Bank ID values on each row and only read the first Bank ID in the import file, which resulted in inaccurate cash postings as well as downstream impacts on the G/L related to using the incorrect bank account used for postings. When posting cash receipts using the Cash Receipts Import form, the system posts all rows to the bank account identified in the Bank ID column of the first row in the import. In addition, text now displays on the Cash Receipts Import form, “This import does not support multiple Bank IDs. The Bank ID in the first row of the import file will be used for all cash receipts in the import file.”
PD-18492 Users were able to enter more than the maximum number of bank accounts allowed for an employee’s direct deposit on the Deposits tab in the Employee Details form. An error now displays in this scenario, “Employee has Active Bank Accounts, the Maximum Allowed is .”
PD-18556 The system accrued PTO for an employee on an Arrearage voucher when the Accrue on Arrears field was disabled and the Calculation Basis field was set to Flat Amount on the PTO Benefit Plans form. This is fixed.
PD-18637 When the Mobile Phone field on the New Hire form was set to required for Standard New Hires and the HOME.PHONE2 column in the import file was empty, the system populated the HOME.PHONE.2 column with the Employer ID. If users then tried to manually update the mobile phone number, the system displayed an error message during a New Employee Import. The result was that the column header in the Import Corrections Step displayed HOME.PHONE.2, but the Prism-Expanded template used for the import displayed HOME.PHONE2 (no second decimal point). In this scenario, users can now enter a valid mobile phone number. In addition, the system now displays HOME.PHONE2 in the column header in the Import Corrections Step.
PD-18644 The system displayed an error message when users ran the Employee Total Compensation Report for Benefit Plans that were added to the Total Compensation Report Setup form in the seventh or eighth columns in the Benefit Plan Allocation panel. The Employee Total Compensation Report now displays the code information added in the seventh or eighth columns.
PD-18744 The Number of Hours values on the File Audit form, which are accessed by selecting Audit on the Actions menu in the Auto Holiday Pay Rule Maintenance form, did not display a decimal point. This is fixed.
PD-18788 The wrong selector displayed when users selected the Candidates option on the Actions menu in the New Hire form. This is fixed.
PD-19074 When a backdated leave request was submitted for multiple days, the system created the voucher as expected but only the first date of the date range displayed as Paid. (The other dates did display the backdated leave requests and the planned time off requests did display the leave request as Approved, but not Paid.) When users submit a backdated leave request for multiple days, the following now occurs: - The planned time off requests display the date range as Paid and the system applies the voucher to all dates in the range. - The system does not display the dates that were processed for backdated leave requests.
  • The planned time off requests display the date range as Paid and the system applies the voucher to all dates in the range.
  • The system does not display the dates that were processed for backdated leave requests. | PP-1600 | When an employee made a change to a user role, the User Role Audit did not display the specific process ID that was changed. | This is fixed. | | PP-1715 | When a user uploaded a file on the Batch Payments form, the form did not generate a timestamp record on the Process Control Dashboard. | This is fixed. | | PP-1719 | When a user searched for an employee record by the employee number on the Employer Quarterly SUTA Tax Export form, the search returned incorrect results. | This is fixed. | | PP-1781 | When a user ran the Certified Payroll Report, the report did not generate a timestamp record on the Process Control Dashboard. | This is fixed. | | PP-1796 | When a user made a change to the Employee Details form, the user was incorrectly listed as having changed the employee’s ACH information. | This is fixed. | | PP-1799 | When a user searched for vouchers and changed the pay years on the Payroll Vouchers form, the search resulted in slowed performance. | This is fixed. | | PP-1831 | Future-dated employee changes where showing in the audit logs showing the user “dailyprod_svc” as having made the changes. | This is fixed. | ========================================================================

Payroll Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/QR202503/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_QR202503.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/QR202503/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_QR202503.htm

Payroll Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-17124 When the Payroll Allocation Report was sorted by Division and the Group by Employee ID field was enabled, the report output only included the hours and wages allocated to the employee’s home division. In addition, when the Group by Employee ID field was disabled, the report output included a column for the allocated divisions, and reported all divisions where the employee had allocated hours. When the Group by Employee ID field is enabled, all Primary Sort options now include all hours and wages for the employee in the report output, not just the ones allocated to their home department, division, and so on.
PD-17888 When users set the Status to One Time on a Scheduled Payment and the system calculated the payroll, the Gross Earnings, Taxes, Deductions, Net Pay, Check Amount, and Deposit Amount on the Payroll Summary form all displayed as 0.00, which was an incorrect amount. However, the Payroll Summary Report run from the Payroll Summary form displayed the correct amounts. This is fixed.
PD-17900 The system displayed the end of the timesheet incorrectly when columns were hidden on the timesheet and users moved between pages. This is fixed.
PD-17906 The system did not display the most current Minimum Wage rate on the State Rules in the Payroll Validation Report. This is fixed.
PD-17909 When users changed an employee’s employer and then attempted a tax adjustment import for their previous employer, the system generated an error message that the employee did not work for that employer. > Note: Note: This scenario does not apply to adjustments made using the Tax Adjustments form. This is fixed.
PD-17983 When users accessed the New Pay Rate Assignment form from the Time Sheet Entry form for an employee with a pending pay rate change and clicked the menu headers, the system incorrectly changed the value that displayed in the Hours column. > Note: Note: This was only a display issue because the correct REG and O/T hours displayed in the initialized voucher. This is fixed.
PD-17993 An extra column without any detail displayed in the XLS output for any Compact Report format in the Payroll Register Report. This is fixed.

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/R202504/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_R_202504.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/R202504/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_R_202504.htm

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-18796 If the Maximum Number of Bank Accounts Allowed field was set to blank/null in the Direct Deposit Form Settings form and users tried to save an employee record in the Employee Details form when the employee had no direct deposit information listed in the Deposit tab and they made an update or clicked Save, the system displayed an error message. PD-18821 The system used the payroll’s Period End Date as the “date” for the transfer of hours on the Employee PTO Register instead of using the Year End Date to match the date for the Carryover hours.   • The “annotation” on the accrual Employee PTO Register for the transfer of hours now includes the Year End Date.
  • During the transfer/carryover process, a “0.00” Hours Calculated entry does not display on the Balance register.

Payroll Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/R202504/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_R202504.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/R202504/Payroll/Fixes_Payroll_PrismHRP_R202504.htm

Payroll Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-18442 The system did not update Third Party Sick Pay voided adjustments in the Payroll Adjustments file when they were voided using the Employee Payroll Voucher Reversal form, so those voids were not included in the Third Party Sick Pay Report. These voided adjustments now display as a negative amount in the Third Party Sick Pay Report.
PD-18612 The system display ed an error and then terminated the session when users entered certain special characters, such as the left angle bracket (<), when they created a payroll note in the Payroll Notes form. > Note: Note: New hires entered manually were not affected by this scenario. The system now accepts all special characters when creating a payroll note in the Payroll Notes form.
PD-18859 When users updated the units in a detail timesheet using a unit pay code, the system incorrectly updated the entry in the Hours Worked field. This is fixed.
PD-19006 The system did not allow users to import stand-alone, miscellaneous charges using the Miscellaneous Invoices import template in the Data Import Tool when the bill code was not set up on a PEO Client accounting template even though it was set up on a related Global PEO accounting template. This is fixed.
PD-19223 The system displayed Admin Fees for ASO clients in the Payroll Check Journal Report. This is fixed.
PD-19255 The system did not save the second and subsequent entries in the Detail Time Sheet Entry form when an employee’s Pay Method was set to Variable Salary on the Pay tab in the Employee Details form. > Note: Note: This issue occurred when users entered a Pay Code that was marked as Variable Salary and another Pay Code that was not marked as Variable Salary. This is fixed.
RRT-6178 When there were multiple Flex account deductions on the voucher and the HSA deduction was not listed first, the system assigned the wrong G/L account to the HSA deduction. This is fixed.
RRT-6201 The system did not capture Employee Direct Deposit updates when the status changed during payroll calculation. This is fixed.
WSP-1326 The Payroll Delivery Sheet that had a Delivery Method override set up for the payroll on the Payroll Options form, which is accessible by selecting Options on the Payroll Control form, did not display the correct delivery message. Instead, the delivery message displayed the delivery Method selected on the Company Delivery Methods form, which is accessible by selecting Special Delivery on the Actions menu from the Payroll tab on the Client Details form. The system now displays the delivery message specified on the Payroll Options form.
WSP-1400 The system did not display the most current list of Payroll Processors with open payrolls in the SuperBatch form when users with an open session clicked the Refresh Batch Report and Filters/Settings icon, even when another user assigned a payroll to a Payroll Processor not previously listed in the filter list of Payroll Processors. If there is no Rebate Bill Code for the Deduction Code, the system now skips validating the accounting in the client template when users run the Payroll Validation Report.
WSP-1527 The system displayed an error message about a missing post-tax deduction code when users ran a payroll for an employee with post-tax deductions related to benefits enrollment, even though the configuration correctly reflected the post-tax deduction code. This is fixed.
WSP-1785 The system did not display check counts correctly on the Payroll Delivery Page for payrolls that included a manual check. This is fixed.

General Fixes

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/R202505/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_R_202505.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/Fixes/2025/R202505/General/Fixes_General_PrismHRP_R_202505.htm

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-18822 The system included multiple checks for the same pay date into one value in the Summary and Detail versions of the Global Payroll Deduction by Date Report, but listed both checks. (This created issues with the XMLS download, which displayed one row per check with the total from the pay date.) The system now displays the amount associated with each check number in the Summary and Detail versions of the Global Payroll Deduction by Date Report, and its Excel version, regardless of the pay date.
PD-19219 When cash earnings were insufficient for all tax amounts, the system did not prioritize Federal Income Tax (FIT) over State Income Tax (SIT) when the Adjust Taxes to Cover Cash Shortfall field was set to Adjust taxes after deductions on the Payroll tab in the Client Details form. The system now prioritizes Federal Income Tax (FIT) over State Income Tax (SIT) when cash earnings are insufficient for all tax amounts, regardless of the Adjust Taxes to Cover Cash Shortfall setting.
PD-19404 The system did not complete the Direct Deposit Prenote in ACH text file or ACH detail report when the account was deactivated and then reactivated. This is fixed.
PD-19414 The system displayed an incorrect amount of Approved leave for the Leave Type in the Leave Approval form. This is fixed.
PP-1837 When a user attempted to save edits on the User Roles form, and the Role ID field was blank, an incorrect record with a User ID of ROLE was created. This is fixed. If the Role ID field is not valid, the record is not saved, and the system displays a message instructing the user to add a Role ID.
PP-1865 When a Service Provider performed a register rebuild for the Tax Register or Federal Tax Register on the Register Rebuilds form, the form experienced significant performance issues, and the rebuild ran for an extended period of time. This is fixed.
PP-1871 When a user deleted existing payroll batches and created a new batch, the Processing History form displayed the wrong User ID for the record of that action. This is fixed.
PP-1873 When a Service Provider used the Quarterly Tax Summary form with a large number of records, the form experienced significant performance issues. This is fixed.
PP-1874 When a user resized the browser on the Employer Details form in Prism, the entries listed in the State Tax ID Numbers section of the form disappeared. This is fixed.
PP-1877 When a user attempted to run the Worksite User Data Security Download, and at least one user record on the report had a large number of roles, the report did not run successfully. This is fixed.
PP-1881 When a user resized the browser with the Action menu displayed in Prism, the Action menu items disappeared and left a blank menu box. This is fixed.
RRT-6268 The system displayed an incorrect warning message when users saved an employee record in a specific way after making a change. This is fixed.
WSP-1727 The system did not calculate the Pending Adjustment Balances as expected when users made an update to a PTO Benefit Plan and ran the PTO Accrual Recalculation process. This is fixed.

PD-18809 When there were multiple payrolls to approve on the Payroll Approval form and users entered a different Payroll Number than the default payroll number that displayed, accessing the Gross-to-Net Register Report from this form displayed the default payroll number instead of the number they entered. The payroll number users enter on the Payroll Approval form now displays when they access the Gross-to-Net Register Report.
PD-19023 The system changed the MEMO-OFFSET Bill Code in the PEO Client Accounting form to an incorrect value when users regenerated PEO Client Accounting in the Regenerate Client Accounting form. This is fixed.
PD-19189 Users were able to add the Payroll Reports form as a favorite even though the Payroll Reports form cannot be directly accessed. The Add to Favorites option no longer displays on the Actions menu for the Payroll Reports form. In addition, you cannot add the HRPY.WORK*PAYROLL.REPORTS process ID to a user’s favorites or to the Template ID field on the Favorites Template Import form.
PD-19220 The system did not display the Charge Date on a voucher accessed on the Pay tab in the Payroll Voucher form when the Pay Code was set to the Per Diem calculation method. This is fixed.
PD-19412 The system did not display Employer Contribution amounts for employer taxes on the Payroll Check Journal Report when ASO clients were set up to not bill employer taxes. This is fixed.
PD-19427 The system did not display all initialized payrolls in the Payroll Variance Analysis form. Users can now review payrolls in the Payroll Variance Analysis form once they have been initialized and before they are sent for approval from SuperBatch.
WSP-1804 The system incorrectly displayed a penny ($0.01) variance in the Net Pay value in the Payroll Summary Report and the Payroll Summary form. This is fixed.

General Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
PD-18699 The system automatically enrolled rehires with a future dated rehire date into a leave plan using their last hire date as the benefit start date instead of their future dated rehire date when the Auto Enroll rules were set up to use the Rehire Date on the Rehire form. The system now automatically enrolls rehires with a future dated rehire date in a leave plan using their future rehire date as the benefit start date when the Auto Enroll rules are set up to use the Rehire Date on the Rehire form.
PD-18922 The system displayed employee amounts in the Employee Total Compensation Report for worksite managers and worksite trusted advisors who did not have access to employees due to data entity security restrictions. > Note: Note: They were unable to view employee information in this scenario. This is fixed.
PD-19416 The system did not recognize the Linked Accrual plan year for PTO taken by an employee when the plan year was set to Anniversary and the time off was taken during the Anniversary pay period. The system now follows these steps: 1. Deducts hours used in the plan year 2. Applies Carryover 3. Transfers Hours between plans 4. Accrues 5. Deducts hours used in the NEW plan year
  1. Deducts hours used in the plan year
  2. Applies Carryover
  3. Transfers Hours between plans
  4. Accrues
  5. PD-18915 When the payroll pay date occurred on a holiday on the first payroll of the year and the pay date was reverted to the prior year, if the payroll was recreated the deduction period changed to the new date instead of staying the same. This is fixed.

PD-19609 The system did not automatically enroll rehires with a future dated rehire date in a leave plan if the PTO Auto Enroll Rule used an Employment Type that matched the future Employment Type instead of their current Employment Type. PP-1464 When a user ran the Company Register Rebuild, the VOUCHER.XREF data was not properly cleared. This is fixed.

For example, “001234.567890 displayed as “1234.56789.” This is fixed.
PP-1996 When a user entered a number on certain fields on the Group Benefit Plans form, such as the Non-Taxable Limit field, then pressed Enter, the value was cleared. This is fixed.
RRT-6528 The system reported an incorrect Gross Wage amount for NC in the RT record in the NC SUTA tax export file when using the Employer Quarterly SUTA Tax Export form, which resulted in filing errors. The file now reports the gross taxable, net taxable, and excess wages correctly to allow filers to submit the NC SUTA export without error. > Note: Note: The Employer Quarterly SUTA Tax Export form for NC now correctly reports the RT record according to the specifications to include: - Positions 34-53, Total Gross Taxable Wages (Gross wages - sheltered wages) - Positions 54-73, Total Net Taxable Wages (currently correct) - Positions 74-93, zero fill (or gross taxable overlimit) - RF record positions 17 - 36 = Total of all RT records, positions 34 - 53, Gross Taxable Wages
  • Positions 34-53, Total Gross Taxable Wages (Gross wages - sheltered wages)
  • Positions 54-73, Total Net Taxable Wages (currently correct)
  • Positions 74-93, zero fill (or gross taxable overlimit)
  • RF record positions 17 - 36 = Total of all RT records, positions 34 - 53, Gross Taxable Wages | WSP-2601 | Users experienced long delays and sometimes timeouts while generating results for a large client using the ACH Journal Edits Audit Report and the ACH Journal Hold/Release Audit Report. | Users will now experience improved processing time when generating these reports. New Completed Payroll Notes Form

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/PD/Release-Notes/New-Features/2024/QR202403/Client/New_Completed_Payroll_Notes_Form_QR202403.htm Path: PD/Release-Notes/New-Features/2024/QR202403/Client/New_Completed_Payroll_Notes_Form_QR202403.htm

New Completed Payroll Notes Form

A new form, Completed Payroll Notes, is now available on the Client|Action menu. For example:

[Image: screenshot]

You can use the Completed Payroll Notes form to review or track previously entered notes that are marked as completed using a date range that occurs within one year.

To search for completed notes by the date they were entered, simply enter or select the Start Date and End Date, then click Submit. (If you are searching for completed notes using a date range greater than one day, it must be within one year.) For example, the following completed payroll notes display for the date range 11/28/2022 through 11/27/2023:

[Image: screenshot]

After the list displays, you can view an existing completed note by clicking the Ref #.

Note: Note the following when working with the Start Date and End Date:

  • You can only enter dates in date format, mm/dd/yyyy. An error message displays if you try to enter an invalid date, “A valid date is required.”

  • If you enter an end date before a start date an error message displays, “Must be a valid date range.”

  • The date range must be no greater than one year. If you enter an invalid date range an error message displays, “Date range entered must be within one year.”

  • The Submit button is disabled if you click it without entering a date range.

Adding the Completed Payroll Notes Form to User Roles

To begin using this new form, you must first add it to the user role(s). (Note: If you have more than one user role to add to this new form, use the Bulk Role Update instructions.)

To add this menu item to a user role, do the following:

  1. Click Back Office. Select User Roles from the System|Change menu.

  2. Select or enter the Role ID.

  3. Click Add. The User Role Maintenance form displays.

  4. Select Completed Payroll Notes from the list. (To quickly find this item, select Company in the Type Filter box.)

  5. Click Accept.

  6. Click Save.

To change the role’s access to Inquiry or Deny for this item (the default is Full), click the Access item (the access changes to Inquiry, click it again to change the access to Deny). Click Save.

To add this menu item to multiple user roles, do the following:

  1. Click Back Office. Select User Roles from the System|Change menu.

  2. Select Bulk Role Update from the Actions menu. The Bulk Role Update form opens.

  3. Click Form and then select HRPY.WORK*COMPLETED.PAYROLL.NOTES from the Search Processes list. (To quickly find this item, enter Completed Payroll Notes in the Form Description field and click Refine, then select the form that displays.)

  4. A list of user roles displays.

  5. Grant access to each user role in the Access column. You can grant full access (Full) or read-only access (Inquiry). To deny access, click Deny.

  6. Click Accept. The User Roles form displays.

  7. Click Save.

For more information, see the in‑product help or PrismHR Payroll Administration Guide.

[Image: screenshot]
