Benefits Administration (BA) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
WSP-1820 New Reporting Section on the Group Benefit Plans form On the Group Benefit Plans form, the fields related to reporting from different sections have been moved to the newly created Reporting section which is now available below the Carrier Code Maintenance section. This section displays for all insurance class plans. [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Configuring Reporting Options help topic.
WSP-2517, WSP-2674 Changes to the Benefit Plan Setup form When you select HSA Contribution in the Plan Class field on the Benefit Plan Setup form, then the Use Benefit Groups field is enabled. Additionally, under the Company HSA Contribution section a new drop-down option named Dollar Match has been added to the Contribution Calculation Method field. [Image: screenshot] When you select the Dollar Match drop-down option, the Contribution Applies To fields defaults to a read-only Contributing Employees Only option. Additionally, the conditional section displays with the header name HSA Dollar Match Contribution with a Maximum Contribution Amount field that you can edit. For more information, see Setting Up a Benefit Plan help topic.
WSP-2675 Changes to the Payroll Process logic When an employee is allocated to the Company’s HSA Contribution as Dollar Match, then during payroll processing, the system matches the same HSA contribution to the employee’s contribution. Note: If the Maximum Contribution Amount is set for Company HSA Contribution on the Benefit Plan Setup form, then the total company contributions in a Plan Year does not exceed the amount set in the Maximum Contribution Amount field. For more information, see the in-product help.
WSP-2583 Adding HSA Creation to Audit Log On the Benefit Plan Setup form, when you set an HSA benefit plan with Company HSA Contribution setup for All HDHP Employees and the Employee is enrolled in an HDHP medical plan, then on the Employee Flexible Spending Accounts form, when you click Audit under the Actions menu, new Flex Spending Account record is created and is also tracked in the audit log. [Image: screenshot] For more information, see the in-product help.
WSP-2695 Changes to the Retirement Plans form On the Retirement Plans form, when you update an existing Retirement Plan that have active enrollments, a warning message stating Critical Warning! This Retirement Plan has active employee enrollments and should not be updated. Making changes to the plan setup can cause serious changes or disruptions to the employee deferrals. Do you still wish to update this plan? is displayed while saving the form. For more information, see the in-product help.
WSP-2874 Functionality of Pre-tax Catchup to ROTH Catchup after 402(g) limit option for Deemed ROTH field Selecting the Pre-tax Catchup to ROTH Catchup after 402(g) limit option for the Deemed ROTH field on the Retirement Plans form signifies that Pretax catchup may be taken to the point when the 402G limit is met. Any further catchup must be taken as a ROTH catchup contribution. For example, if an employee is an Highly Paid Employee (HPE) for prior year, then pretax contributions must be limited to $23,500 with any remaining Catchup contributions taken as ROTH Catchup for the following year. [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Setting Up Basic Information for a Retirement Plan help topic.
WSP-2922 Changes to the Group Benefit Plans form When you select a Benefit Plan, then under the Age Parameters section, for the Age Calculation (Month/Day) field, the Day field is now a drop-down field and is conditionally displayed only when a valid Month (January-December) is selected. [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Configuring Age Parameters help topic.
WSP-3029 Changes to the Retirement Plans form After selecting a retirement Plan ID, when you navigate to the Deduction/Bill Code Overrides section, the checkbox for Prohibit Deductions is now selectable for the Employee Loan Deduction Code row. [Image: screenshot] Additionally, when the Employee Loan Deduction Code row is checked for prohibition, then on the Employee Retirement Loans form, when you set up a retirement loan, (Prohibited) text is displayed next to the plan name in the Retirement Plan drop-down options. Note: If a loan exists for a retirement plan with Prohibit Deductions checkbox flagged for the Employee Loan Deduction Code row, then while running a payroll, the system does not take the loan deductions. For more information, see Setting Up Deductions and Bill Codes Overrides help topic.
WSP-3074, WSP-3075, WSP-3088, WSP-3089 Changes to the Group Benefit Plans form When you select a Benefit Plan, then under the Other Processing Parameters section, the Pay Rate Month and Day field has now become an optional field. However, if you enter any value for the Month field, then the Day field becomes mandatory. [Image: screenshot] Under the Other Processing Parameters section, the earlier LTD/STD Based on Salary Instead of Coverage Amount field has been renamed to Premium Based on and is now a drop-down field. Additionally, the conditional field LTD/STD Salary Limit has also been renamed to Weekly Salary Limit/Monthly Salary Limit. [Image: screenshot] Note: Please note the following: If you select a benefit plan with Offer Type as Short Term Disability (STD), then the options in the Premium Based on drop-down field are: - Calculated Coverage - This is the default option. - Rate x Weekly Salary - When you select this option, the conditional field, Weekly Salary Limit is displayed. If you select a benefit plan with Offer Type as Long Term Disability (LTD), then the value in the Premium Based on drop-down are: - Calculated Coverage - This is the default option. - Rate x Monthly Salary - When you select this option, the conditional field, Monthly Salary Limit is displayed. When you select a benefit plan with Offer Type as Life Insurance, then under the Other Processing Parameters section, a new hyperlink named View Tax Rates is added next to the Non-taxable Limit field, which redirects you to Tax Rates for Taxable Life Coverage modal form. [Image: screenshot] After you select a benefit plan with Offer Type as Life Insurance, then under the Age Reduction Schedule, the earlier Reduce coverage and premium checkbox field has been renamed to Reduce and is now a drop-down field with the following options: - Coverage Only - Coverage and Premium [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Maintaining Group Benefit Plans help topic.
WSP-3124 Changes to the Client Benefit Plan Import form On the Client Benefit Plan Import form, two new optional columns have been added for Client Plan Renewal Month and Client Plan Renewal Day fields. The sample header file is also updated to include these two newly added fields. For more information, see the in-product help.

Compliance (CMP) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
CMP-6095 Changes to the W2 Error Report Previously, the W2 Error Report did not include a message if an employee had a negative amount for Social Security Tips during the W2 build. Now, the W2 Error Report will indicate when an employee has a ‘Negative amount of Social Security Tips’ during the W2, or W2c builds for both SBEA and Non-SBEA clients. The FormW-2 will not be created and the NO FORM GENERATED column is indicated with an asterisk. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Employer Administration User Guide.
CMP-6913 Changes to the Deduction Codes form On this form, when you select the Deduction Type field as Voluntary, then under the Voluntary Classifications section, a new field named 403(b) Retirement appears as you can see from the screenshot below: [Image: screenshot] Now, you have a voluntary deduction type to support a 403(b) tax-sheltered annuity plan. The deduction amount will be exempt from Federal Withholding and resident State Withholding. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Payroll Administration and Processing User Guide.
CMP-6921 Changes to the Pay Codes form On this form, under the Processing Options section, a new field named Exclude from Qualified Tip Reporting has been added as you see from the screenshot below: [Image: screenshot] This field is unchecked by default. Check this field if you want to exclude the pay code from Qualified Tip Reporting. This field has no functionality within payroll processing, but it will be used in future recalculation and reporting options related to OBBBA. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Payroll Administration and Processing User Guide.
CMP-6974 Changes to the Update Employee W-2 Forms form Previously, on the Tax Deductions form, if for a redirected tax deduction code, the Form W2 Box 14 Override field was set to Include in Box 14, but the Box 14 Description Override field was blank, then on the Update Employee W-2 Forms form, under the Federal Form W-2 section, that tax was not included in the Other grid and was not included on the employee’s Form W-2. Now, under the same circumstances, on the Update Employee W-2 Forms form, under the Federal Form W-2 section, that redirected tax code will display under the Other grid. The Description field in the grid will use the Pay Stub Name (if available), otherwise it will use the Tax Description of that redirected tax code on the Tax Deductions form and will be included on the employee’s Form W-2. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Employer Administration User Guide.
CMP-7010 CMP-7032 Updates to EFW2 specifications Updates to EFW2C specifications The RE (Employer) record on the EFW2 files are updated to include: - Employer Contact Name: Positions 222 - 248 - Employer Contact Phone Number: Positions 249 - 263 (numerical characters only without dashes) - Employer email address: Positions 279 - 318 (symbols allowed) The RE (Employer) record on the EFW2C files are updated to include: - Employer Contact Name: Positions 228 - 254 - Employer Contact Phone Number: Positions 255 - 269 (numerical characters only without dashes) - Employer email address: Positions 285 - 324 (symbols allowed) For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Employer Administration User Guide.
- Employer Contact Name: Positions 222 - 248
- Employer Contact Phone Number: Positions 249 - 263 (numerical characters only without dashes)
- Employer email address: Positions 279 - 318 (symbols allowed)
- Employer Contact Name: Positions 228 - 254
- Employer Contact Phone Number: Positions 255 - 269 (numerical characters only without dashes)
- Employer email address: Positions 285 - 324 (symbols allowed)
CMP-7012 Flat Sum Bonus overtime for multiple pay codes The Flat Sum Bonus Overtime calculation logic has been updated to allow for multiple pay codes to be assigned to a single Flat Sum pay code. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Payroll Administration and Processing User Guide.

Employee Portal (EP) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
EP-1827 Update Employee Address from Employee Details Managers can now update an employee’s address using the Employee Details form. Simply click the Edit buttons in the Addresses section on the Personal Info tab to edit the Resident, Mailing, or W-2 addresses. Updating this information in Employee Portal also updates the corresponding Prism record. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-8578 Accessibility Enhancement for Skip to Content A new Skip to Content button has been added for users who can only access Employee Portal via a keyboard and need a way to skip over repetitive content. The Skip to Content button is hidden by default, but pressing the tab key for the first time on a form displays the Skip to Content button. Users can click this button to skip directly to the main content section of each form and directly to the first element in that section. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-9550 Job Candidate Information Synchronized with Prism When a job candidate has a Date of Birth and/or SSN and is hired via Employee Portal, this information is now updated on their corresponding New Hire record in Portal and passed to Prism. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-9637, EP-9720, EP-9721, EP-9727 Time Off Form Redesign The Time Off tab has undergone a redesign for both the employee’s My Time Off form and the manager’s My Employees Time Off tab. [Image: screenshot] The employee My Time Off tab now features an Overview tab, as well as separate tabs to view the details for each PTO plan. Current PTO requests display on the Planned tab, while past requests display on the History tab. Employees can submit PTO requests using the Request Time Off button. This button now displays a separate window, where all the PTO information can be added directly and easily. In addition, they can use the Estimate Time Off link to access a tool to estimate the amount of PTO they will have at another time. This design now matches the Time Off tab on the manager’s My Employees form. Managers can use this form to review and send PTO requests for their employees. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-9643, EP-9644, EP-9645, EP-9646 Improved HR Actions Modals The HR Actions available to managers have been enhanced with buttons to initiate the process that open a new window with additional information. For example, to rehire an employee, click the Start Rehire Process button. A new window displays, where you can enter all the employee’s required information in a clear and straightforward process. This process is now used for the Leave of Absence, Rehire, Return to Work, and Termination HR Actions. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-9694 Additional Filters for New Hire Dashboard The New Hire Dashboard can now be filtered by the Hire Date, Start Date, and Hired By fields. Managers can use these new filters to search for specific employees more easily. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-9709 Enhancement to the Time Off Calendar The Employee and Type options on the Time Off Calendar now always display, and cannot be deselected using the Columns button. These fields now always display to prevent any confusion using this calendar. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-9743, EP-9744 Standard Options for Gender and Pronoun Designations The Gender Designation field and Preferred Pronoun field now feature a standard list that matches the options available in Prism. These fields are now synchronized with Prism, allowing the standard options selected to update the corresponding record. However, custom options for these fields are no longer supported. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-9750 View Taxable Wages on Paystub Employees can now view their taxable wages directly on their paystub on the Pay History screen. The Taxable Wages column on the Taxes Withheld tab of the Pay History form now displays the total amount of their wages that were taxable, which can then be compared to the amount of taxes withheld. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-9882 New Dashboard Configuration Experience The Dashboard Configuration form in Prism has been redesigned to combine the Edit Content and Edit layout modes into one cohesive design. This mode is now in beta, and the old functionality is still available. [Image: screenshot] The new Dashboard Configuration experience allows Service Providers to change the content and layout of the dashboard simultaneously. Service Providers can add widgets, then resize and reposition these widgets while adding additional content without having to switch modes back and forth. In addition, widget content such as titles, data sources, and settings can be changed directly from this form. Changes to the Dashboard Configuration are saved automatically to provide a seamless experience setting up the dashboard. For more information, see the in-app help.

Identity and Access Management (IAM) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
IAM-2436 Enhancement to Authenticator App Name The authenticator app now displays the client name of the user’s organization instead of PrismHR Auth. For more information, see the in-app help.

Onboarding (OB) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
OBE-7544 Select Effective Date Calculation for Life Events Service Providers can now override the eligibility date for a Life Event on the Life Event Maintenance form. When Use Benefit Rule is selected in the Source of Effective Date field, select an option in the Eligibility Date Used From Override field to use this selection in place of the benefit rule’s eligibility date. Options for this field include: - 1st of Month after Calculated date - If Calculated is 1st of month, use that else next 1st of month - Calculated Eligibility Date For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-7881 Benefit Enrollment Reminder Message Template Service Providers can now set up a reminder message to be used for Benefits Enrollment reminders on the Message Templates form. Simply enter BEEMPLOYEEDASHBOARDREMINDER in the Message ID field to access and edit the message template for the Benefit Enrollment Employee Dashboard. When a service provider uses the Send Reminder action on the dashboard, the email message is automatically sent using this template. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9033 Generate Benefits Adjustments During Bulk Plan Termination When Service Providers conduct a bulk termination on the Terminate Benefit Plan form, the benefit adjustments are now generated automatically. This enhancement helps ensure that employees collect the full premium from their benefit plans after a bulk plan termination. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9034 Suppress Benefit Calculation During Bulk Termination Service Providers can now select an option to suppress the benefit adjustments calculation on the Terminate Benefit Plan form. Suspending this option during a bulk termination of benefit plans can increase performance and make the process more efficient. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9086 Send Reminder on Benefit Enrollment Plan Dashboard Service Providers can now use the Send Reminder action on the Benefit Enrollment Plan Dashboard to send reminders to employees to submit their benefit plan elections. This action uses the reminder message template set up on the new Message Templates feature for Benefits Enrollment. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9349 Updated I-9 Form The most recent version of the I-9 form, edition 01/20/25 with an expiration date of 05/31/2027, is now available. This version updates the language for work authorization in Section 1 and the descriptions of certain List B documents. This new form will be made available on 1/23/26. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9490 Gender Designation for Dependent Form Employees can now select a dependent’s gender using the Gender Designation field on the Edit Dependent form. This field displays as long as the Hide Gender Designation setting is not selected on the configuration template or client override. This information uses a standard list of options from Prism, and updating the Dependent form also updates the corresponding record in Prism. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9491 Preferred Pronoun for Dependent Form Employees can now select a dependent’s pronoun using the Pronoun field on the Edit Dependent form. This field displays as long as the Hide Pronoun setting is not selected on the configuration template or client override. This information uses a standard list of options from Prism, and updating the Dependent form also updates the corresponding record in Prism. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9508 Enhancement to Voluntary Coverage Amount When an employee accesses the Voluntary Benefit Summary form, the Coverage Amount for the employee now always displays. Previously, the coverage amount displayed based on the selection for the Include Employer Cost in Employee Self Service option on the configuration template. With this enhancement, employees can always view their coverage amount to verify their information on voluntary benefit plans. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9626 Select Primary Care Provider Validation Format Service Providers can now select a format for validating an employee’s Primary Care Provider on a Group Benefit Plan. [Image: screenshot] Select Edit on the PCP Validation Format field on the Online Enrollment form to access the Edit PCP Validation Format form, which can be used to define a format template to validate physician information. Instructions for this formatting are provided on the Edit PCP Validation Format form. For more information, see the in-app help.

Prism (PD) Enhancements

Ticket Category Description Summary Help Content
WSP-3003 Accounting Enhancement to Auto Check Reconciliation Load Form A new option, Escheated Check Import, is now available in the Bank Media Format field on the Auto Check Reconciliation Load form. For example: [Image: screenshot] You can use the Escheated Check Import option to import a list of payroll checks as “Escheated,” so you can efficiently and accurately update the status of multiple checks at once (imports will accept files with the .csv format). Note: After selecting Escheated Check Import, the system disables the Checking Account Number and Exclude Account # fields. For more information, see Importing Auto Reconciliation Data.
WSP-3030 Accounting Enhancement to Unreconcile a Check Form You can now reverse check reconciliation on a check that is in the S - Stale Dated Check status code, as this feature currently functions for checks in the R - Reconciled status code. (This feature is useful for correcting issues with inappropriately reconciled records.) For more information, see Reversing Check Reconciliation.
PD-19904 Billing Enhancement to Billing Rules (Bundled) Form Two new columns, Rule Start Date and Rule End Date, now display in the Existing Bundled Rules panel on the Billing Rules (Bundled) form. For example: [Image: screenshot] The Rule Start Date and Rule End Date columns display the date when the existing bundled rule begins and ends. For more information, see Using Bundled Billing Rules.
PD-17943 Client Enhancement to Invoices Form You can now access payroll voucher details directly on the Payroll Summary form by clicking the payroll number in the Payroll column on the Invoices form. For example: [Image: screenshot] > Note: Note the following: - Users whose user role is set to FULL for the Payroll Summary form can view and update payroll voucher details. - Users whose user role is set to INQUIRY for the Payroll Summary form can only view payroll voucher details. - Users whose user role is set to DENY for the Payroll Summary form and click a payroll number will view an error message, “User does not have access to this form.” For more information, see Reviewing Invoice Information.
PD-19603 and PD-20266 Client Enhancements to Custom Features Form The following enhancements are now available on the Custom Features form: - The VARSALMETHOD global custom feature code is now available as a client-level custom feature code, VARSALMETHOD-C, in the Select Available Feature Codes list. (You can access the Custom Features form by selecting Custom Features on the Actions menu in the Client Details form.) For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: Custom feature codes are only available for service providers. Enabling the VARSALMETHOD-C custom feature code displays the Variable Salary option in the Pay Method field on the PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance form. (You can access this form by clicking New Rule in the PTO Auto Enroll Rules form.) When enabled, the Variable Salary option lets you track the hours that salary-exempt employees actually work. - A new client-level custom feature code, BATCH-PAYMENTS-CHANGE-DEFAULTS-C, is now available in the Select Available Feature Codes list to allocate batch payments. For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: You must set the BATCH-PAYMENTS-CHANGE-DEFAULTS (system level) and BATCH-PAYMENTS-CHANGE-DEFAULTS-C (client level) custom feature codes to view the Edit Employee Details column on the Batch Payments form. For more information, see Specifying Client Custom Feature Codes and Entering Multiple Fixed, Pre-calculated Payments.
PD-20289 Client Enhancement to Client Details Form The Employee Numbers Used field, which displays in the New Hire/Employee Detail Controls panel on the Control tab in the Client Details form, now displays as Employee Number Required for EP NH. For example: [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Setting Client Control Parameters.
PD-20423 Client Enhancement to Auto Holiday Pay Form Previously, the FLSA Exempt? column name on the Auto Holiday Pay form was spelled incorrectly. This column name now displays correctly. For example: [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Adding Auto Holiday Pay.
WSP-2434, WSP-2435, WSP-2436, and WSP-2438 Client Enhancement to PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance Form Two new fields, Trigger Rule On and Archive existing register?, now display on the PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance form. (You can access this form by clicking New Rule in the PTO Auto Enroll Rules form.) For example: [Image: screenshot] These new fields do the following: - Trigger Rule On: Select an option to determine which event triggers the re-assessment of a rule. For example, when Trigger Rule On is set to Status/Type Change, the rule triggers during an employee status/type change process and, if criteria are met, the system enrolls that employee in the indicated plan. - Archive existing register?: Indicate whether to archive existing PTO registers when the rule is invoked based on the re-assessment of the rule. Note: You must select an option. Otherwise, an error message displays. Click OK to continue. For more information, see Specifying Time Off Auto-enroll Rules.
- You cannot use a rule trigger option more than once. If you try to reuse a trigger an error message displays, “Trigger already listed for this rule.” Click OK to continue. In addition, you can view existing PTO Auto-enrollment rules, but you cannot make any updates to them.
- Using future-dated status/type changes and position changes triggers a re-evaluation of the PTO auto-enroll rules and executes the enrollment based on the employee’s Status/Type Change or Position Change at the time the change takes effect.
- If the rule is set to archive the prior PTO Register:
- Any existing PTO Registers that share the same class as the PTO Register assigned to the affecting rule are archived.
- The system sends a notification about register archival to the user on the Status Type Change form.
- The system creates a new enrollment/register for the employee’s new plan.
- If the rule is not set to archive the prior PTO Register and no PTO Class conflicts exist with the employee’s existing register, the system creates a new enrollment/register for the employee’s new plan.
- If the rule is not set to archive the prior PTO Register and a PTO Class conflict exists, the system does not update the PTO Register and does not make any changes.
- If the change date matches or is prior to the system date and there are required approvals.
- If the change date is future-dated and there are required approvals.
- If the change date is future-dated and there are no required approvals.
- If the rule is set to archive the prior PTO Register:
- Any existing PTO Registers that share the same class as the PTO Register assigned to the affecting rule are archived.
- The system sends a notification about register archival to the user on the Position Change form.
- The system creates a new enrollment/register for the employee’s new plan.
- If the rule is not set to archive the prior PTO Register and no PTO Class conflicts exist with the employee’s existing register, the system creates a new enrollment/register for the employee’s new plan.
- If the rule is not set to archive the prior PTO Register and a PTO Class conflict exists, the system does not update the PTO Register and does not make any changes.
- If the change date matches or is prior to the system date and there are required approvals.
- If the change date is future-dated and there are required approvals.
- If the change date is future-dated and there are no required approvals.
WSP-2437 Client Enhancement to PTO Auto Enroll Rules Form The system now re-evaluates PTO auto-enroll rules and executes enrollments in the PTO Auto Enroll Rules form for current or past-dated Status/Type and Position changes that require approvals, which is helpful to users managing PTO enrollments. When an approval is approved for an applicable change, if the change date matches the system date or a prior date the following occurs: - If an employee meets the criteria for a rule and the rule is set to archive in the prior PTO Register, the system archives existing PTO Registers that share the same class as the PTO Register assigned to the affected rule. Note: In this scenario a message displays, “A type change has taken place that will archive this employee’s PTO plan.” - If an employee meets the criteria for a rule and the rule is not set to archive the prior PTO Register and no PTO Class conflicts exist with the employee’s existing register, the system creates a new enrollment/register for the employee’s new plan. - If an employee meets the criteria for a rule and the rule is not set to archive the prior PTO Register and a PTO Class conflict exists, the system does not update the PTO Register. - If an employee does not meet the criteria for any rule, the system does not update the PTO Register. > Note: Note the following: - If applicable, a new PTO Register enrollment occurs. - If archiving PTO Registers is configured, the system archives the PTO Register as part of the PTO re-enrollment process. - When a user approves an approval for a future-dated change, the system does not re-evaluate the PTO auto-enroll rule. For more information, see Specifying Time Off Auto-enroll Rules.
WSP-2489 Client Enhancement to PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Import Form In association with the new fields that display on the PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance form (see Enhancement to PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance Form), two new columns, Trigger Rule On and Archive Existing Register, now display in the import spreadsheet on the PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Import form. These new columns indicate the following: - Trigger Rule On: Determines which event triggers the re-assessment of a rule. For example, when Trigger Rule On is set to Status/Type Change in the PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance form, the rule triggers during an employee status/type change process and, if criteria are met, the system enrolls that employee in the indicated plan. - Archive Existing Register: Indicates whether to archive existing PTO registers when the rule is invoked based on the re-assessment of the rule. > Note: Note the following: - The system validates that the Trigger Rule On value is not used more than one time per rule. - The system reports the import status of the new fields in the Transaction Report along with any error messages. For more information, see Importing Time Off Auto-enrollment Rules.
- Trigger Rule On: Determines which event triggers the re-assessment of a rule. For example, when Trigger Rule On is set to Status/Type Change in the PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance form, the rule triggers during an employee status/type change process and, if criteria are met, the system enrolls that employee in the indicated plan.
- Archive Existing Register: Indicates whether to archive existing PTO registers when the rule is invoked based on the re-assessment of the rule.
- The system validates that the Trigger Rule On value is not used more than one time per rule.
- The system reports the import status of the new fields in the Transaction Report along with any error messages.
WSP-2829 Client Enhancement to PTO Benefit Plans Form The system now expires carryover expiration hours set in the PTO Benefit Plans form using year-end date functionality. Therefore, time off hours used after the expiration date do not count towards the carryover balance. (Previously, carryover expiration hours only expired when the system processed the payroll with the pay period start date included.) For more information, see Defining Time Off Plans.
PD-18333, PD-20426, and WSP-2917 Human Resources Enhancements to Employee Details Form The following enhancements are now available on the Employee Details form: - A new field, Contact if arrested/detained?, now displays in the Emergency Contact panel. For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: This enhancement was created in association with the new requirement for California employers, that as of March 2026, employers must allow employees to indicate whether an emergency contact should be notified if they are arrested or detained on their worksite. To ensure an employee’s emergency contact is contacted in case of an employee’s arrest/detainment on the worksite, select Yes in the Contact if arrested/detained? field. (The default is –Select–.) - The system now displays –Select– as the default option in the Non-Res Cert Filed field on the Tax tab when you create an employee. (Previously, the Non-Res Cert Filed field defaulted to No, resulting in users having to reset the option to –Select– to perform new employee imports.) For example: [Image: screenshot] With the default set to –Select– in the Non-Res Cert Filed field, you can now add the State Tax Non-Res Cert Filed field during a New Employee Import. - The display for all the Form I-9 ID Authority fields in the Employee Verification panel has been enhanced, so it’s easier to view manual entries. Specifically, these fields were enlarged and moved to the left side and the description was repositioned. For example: [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Maintaining an Employee’s Personal Information and Establishing Employee Tax Information.
PD-20280 Human Resources Enhancement to Employee Details and Employee Voucher Forms Information for the following fields on the Employee Details and Employee Voucher forms no longer displays after an employee is deidentified using the Inactive Data Deletion form: Deposit tab on Employee Details form: - Suppress Account Number Print - Pay Types to Deposit - DD Exclude Amt Banking tab on Employee Voucher form: - Bank Account - Check Number - Check Amount - ACH Check Account - Void Reason - Transit Number - Account Number - Status - Amount For more information, see Depositing All or Part of Employee’s Net Payment and Reviewing Banking Tab Details.
PD-20438 Human Resources Enhancement to Emergency Contact Report A new column, Contact If Arrested/Detained, now displays in the output after running the Emergency Contact Report. For example: [Image: screenshot] The Contact If Arrested/Detained column indicates whether the employee’s emergency contact will be contacted in case of the employee’s arrest/detainment on the worksite. (This option is set in the Contact if arrested/detained? field on the Personal tab in the Employee Details form.) For more information, see Emergency Contact Report.
WSP-3062 Human Resources Enhancement to Approvals Pending Form The system no longer cuts off long comments and now ignores carriage returns and wraps text that displays in the Comments field when you open a pending approval on the Approvals Pending form. For more information, see Working with Pending Approvals.
WSP-2839, WSP-2840, WSP-2841, WSP-2842, WSP-3162, and WSP-3163 New Employee Import Enhancement to New Employee Import Dashboard Six new options, Shift, Pay Group, Citizenship Status, I9 Identification Document, I9 Eligibility Document, and 2nd Form I-9 ID Document, are now available in the Table field on the Employee Import Code Translation Tables form, which you can access by selecting Code Translation Tables on the New Employee Import dashboard. For example: [Image: screenshot] These options do the following: - Shift: Set up a translation table for shift codes, so you can use this translation table to change the import file code to an accepted PrismHR code. - Pay Group: Set up a translation table for pay group codes, so you can use this translation table to change the import file code to an accepted PrismHR code. - Citizenship Status: Set up a translation table for citizenship status codes, so you can use this translation table to change the import file code to an accepted PrismHR code. - I9 Identification Document: Set up a translation table for I9 identification document status codes, so you can use this translation table to change the import file code to an accepted PrismHR code. - I9 Eligibility Document: Set up a translation table for I9 eligibility document status codes, so you can use this translation table to change the import file code to an accepted PrismHR code. - 2nd Form I-9 ID Document: Set up a translation table for 2nd form I-9 ID document status codes, so you can use this translation table to change the import file code to an accepted PrismHR code. For more information, see Managing Code Translations and Import Field Mappings.
PD-18969 Payroll Enhancement to Pay Period PTO Report Form The warning message that displays when you access the Pay Period PTO Report form now displays as follows: For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: This warning message helps remind users that they must run the most recent payroll to ensure the system posts accurate data in this report. For more information, see Pay Period Time Off Report.
PD-19014 Payroll Enhancement to Billing Voucher Detail Form The Project Phase now displays on the Client Accounting panel on the Billing Voucher DetailVoucher tab when Project Phase tracking is in use and Overtime hours are reported separately using the Premium Pay Code and the Double Time Premium Pay Code, which is set up in the FLSA Ruleset used by the client. Note: You can access the Voucher tab by selecting a Voucher on the Payroll Billing Summary form. After selecting the Voucher, the Billing Voucher Detail form displays. Expand the Client Accounting panel to view the information. For more information, see Voucher Tab and FLSA Ruleset.
PD-19024 and PD-19027 Payroll Enhancement to Time Sheet Audit Report Form The Time Sheet Audit Report form, which you can access by selecting Audit on the Actions menu in the Time Sheet Entry form, now displays the following updates: - Initial manual entries in a timesheet: When users enter hours for an employee (with no current timesheet hours), the Time Sheet Audit Report now reflects that change. - Auto-accept leaves: An auto-accept leave displays as made by the “Background Process” user instead of the first user who opened the timesheet when the auto-accept leave was created. - By column update: The user ID now displays in the By column instead of the user’s last name, first initial. - Tiime Sheet Imports: The user ID and time when a Time Sheet Import is processed now displays in the By and When columns. For example: [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Restoring Recently Changed Information.
PD-19596 Payroll Enhancement to Client Allocation Formats Form The Header Column that displays when you select Add Column and update header lines in the Client Allocation Formats form now reflects the correct value. (Previously, the system sometimes overwrote the prior column header when users added a new column to a client allocation format.) For more information, see Setting Client Allocation Formats.
PD-19681 Payroll Enhancement to Add Employees to Payroll Form A new link, Quick Load, now displays on the Add Employees to Payroll form. For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: You can access the Add Employees to Payroll form by selecting Add Employees to Payroll on the Actions menu in the Payroll Control form. Selecting Quick Load opens the new Regular Payroll Control Quick Load form, where you can add multiple employees to a pay group at once. (See New Regular Payroll Control Quick Load Form.) For more information, see Adding Employees to a Payroll.
PD-19999 and PD-20000 Payroll Enhancements to Pay Codes Form The following enhancements now reside on the Pay Codes form: - The Include in Variable Salary Pay field now displays in the Processing Options panel, regardless of whether the VARSALMETHOD custom feature code is enabled at the Global or Client level. For example: [Image: screenshot] You can enable the Include in Variable Salary Pay field to include the pay code in the employee’s Variable Salary pay. Note: The Unpaid Variable Salary Time field only displays when the Include in Variable Salary Pay field is enabled. - A new tool tip icon ( [Image: screenshot] ) now displays next to the Include in Variable Salary Pay field. Clicking the tool tip icon displays a message, “The VARSALMETHOD custom feature code must be enabled to use this option.” For more information, see Working with Pay Codes.
PD-20145 and PD-20407 Payroll Enhancement to Payments Pending Form New filters are now available on the Payments Pending form to help you narrow the search for payments you need to process. For example: [Image: screenshot] > Note: Note the following: - Select Find Payments to display the payments matching the selected criteria. - If you enter an invalid value for the Client ID, Multi Entity Group, or Cost Center, an error message displays. For example, “<XXX> is not a valid Client ID.” - > Note: Note the following when using the Multi-Entity Group filter: - These groups do not display for a client if the service provider does not have access to that client. - The name of the multi-entity group created in the Multi-Entity Groups form displays. - Note: If there is more than one multi-entity group, they display as listed in the Client Details form, which are truncated if necessary. For more information, see Listing Pending Payments.
PD-20248, PD-20250, and PD-20266 Payroll Enhancements to Batch Payments Form The following enhancements are now available on the Batch Payments form: - A new field, Recalculate Overtime, is now available, which is useful when you need overtime recalculated when the payroll is calculated. (Previously, you could only set this feature in the Payroll Options form.) For example: [Image: screenshot] > Note: Note the following: - Enabling this field automatically enables the Recalculate Overtime field on the Payroll Options form. - You can access the Payroll Options form by selecting Options on the Actions menu in the Payroll Control form after selecting a Payroll Number. - If the system cannot update the Recalculate Overtime field on the Payroll Options form an error message displays, “Recalculate Overtime cannot be updated for Payroll <number>.” - The Recalculate Overtime field does not display for payrolls set to the Regularly Scheduled payroll type on the Payroll Control form. - After saving the Batch Payments form: - If you do not enable Recalculate Overtime, the Recalculate Overtime field on the Payroll Options form is also not enabled in the Payroll Control record for the Batch Payments Payroll Number. - If you enable Recalculate Overtime, the Recalculate Overtime field on the Payroll Options form is also enabled in the Payroll Control record for the Batch Payments Payroll Number. - After enabling Recalculate Overtime a message displays, “The Recalculate Overtime checkbox on the Payroll Options form for Payroll Number <number> has been updated.” - Two new custom feature codes, BATCH-PAYMENTS-CHANGE-DEFAULTS (system level) and BATCH-PAYMENTS-CHANGE-DEFAULTS-C (client level), are now available to allocate batch payments. Note: If you do not set these custom feature codes at the system and client levels, the Edit Employee Details column does not display in the Batch Payments form. For more information, see Entering Multiple Fixed, Pre-calculated Payments.
PD-20331 Payroll Enhancement to SuperBatch Form The text “Wire transfer created” now displays when you cursor over the [Image: screenshot] icon in the SuperBatch form. For example: [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Using SuperBatch and Understanding the SuperBatch Status Icons.
PD-20338 Payroll Enhancement to Detail Time Sheet Entry Form The system now recognizes when the parameters for a Position are set to Service Provider for the User Access and the Hidden option is set to Yes on the Time Sheet tab in the Client Details form, so worksite managers and worksite trusted advisors are now unable to view or update an employee’s Position Code in the Detail Time Sheet Entry form. For more information, see Making Detail Time Sheet Entries.
PD-20368, WSP-3011, and WSP-3040 Payroll Enhancements to Payroll Options Form The following enhancements are now available on the Payroll Options form: - The status that you set for the Recalculate Overtime field on the now automatically displays on the Recalculate Overtime field on the Batch Payments form. For example, if you enable the Recalculate Overtime field on the Payroll Options form for a payroll and then enter or select that Payroll Number in the Batch Payments form, the Recalculate Overtime field displays as enabled after the data loads. Note: You can access the Payroll Options form by entering or selecting a Payroll Number in the Payroll Control form and then select Options from the Actions menu. - A new field, Force PTO Accruals, now displays, which you can enable to override standard PTO accrual functionality for payrolls that are not yet initialized and are set to the Manual or Special/Unscheduled payroll type on the Payroll Control form. For example: [Image: screenshot] - The system now displays the Special Message, which is set by enabling Deliver Message Override, with the correct line return formatting so the text that displays on the Delivery Sheet no longer appears jumbled within the message. For more information, see Setting Special Processing Options.
PD-20430 and PD-20431 Payroll Enhancements to Data Import Tool The following enhancements now reside in the Data Import Tool: - A new field, State Misc4 Rate, is now available on the State Tax Rates (SUTA) import template. For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: The system populates imported State Misc4 Rate information to the associated field that sets employer tax rates for tax codes 24-54 (Minnesota) on the State Tax Rates (SUTA) form. - A new field, State Misc4 Rate, is now available on the State Tax Bill Rates (SUTA) import template. For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: The system populates imported State Misc4 Rate information to the associated field that sets employer tax rates for tax codes 24-54 (Minnesota) on the State Tax Bill Rates (SUTA) form. For more information, see Importing State Tax Bill Rates (SUTA).
WSP-2905 and WSP-3020 Payroll Enhancements to Payroll Check Register Form The following enhancements are now available on the Payroll Check Register form: - A new status code, S - Stale Dated Check, now displays. For example: [Image: screenshot] The Stale Check Reconciliation process now recognizes this new S - Stale Dated Check status code when you update checks as “stale” using the Stale Date and Stale By value. - A new field, Stale Dated?, now displays. For example: [Image: screenshot] The information that displays in the Stale Dated? field clearly identifies which payroll checks the system recognizes as “stale” (regardless of status code), so you can easily address outstanding check issues. For more information, see Viewing Payroll Check Register.
WSP-3051 and WSP-3052 Payroll Enhancement to Client Check Register Report Form Two new options, Escheated and Stale-dated, now display in the Check Status field on the Client Check Register Report form. For example: [Image: screenshot] These options do the following: - Escheated: The system recognizes unclaimed money in a deposit account or other property that is turned over to the state. - Stale-dated: The Stale Check Reconciliation process recognizes the S - Stale Dated Check status code when you update checks as “stale” using the Stale Date and Stale By value. (The system generates results only for checks with the indicated status code for the given time period.) Note: This enhancement does not alter previously stale-dated records in the client’s databases. (Payroll check registers stale-dated prior to this enhancement will still use status code R, but will display Stale dated = Y.) In association with these new options, a new field, Include Stale-dated Checks, now displays when you select the Reconciled option in the Check Status field. For example: [Image: screenshot] You can enable Include Stale-dated Checks to include stale-dated checks when you run a reconciled check report. For more information, see Client Check Register Report.
PD-19409 PTO Enhancement to Add Time Off Type Form The Delete button no longer displays on the Add Time Off Type form, which is part of the Time Off Setup Workflow process. For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: The Delete button isn’t necessary because you cannot delete an existingTime Off Type Code. (If you need to update an existing type, click the pencil icon ( [Image: screenshot] ).) For more information, see Setting Time Off Plan Type.
PD-20212 PTO Enhancement to Confirmation Form When there are no First Year prorated amounts, the message that displays in the Accrual field in the Plans panel on the Confirmation form, which is step 3 in the Time Off Workflow Setup process, was updated to provide more clarity, “The plan has <number of rows in multi-value grid> seniority tiers and does not have prorated amounts for the first year.” For example: [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Confirming Time Off Plan Settings.
PD-20214 PTO Enhancement to Time Off Setup Workflow Form A link to proceed to the time off plan’s current step now displays in the Status column on the Time Off Setup Workflow form. For example: [Image: screenshot] Clicking a link in the Status column proceeds to the step in the Time Off Setup Workflow process based on the plan’s setup progress: - If the user is on step 1, proceeds to the Time Off Type form. - If the user is on step 2, proceeds to the Accrual Schedule panel on the Set Up Plans form. - If the user is on step 3, proceeds to the Confirmation form. For more information, see Setting Up Time Off Plans.
WSP-3069 PTO Enhancement to PTO Accrual Recalculation Form A new note now displays on the PTO Accrual Recalculation form. For example: [Image: screenshot] This note warns that using the accrual recalculation tool might adversely impact employees who have forced PTO accrual on manual or special batches, so you can make an informed decision on whether to use this tool. Important! At this time, the note is a preparatory warning because the system functionality to force PTO accruals on manual or special payrolls will be included in a future release. For more information, see Recalculating Time Off Accruals.
PD-18101 System Enhancement to PTO Absence Codes and Time Off Setup Workflow Forms Previously, an issue occurred when an employee was enrolled in two registers and an absence code was not set up correctly, but the employee had leave on a timesheet for a different PTO Register with an absence code that was setup correctly. To resolve this issue, enhancements were made in the following scenarios, so users cannot save entries on the PTO Absence Codes form or proceed to step 3, Confirmation, in the Time Off Setup Workflow process, as confirmed by the error message that displays: - When the Leave Pay Code entered on the PTO Absence Codes form or Portal Configuration in the Time Off Setup Workflow process is the same as a Leave Offset Pay Code for a different absence code (different forms) an error message now displays, “Leave Pay Code PAYCODE is already used for a Leave Offset Pay Code. Use a different Leave Pay Code or update the Leave Offset Pay Code for PTO Absence Code ABSENCE CODE.” - When the Leave Offset Pay Code entered on the PTO Absence Codes form or Portal Configuration in the Time Off Setup Workflow process is the same as the Leave Pay Code for a different absence code (different forms) an error message now displays, “Leave Offset Pay Code PAYCODE is already used for a Leave Pay Code. Use a different Leave Pay Code or update the Leave Offset Pay Code for PTO Absence Code ABSENCE CODE.” - When the Leave Pay Code entered in the PTO Absence Codes form or Portal Configuration in the Time Off Setup Workflow process is the same as the Leave Offset Pay Code for the same absence code (same form) an error message now displays, “Leave Pay Code PAYCODE is already used for the Leave Offset Pay Code.” For more information, see Creating Time Off Absence Codes and Confirming Time Off Plan Settings.
PD-18439 System Enhancement to Role Maintenance Form The system now recognizes case structure when creating a new user role in the Role Maintenance form, which compares new role entries against existing roles. For example, you cannot create or copy the user role glsp if the user role GLSP already exists. If you try to create or copy a new user role using a different case structure of an existing role, an error message now displays. For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: You can access the Role Maintenance form by selecting New Role on the Actions menu in the User Roles form. For more information, see Creating a New Role.
PD-18854, PD-19685, and PD-20266 System Enhancements to System Parameters Form The following enhancements are now available on the System Parameters form: - A new field, Disallow On Demand Check Processing for Prior Year, now displays. For example: [Image: screenshot] Enabling the Disallow On Demand Check Processing for Prior Year field prevents users from processing an on-demand check from the previous year. When you enable this field and enter an on-demand check from the previous year in the Check Date field on the On Demand Check Processing form: - An error message displays, “You are unable to submit on-demand checks for the prior year.” - The Print Check and Calculate Totals buttons are disabled. However, when you enter a check date in the current year, these buttons are enabled. (Note that Print Check is disabled until the system finishes Calculate Totals.) - A new system-level custom feature code, BATCH-PAYMENTS-CHANGE-DEFAULTS, is now available on the Select Feature Code list to allocate batch payments. For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: You must set the BATCH-PAYMENTS-CHANGE-DEFAULTS (system level) and BATCH-PAYMENTS-CHANGE-DEFAULTS-C (client level) custom feature codes to view the Edit Employee Details column on the Batch Payments form. - The Feature Description for the ALLOWWMNEWHIREALTEMP custom feature code now displays as “Allow New Hire Alternate Employers for WS managers” in the Custom Feature Codes panel. (Previously, this description incorrectly displayed “Employees” instead of “Employers.”) For example: [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Setting General System Parameters and Using Custom Feature Codes.
PD-20022, PD-20023, and PD-20024 System Enhancement to Email Services Form A new email template type, Leave Approval, is now available on the Email Services form. For example: [Image: screenshot] You can use the Leave Approval template type to create an automatic email message that an employee’s leave is ready for approval. > Note: Note the following: - When an employee requests leave using Employee Portal (EP), the message is sent to the appropriate approver(s). - If the Leave Approval template type is not configured on the Email Services form but the HR Actions Approval template type is configured, the system uses the HR Actions Approval template type as the default message. - If neither of the Leave Approval or HR Actions Approval template types are configured on the Email Services form, the system uses the following default message instead: For example: [Image: screenshot] > Note: Note the following about the default message: - A new substitution variable, <<LEAVE.DATESANDHOURS>>, displays the leave date(s) and hours in the Leave Approval email notification in the MM/DD/YYY (N Hours) format. If there is more than one date, all dates and hours display. For example: HTML Content Type 10/07/2025 (8 Hours) 10/09/2025 (8 Hours) 10/10/2025 (8 Hours) TEXT Content Type 10/07/2025 (8 Hours) 10/09/2025 (8 Hours) 10/10/2025 (8 Hours) - When multiple leave dates are requested at the same time, all dates and hours display in the email. For more information, see Setting Up Automated Email Messages.
PD-20245 System Enhancement to User Roles Report Form A new field, Include Custom Process IDs, now displays on the User Roles Report form. For example: [Image: screenshot] Enabling Include Custom Process IDs includes all custom process IDs assigned to the User Roles on the report. For more information, see Determining User Role Details Display.
PP-2050 System Enhancement to Search Results Style The search results for the main Prism search bar have been updated to be consistent to other search styles throughout the software. For more information, see the in-app help.
WSP-2899 System Enhancement to Print Service Global Check Parameters Form A new field, Auto-Stale Date Checks After (Days), now displays on the Print Service Global Check Parameters form. For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: This feature is only available for service providers. You can use the Auto-Stale Date Checks After (Days) field to configure, at the system level, the number of days before the system automatically updates a Payroll Check to the status of Stale-Dated. For more information, see Setting Up Default Global Check Printing Parameters.

Fixes

Benefits Administration (BA) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
WSP-2921 Previously, on the Retirement Plan Enrollment form, under the Election Details section, when you deleted an Effective Date, the system deleted the prior records data available for employee contributions. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-2932 On the Benefit Plan Setup form, when you set a benefit plan for an employee with the One Month Prepay and the Auto Enrollment fields checked, then the system created Benefit Adjustments records, which was an incorrect behavior. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-2937 Previously, while using the Next Gen FSA/HSA Enrollment Posting Import Definition Template on the Benefits Import form, the importing of an election update caused the system to overwrite the Plan Year To Date Deductions and Funded Balance from one account to the other account on the Employee Flexible Spending Accounts form. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-2938 Previously, on Retirement Match Rules form, there was some confusion with the logic for calculation of Matching Contribution displayed on the employee’s payroll voucher. Now, this is fixed. A help text icon now displays explaining the Match Layers logic next to the Layered Match Rules section on the Retirement Match Rules form when the Match Logic Type is selected as Layered.
WSP-2997 Previously, the Retirement Plan Enrollment form had tab order issues. This is fixed. The tab order now flows through each section in the correct sequence. Additionally, the tab order does not go to the hyperlink form buttons of Import Retirement Plan Adjustments and View Employee Retirement Plan Register.
WSP-2998 Previously, on the Retirement Plan Enrollment form, the Effective Date under the Election Details section was not displayed when the browser was resized down. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3028 Previously, there were issues while importing benefit rules to a benefit group for specific plans that were added to the benefit groups. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3066 Previously, on the Group Benefit Plans form, when you expanded all the sections for a benefit plan and then tried creating a new plan, the sections remained expanded, which was an incorrect behavior. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3067 Previously, when an employee had an existing pre-tax retirement plan election and the Employee Deferral Deduction Code was flagged to Prohibit Deductions then while running a payroll, the payroll warning was not triggered. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3107 Previously, on the Benefit Adjustments form, the Benefit Plan ID changed while adjusting an existing benefit adjustment. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3142 Previously, when you entered a future dated Benefit Salary where current day was prior to the Benefit Salary change and the pay date was after the future dated Benefit Salary, then the payroll process did not automatically create a new coverage detail Effective Date. Additionally, for Benefits Enrollment, if the Open Enrollment effective date was equal to or after the future dated Benefit Salary, then the system displayed incorrect rates. However, if the current day was equal to or after the future dated Benefit Salary, the payroll process updated the existing coverage detail effective date with the correct coverage and premium amounts. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3257 Previously, on the Group Benefit Plans form, when you selected a Benefit Plan, then under the Age Parameters section, in the Age Calculation (Month/Day) field, when you selected non-Month/Day option, the system displayed an error message, which was an incorrect behavior. Now, this is fixed. The validation message is displayed only if you select a valid month (January-December) and do not select a Day against the selected month.

Compliance (CMP) Fixes

Ticket Issue Summary Resolution
CMP-3696 Previously, when an employee who was not a resident of the District Of Columbia submitted the D-4A Certificate of Nonresidence, it did not update the information on the Tax tab on the Employee Details form. Now, an employee who is not a resident of the District Of Columbia when submits a D-4A Certificate of Nonresidence in the District of Columbia, this information will populate in PrismHR both during onboarding as well as in Employee Portal.
CMP-4770 Previously, when Form W-2s were generated before tax adjustments were applied, then the Form W-2 had to be manually deleted because the Create W2 process did not update to zero. Now, previously created Form W-2s will update to zero when all taxable earnings and tax amounts are reduced to zero.
CMP-6203 Previously, PrismHR was not correctly recalculating billing taxes on vouchers for the Miscellaneous Taxes when the tax rate is less than, equal to, or greater than 1.00. Now, this is resolved.
CMP-6577 Previously, when an override rate was entered at the Employer or Client Level for PFML, it did not populate in the PTS file on the 210 records, positions 71-76 for CT, DC, MA and MN. Now, this is resolved.
CMP-6836 Previously, the system did not treat Group-Term Life Insurance wages as taxable for Detroit like any other Michigan local taxes. Now, Group-Term Life Insurance wages will be taxable for Detroit like any other Michigan local taxes under the following Michigan local tax codes: - 213630380-31 (Detroit City Income Tax) - 213630380-39 (Detroit Resident City Income Tax)

Also, if an invalid project is entered, upon tab or enter(or run), an error message will pop up stating Record [.] is not on file [PROJ.WORK.CODES]. | | CMP-6984 | Previously, in the Mastertax RTS Q4 616 record, only one tax code was reported instead of the combined amount of all tax codes reported in boxes 18-20 on the Form W-2 for New York City localities. | Now, this is resolved. | | CMP-6985 | Previously, when the custom feature code MCTAXCALC was enabled for a client on their Custom Features form, then the second and subsequent payrolls for the same pay period was failing for an employee who resided in a state that did not require a filing status. | Now, this is resolved. | | CMP-6987 | Previously, though the wage reporting for Delaware and Maine PFML on the MasterTax RTS was correct, however, the tax code configuration on the 500 records for these states were not updated to align with the structure used for other PFML reporting, such as Colorado and Massachusetts. Jira # Issue Summary Resolution

Employee Portal (EP) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-3044 When two or more employees were added to a payroll in Prism and a manager manually added their time using the Time Sheet Entry form in Portal, an error occurred when a service provider attempted to calculate the payroll and the Charge Date field would display as blank. This is fixed.
EERT-3080 When an employee viewed their benefits contributions in Employee Portal, the Limited FSA and Dependent Care FSA contributions did not always display correctly. This is fixed.
EERT-3123 When a manager accessed the View My Employees form in Employee Portal, sometimes employee names displayed as undefined, even though they displayed correctly on the home screen and employee records. This is fixed.
EP-3227 If an employee attempts to add a 100% account on the Direct Deposit form in Employee Portal and already had a Remainder account, the system produced an error message indicating that the accounts sum to greater than 100% and did not save the change. This message has been fixed to indicate that the employee cannot have a Remainder account record and another account with 100% at the same time.
EP-9545 When an employee changed their retirement contributions status to Inactive, the Retirement Summary form in Employee Portal still displayed their original retirement contribution amounts. This is fixed.
EP-9877 When a user viewed the Template History form for a Configuration Template, changes made on the new dashboard layout did not display on the audit log properly. This is fixed.
EP-9903 When a user attempted to access their documents, and no override or template had been assigned to their client, some document folders did not display correctly. This is fixed.

Identity and Access Management (IAM) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
IAM-2153 When a user had multiple profiles, including a Service Provider profile with an IP restriction, the user could not log in using their non-Service Provider profiles, even if the other profiles did not include an IP restriction. This is fixed.
IAM-2474 When an employee registered through Employee Portal, they would sometimes receive an empty error message. This is fixed.
IAM-2496 When an employee went through the Forgot Password process, typed in the verification code, and clicked the Verify Code button, next page in the process did not load, and the Forgot Password process could not be completed. This is fixed.

Onboarding (OB) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-2966 When the system generated I-9 reminder notification emails, the emails were sent in a single batch all at once instead of over a period of time. This is fixed.
EERT-2967 When a user clicked Get Employees on the Download Enrollment Statements form and no batch ID was selected, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EERT-3071 When an employee set their Preferred Language to Spanish, the Per Pay Period Amount on the Benefits Enrollment Confirmation Statement displayed the Per Month value instead of the Per Pay Period value. This is fixed.
EERT-3089 When employees reviewed onboarding documents, documents which did not belong to the client would erroneously display. This is fixed. When workflow is created, trace should display either formId and rulesetId, with passes result, or error message, or formId no rule and ‘Passes’.
EERT-3096 When an employee finished their I-9 record and the manager approved it, the status still displayed as Onboarding In Progress on certain forms. This is fixed.
EERT-3127 If an error occurred on the I-9 Section 1 form and the employee refreshed the page, the employee was erroneously given the option to continue. If they clicked Continue, the I-9 Section 2 form did not display properly. This is fixed.
EERT-3169 When a user made changes to a new hire record on the Client Details form, an invalid record would sometimes be created. This is fixed.
OBE-8456 When an employee elects the same FSA amount as was previously elected during a Life Event and also elects to enroll in a new Flexible Spending Account type, an error occurred. This is fixed.

Prism (PD) Fixes

Jira # Category Issue Summary Resolution
PD-19217 General The Tax Calculation Override link did not display on the Tax tab in the Employee Details form when there were Suppressed Taxes, but there were no Income Tax Overrides. The Tax Calculation Override link now displays when the employee has at least one record in the Suppress Taxes form or when the Income Tax Override has at least one active override.
PD-19238 General The system did not display the correct description of the Contact Type for the assigned contact in the Type field in the Contact Information panel on the Account tab in the Client Details form. This is fixed.
PD-19417 General When users enrolled an employee in a PTO Benefit Plan in the PTO Benefit Plans form with a calculation basis of Hours Worked (by Hours) or Hours Worked (by Months), a message displayed even when there was a value for Max per Year, “Warning: no additional hours will be accrued because the initial amount is equal to the maximum accrual of 0.00 hours set up in the PTO benefit plan.” The following now happens in these scenarios: - When enrolling an employee in a PTO Benefit Plan with a calculation basis of Hours Worked (by Months): – If the difference between the Benefit Start Date and Calculated Thru date is less than the initial “After Months” worked for Seniority Level 1 a warning message now displays, “Warning: no initial hours will be accrued because the time between the benefit start date and calculated thru date is less than the After Months required to begin accruing.” – If the difference between the Benefit Start Date and Calculated Thru date is not less than the initial After Months worked for Seniority Level 1, a warning message now displays, “Warning: no additional hours will be accrued because the initial amount is equal to the maximum accrual of N hours set up in the XXX benefit plan.” - When enrolling an employee in a PTO Benefit Plan with a calculation basis of Hours Worked (by Hours): – If the difference between the hours the employee has already worked from the Employee Payroll Register hours is less than the initial After Hours worked for Seniority Level 1, a warning message now displays, “Warning: no initial hours will be accrued because the employee has worked less hours than the After Hours required to begin accruing.”
PP-2072 General When a user performed a search in the Prism menu, the search did not return results that appeared in parentheses. For example, searching for “unbundled” would not return the Billing Rules (Unbundled) form. This is fixed.
PP-2101 General When a user accessed the demo version of the PrismHR UI, the background color of the home screen obscured the version number. This is fixed.
PP-2102 General When a user accessed the Actions menu on the Code Descriptions Overrides form, two options labeled “Audit” displayed. In addition, clicking either of these options without any audits selected on the form produced an error message. This is fixed.
PP-2117 General When a user had access to only one account, the Account Selection logo still displayed on the PrismHR menu. This is fixed. The logo is now transparent when the user has access to only one account.
PP-2125 General When a user had 0 messages or approvals, the Messages icon and the Approvals icon would show a red “0” notification on the PrismHR menu. This is fixed. When the user has zero messages or approvals, the corresponding icons do not display a red notification.
RRT-6666 General When users selected the Tiered Per Employee Per Pay Period option as the Unbundled Billing rule basis in the Billing Rules (Unbundled) form, the system did not count employees with a status classification of Active in the employee count to determine the Tier Level rate per employee. This is fixed.
WSP-1653 General When users navigated between clients while on the PTO Auto Enroll Rules form and then clicked New Rule, the system displayed the last-used existing rule instead of creating a new rule. In this scenario, clicking New Rule now opens the PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance form, which displays blank fields.
WSP-2906 General When users removed checks with the MVG “x” in a row while using the Stale Check Reconciliation form to load checks into the MVG, the system incorrectly updated the Checks Total calculation. The system now accurately reduces the Checks Total to reflect the total amount of the Check Amount column for all rows in the MVG when users remove rows from the Stale Check Reconciliation MVG.
WSP-2929 General The system sorted payroll numbers on the Batch Number (left-justified) by default on the Select Payroll Number list in the Benefits Billing Detail Report form. (The Select Payroll Number list displays when you select Payroll Number after choosing Select Batch ID in the Defined Ranges field.) The system now sorts payroll numbers by Pay Date, descending from most recent, by default in the Select Payroll Number list.
WSP-3128 General Users sometimes experienced long delays waiting for the system to generate results when they ran the ACH Journal Edits Audit Report and the ACH Journal Hold/Release Report. The ACH Journal Edits Audit Report and the ACH Journal Hold/Release Report now use an updated process, so they run more efficiently.
PD-19066 Payroll The system included empty columns in the XLS output produced by the Labor Distribution Report. This is fixed.
PD-19610 Payroll The system did not include the right angle bracket (>) in the STDMEMO column in the Global Accounting Custom Layout on the PEO Client Accounting and System Parameters forms. (When the file was created, the system populated this type with < instead of resolving to the standard name.) The following now happens: - STDMEMO data option populates as <> in the Custom Layout on the PEO Client Accounting and System Parameters forms. - < resolves to the correct entry when an External Journal posts and the system generates and regenerates PEO Client Accounting.
PD-20422 Payroll The system did not display the void reason on the adjustment voucher when a voucher with a direct deposit was reclassified using the Reclassify Direct Deposit form. This is fixed.
PD-20504 Payroll The system displayed an error message when users tried to import 2025 year records using the Tip OT Register import template in the Data Import Tool. Users can now import information in the Qualified Tips and Overtime form and create a 2025 year record using the Tip OT Register import template in the Data Import Tool.
WSP-2865 Payroll When users configured an ACH Maximum Global Approval Policy that exceeded the ACH Maximum Amount, the system did not enforce the approval policy during the initialization step. The system now enforces the approval policy during the initialization step and stops the payroll until the approval is processed.
WSP-3157 Payroll When users selected the Plan Comparison Data import template in the Data Import Tool and then selected an Offer Type, during import the system did not import the plan information on the Benefits Enrollment Plan Details form. This is fixed.

January (R_202601)

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/Release-Notes/2026/01/whatsnew-R_202601.htm Path: Release-Notes/2026/01/whatsnew-R_202601.htm

Welcome

PrismHR software is specifically designed to help Professional Employer Organizations (PEOs) and Administrative Services Organizations (ASOs) reduce risk, be more efficient, expand business, and be more profitable.

When you choose PrismHR, you are choosing more than just a software platform. You are partnering with a team of professionals who are deeply invested in the PEO and ASO industry and dedicated to providing the best technology and services possible. You are also partnering with other professionals in the industry in the sense that we all learn from each other.

To view release notes for PrismHR, click any of the links in the Table of Contents. Each release is represented with a book that features the month and year. Click these books to expand product names and version numbers for the release. The most recent documents are at the top of the list. Use the Search feature to look for a specific keyword or phrase. Open any PDFs for Download book to view and print release notes documents from the past year.

New Features

We would like to bring your attention to the following list of new features for PrismHR.

List of New Features

Click a link to display the detailed release notes for the new feature

  • Communication Hub Release Note PrismHR Communication Hub is a powerful, all-in-one messaging platform that enables Service Providers to communicate with employees through email, text (SMS), in-app messages, and push notifications—all from a single, unified interface. Built directly into the PrismHR platform, Communication Hub leverages employee data to create highly targeted recipient groups, allowing you to deliver smarter, more efficient communications. With built-in AI capabilities, Service Providers can quickly generate compelling message content and translate communications into multiple languages. This ensures communications are clear, inclusive, and impactful across diverse audiences. Whether you’re sending a company-wide announcement or a personalized text message, Communication Hub helps ensure the right message reaches the right people, at the right time, through the right channel. Communication Hub is available for all PrismHR accounts beginning with the January 2026 release. To help you get started, we have included links to several topics that you can find below:

  • Quick Start Guide

  • FAQs

  • Product Overview Video

  • Communication Hub Help Center

  • Regular Payroll Control Quick Load form: You can use the Regular Payroll Control Quick Load form to add employees to a regular (scheduled) payroll. (See New Regular Payroll Control Quick Load Form and Using Regular Payroll Control Quick Load.)
