CMP-7185 Change to the Quarterly Tax JSON Export In the Quarterly Tax JSON Export file, in the “YtdToDate” object, the “TotalTaxableWage” object has been renamed to “TotalTaxable”. Everything else, including functionality remains unchanged. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Employer Administration User Guide.
CMP-7196 Change to the PrismHR Tax Client Setup File Previously, both the standalone client setup and the periodic setup (with the Include PrismHR Tax Agency Export option selected) JSON export files always included AgencyInfo records for tax codes 00-10 (Federal Income Tax) and 00-17 (FUTA Employer) for all client report taxes, even when there were no tax liabilities. These AgencyInfo records are now omitted when there are no tax liabilities, which better reflects actual tax usage and simplifies client setup for clients whose taxes roll up to a PEO. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Employer Administration User Guide.
WSP-3389 Support Manual or Special Batches Before Regular Payroll in Garnishment Capping Previously, enhanced capping logic depended on a processed regular payroll batch to establish the pay period. As a result, garnishment deductions taken in manual/special batches run before the regular batch were not included when the regular payroll batch was processed later. This caused duplicate garnishment deductions within the same pay period. Enhanced garnishment capping now correctly includes manual and special payroll batches processed before the regular payroll in a pay period, preventing duplicate Child Support, Spousal Support, and State Tax Levy deductions when the Enhanced Garnishment Capping field is enabled on the System Parameters form. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Payroll Administration and Processing User Guide.

Employee Portal (EP) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
EP-8356, EP-8357 Automatically Populate Timesheet with Default Hours During the New Hire process, managers can now set an employee to have their time sheet automatically populated using default hours. To enable this option, select Auto Populate Default Hours on the New Hire Form. The Default Time Sheet Hours field displays, where the default hours to be automatically added to each time sheet can be set. These values correspond to the Auto Time Sheet and Default Time Sheet Hours in Prism. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-9886 Enhancement for Emergency Contact for California Compliance An additional option is now available for the Emergency Contact form to comply with California regulations. If an employee’s resident state or worksite location is in California, the employee can now select which contact(s) should be notified if they are arrested or detained at work. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-10012 New Dashboard Configuration Exits Beta The New Dashboard Configuration is no longer in beta, and the banner has been updated accordingly. Users can still switch between the new and legacy dashboard configurations using the option on the banner. For more information, see the in-app help.

Identity and Access Management (IAM) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
IAM-2409 Enhancement to Email Address Change When a user changes their email address for PrismONE, the Sign In Email field now updates immediately and displays as unverified. An email message is sent to the user at the new email address with a pin number to verify the email address the next time the user logs in. For more information, see the in-app help.
IAM-2536 Enhancement to Password Reset and MFA Security To increase security, users can no longer perform a password reset and set up multi-factor authentication in the same session. To perform a password reset, the user must already have MFA set up within the system. If a user without MFA information must reset their password, they must contact an administrator for a temporary password. For more information, see the in-app help.
IAM-2664 Security Enhancement for External Logins When a user logs in to the system through an external SSO, that user is blocked from using the PrismONE ID forms. For more information, see the in-app help.

Onboarding (OB) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
EERT-3160 Enhancement to HSA Employer Contribution Wording The wording for the HSA Employer Contribution during Benefits Enrollment has been updated to be consistent across all forms. For more information, see the in-app help.
EERT-3742 Enhancement to Metadata Editor The Benefits Enrollment Confirmations form has been enhanced with support for the User.Label metadata attribute for additional document integrations. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9784 Enhancement for Emergency Contact for California Compliance During the Onboarding process, an additional option is now available for emergency contacts to comply with California regulations. If an employee’s resident state or worksite location is in California, the employee can now select to notify the contact if they are arrested or detained at work. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9857 Additional Medical Offer Type A new offer type, Additional Medical (MDA), is now available for grouping together similar medical plans. This offer type allows Service Providers to group MDA benefits under one form. Employees can only select one plan for this offer type. A prebuilt Additional Medical form is now available in the Workflow Library, which can be copied into a Benefits Enrollment workflow to provide MDA benefits. > Note: Note: The Additional Medical offer type does not integrate with HSA options. For more information, see the in-app help.
OBE-9889 Enhancement to Decision Support Field The Decision Support field on the Control tab of the Client Details form is now set to Disabled by default if no previous changes by the client have been saved. If the client had made any changes to the field, the client’s saved value is retained. For more information, see the in-app help.

Prism (PD) Enhancements

Ticket Category Description Summary Help Content
WSP-3195 Client Enhancement to Positions Form A new field, Remote Position Classification, now displays on the Positions form. You can use the Remote Position Classification field to designate an alternative position classification for remote employees of the same position. > Note: Note the following: - Entering a valid Remote Position Classification displays the position’s FLSA Exempt, EEO Position Group, and EEO Position Class details, if they apply to the remote position. - Users with FULL access to the Positions form can use the Remote Position Classification field to designate an alternative position classification for remote employees of the same position. - Users with INQUIRY access to the Positions form can view the Remote Position Classification field, but cannot designate an alternative position classification for remote employees of the same position. For more information, see Defining Positions.
WSP-3196 Client Enhancement to Clone Client Form A new field, Retirement Plan Setup, now displays on the Clone Client form. You can enable the Retirement Plan Setup field when cloning a client to include the retirement plan Benefit Plan Setup information and Company Match Rules. (The default is enabled.) For more information, see Cloning a Client.
WSP-3197 Client Enhancement to the Clone/Copy Client Process When creating a new client or copying client setup records using the Clone Client or Copy Client Settings forms, you can now conditionally include or exclude the Retirement Plan Setup records. For example, if you enable the Company Benefits or Benefit Rules field and disable the Retirement Plan Setup field on the Copy Client Settings form, then during the client clone or copy client process, the system will not clone the following client configuration records: - The records available when you select Plan Class as Retirement or Employer Match on the Benefit Plan Setup form. - All the records available on the Retirement Match Rules form. However, if you enable the Retirement Plan Setup field, the system will include the retirement-related records during the clone process. For more information, see Cloning a Client and Copying Client Settings.
WSP-3201 Client Enhancement to Copy Client Settings Form A new field, Retirement Plan Setup, now displays on the Copy Client Settings form. You can enable the Retirement Plan Setup field when copying client settings to include the retirement plan Benefit Plan Setup information and Company Match Rules. (The default is enabled.) For more information, see Copying Client Settings.
WSP-3289 and WSP-3418 Client Enhancements to Client Details Form The following enhancements are now available: - A new field, Inactivation Reason, now displays on the Detail tab. This field displays the reason supplied when the client was inactivated. Note: This field only displays for Inactive clients. - A warning message now displays if you click Save without entering a client’s Federal Employer ID Number (FEIN) on the Tax tab in the Client Details form, “Client Tax Federal Employer ID Number is blank. Continue?” Click Yes to save updates to the form without supplying the FEIN. Note: Issues could occur later in this process if you do not provide the FEIN. For more information, see Maintaining Client Information and Setting Client Tax Parameters.
PD-20630 Employer Administration Enhancement to Employer Details Form The system now restricts creating an Employer ID in the Employer Details form that is a duplicate of an existing Employer ID but uses leading zeros. For example, you cannot create Employer ID 042 when Employer ID 42 already exists. Note: If you enter an existing Employer ID and include leading zeros in that ID an error message displays, “Employer IDs must be unique, excluding leading zeros. New Employer ID <new client ID> cannot be created because Employer ID <existing client ID> already exists.” For more information, see Setting Employer Details.
PD-15561 Human Resources Enhancement to Employee Termination Form If you try to terminate an employee who has a scheduled payment, a warning message now displays. For example: [Image: screenshot] Note: You can choose to continue the termination process or cease the process and return to the termination form. For more information, see Establishing Scheduled Payments and Terminating an Employee.
PD-17798 Human Resources Enhancement to Planned Time Off Requests Form Worksite managers and worksite trusted advisors with the PTO Administrator H/R Role can now view and approve leaves in the Planned Time Off Requests form for any employees who have access via Data Entity Security, not just those users where the WSM/WTA is listed as the PTO Approver for an employee. Important! The system circumvents leave approval security configurations and workflows for users with access to this form, which can result in unexpected behavior. Please note the following security used by this form: - Users with the PTO Administrator H/R Role and access to Manage Planned Time Off Requests can update leave for all employees in the client regardless of their Data Security access or the assigned PTO Approver. - Users without the PTO Administrator H/R Role and with access to Manage Planned Time Off Requests can update leave only for employees where the user has access via Data Security, regardless of the assigned PTO Approver. For more information, see Working with Planned Time Off Requests.
WSP-2983 Human Resources Enhancement to Employee Fields Import Form The system now enforces the standards of entry using the Employee Fields Import form, which allows you to assign PTO Approver and Manager users from clients other than the Client where the Employee record is located. For more information, see Performing Employee Fields Import.
WSP-3249 and WSP-3432 Human Resources Enhancements to Employee Details Form The following enhancements are now available: - When an employee is terminated and the If ACH, Turn Off ACH? field is enabled on the Employee Termination form, the system now sets all records for the employee’s direct deposit to inactive in the Employee Details form. - The W/C Class now reflects the appropriate W/C class based on the employee’s Remote Location, which is enabled on the Worksite Locations form, and their Remote Position Classification on the Positions form. > Note: Note the following: - If the Remote Location field is not enabled on the Worksite Locations form and there is no Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the standard Position Classification to determine the W/C class. - If the Remote Location field is not enabled on the Worksite Locations form but there is a Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the standard Position Classification to determine the W/C class. - If the Remote Location field is enabled on the Worksite Locations form and there is no Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the standard Position Classification to determine the W/C class. - If the Remote Location field is enabled on the Worksite Locations form and there is a Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the Remote Position Classification to determine the W/C class. In association with the enhancement detailed above, the system now uses the correct variable when determining the W/C state, which is based on the employee’s state of residence in the Employee Details form. The configuration includes setting the Calculation Options field to Resident State Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form and one of the following settings: - Tax Geocode Override Option field on the Other tab in the Employee Details form set to Override Work Geocode with Resident Geocode - Remote Location field enabled on the Worksite Locations form > Note: Note the following: - If the Calculation Options field is set to Resident State Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form and the Remote Location field is not enabled on the Worksite Locations form, where any option, except the Override Work Geocode with Resident Geocode option, is set in the Tax Geocode Override Option field on the Other tab in the Employee Details form, the system uses the Worksite WC State to determine the W/C state. - If the Calculation Options field is set to Resident State Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form and the Remote Location field is not enabled on the Worksite Locations form and the Override Work Geocode with Resident Geocode option is set in the Tax Geocode Override Option field on the Other tab in the Employee Details form, the system uses the Resident WC State to determine the W/C state. - If the Calculation Options field is set to Resident State Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form and the Remote Location field is enabled on the Worksite Locations form and the –Select– option is set in the Tax Geocode Override Option field on the Other tab in the Employee Details form, the system uses the Resident WC State to determine the W/C state. - If the Calculation Options field is set to Resident State Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form and the Remote Location field is enabled on the Worksite Locations form and the Override Work Geocode with Resident Geocode option is set in the Tax Geocode Override Option field on the Other tab in the Employee Details form, the system uses the Resident WC State to determine the W/C state. For more information, see Depositing All or Part of Employee’s Net Payment and Defining Employee Name and Contact Information.
WSP-3250 Human Resources Enhancement to Employee Master Report With the introduction of the Remote Position Classification field to designate an alternative position classification for remote employees of the same position, which is set on the Positions form (see Enhancement to Positions Form for more information), the Employee Master Report now displays this designation to ensure that the accurate W/C Class code displays when you run this report. For example: [Image: screenshot] > Note: Note the following that occurs in the Worksite Locations form: - If the Remote Location field is not enabled on the Worksite Locations form and there is no Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the standard Position Classification to determine the W/C class. - If the Remote Location field is not enabled on the Worksite Locations form but there is a Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the standard Position Classification to determine the W/C class. - If the Remote Location field is enabled on the Worksite Locations form and there is no Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the standard Position Classification to determine the W/C class. - If the Remote Location field is enabled on the Worksite Locations form and there is a Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the Remote Position Classification to determine the W/C class. > Note: Note the following that occurs in the Client Details form: - If the Calculation Options field is set to Resident State Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form and the Remote Location field is not enabled on the Worksite Locations form, where any option, except the Override Work Geocode with Resident Geocode option, is set in the Tax Geocode Override Option field on the Other tab in the Employee Details form, the system uses the Worksite WC State to determine the W/C state. - If the Calculation Options field is set to Resident State Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form and the Remote Location field is not enabled on the Worksite Locations form and the Override Work Geocode with Resident Geocode option is set in the Tax Geocode Override Option field on the Other tab in the Employee Details form, the system uses the Resident WC State to determine the W/C state. - If the Calculation Options field is set to Resident State Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form and the Remote Location field is enabled on the Worksite Locations form and the –Select– option is set in the Tax Geocode Override Option field on the Other tab in the Employee Details form, the system uses the Resident WC State to determine the W/C state. - If the Calculation Options field is set to Resident State Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form and the Remote Location field is enabled on the Worksite Locations form and the Override Work Geocode with Resident Geocode option is set in the Tax Geocode Override Option field on the Other tab in the Employee Details form, the system uses the Resident WC State to determine the W/C state. For more information, see Employee Master Report.
WSP-3258 Human Resources Enhancement to Approvals Pending Form You can now approve or deny approvals for the new Late Payroll Posting Approval Policy in the Approvals Pending form. (Users with FULL access to the Global Approval Policies and Approval Policies forms can configure a Late Payroll Posting approval policy at the global or client level by selecting this Approval Type.) > Note: Note the following: - When a Late Payroll Posting pending approval is approved: - The associated payroll batch status updates from POSTPEND > INITCOMP. - The Approval status is Approved. - Starting Payroll Finalization again after receiving the approval completes the finalization process without disruption, assuming there are no changes to the timesheet or recalculations have occurred in the payroll. - If you update the timesheet or recalculate the payroll, the approval must be resubmitted. - When a Late Payroll Posting pending approval is denied: - The associated payroll batch status updates from POSTPEND > INITCOMP. - The Approval status is Denied. - When you attempt Payroll Finalization again after the approval is denied, the system generates a new Late Payroll Posting Approval for the payroll. For more information, see Working with Pending Approvals.
WSP-3396 and WSP-3415 Human Resources Enhancement to Manage Pending Approvals Form Users with FULL access to the Manage Pending Approvals form can now do the following: - View and reassign pending ACH Maximum and Late Payroll Posting Approvals for the selected client. - Filter pending approvals for ACH Maximum and Late Payroll Posting Approvals. Users with INQUIRY access to the Manage Pending Approvals form are now restricted as follows: - Can only view pending ACH Maximum and Late Payroll Posting Approvals for the selected client. - Cannot filter the form results. Note: Worksite managers and worksite trusted advisors are now required to limit user access to approvals for only those employees/payrolls where they are granted appropriate security access. For more information, see Managing Pending Approvals.
PD-20232 Payroll Enhancement to Payroll Variance Analysis Dashboard The system now analyzes and updates the Payroll Variance Analysis dashboard when you enter or select a payroll number in the Compare to Payroll field that meets the following criteria: - The comparison Payroll Pay Date is within 180 days of the initialized Payroll. - The comparison Payroll Type is Regular or Special. - The comparison Payroll Number is a valid payroll. - The comparison Payroll is finalized. - The comparison Payroll includes the same Pay Group. For more information, see Payroll Variance Analysis.
PD-19660, PD-19778, and PD-20640 Payroll Enhancements to Data Import Tool The following enhancements are now available: - A new import template, Client Details (Tax), is now available. You can use the Client Details (Tax) import template to import taxes for the client into the state tax setup on the Client Details form at once to reduce the amount of manual work required. (This is helpful when maintaining tax IDs for various agencies.) - A new import template, Employee Benefits Per Hour, is now available. You can use the Employee Benefits Per Hour import template to import the employee benefits per hour at once to reduce the amount of manual work required. Important! This update does not display in the Benefits Per Hour field on the Pay tab in the Employee Details form. - A new field, Override Work Geocode, now resides on the Worksite Locations import template in column 36, and in the downloadable sample header file. You can indicate the Override Work GeoCode setting as appropriate: - Use Worksite Location GeoCode (no value) - Override with Resident GeoCode (R) - Override with Home Location GeoCode (H) - Override T/S GeoCode with Resident GeoCode (T) Note: The system only applies the override if there are no overrides set at the system, client, or employee level. Typically, this is used to create “worksite locations” for remote employees. For more information, see Importing Client Taxes, Importing Employee Benefits Per Hour, and Importing Worksite Locations.
WSP-970, WSP-1208, and WSP-1210 Payroll Enhancement to Global Approval Policies and Approval Policies Forms A new option, Late Payroll Posting, is now available as an Approval Type in the Global Approval Policies and Approval Policies forms. Selecting Late Payroll Posting stops payrolls from being posted on or after the ACH Late Payroll Posting date and time during the finalization process, which prevents the payroll from finalizing until it is approved by a user in accordance with the applicable Approval Policy configuration. (After selecting Late Payroll Posting, the system displays any existinglate payroll posting steps.) > Note: Note the following: - To stop a payroll from finalizing, the client must have ACH billing configured on the Billing tab on the Client Details form by selecting one of the following statuses in the ACH Status field, Active, ACH by Division, or ACH by Location. In addition, the approval observes the positive or negative value in the Adjust to ACH Bill Day field, which adjusts the processing of the ACH if it is different from the employee pay date. - Users with FULL access to the Global Approval Policies form can configure a Late Payroll Posting approval policy at the global level by selecting this Approval Type. - Users with INQUIRY access to the Global Approval Policies form can access existing Late Payroll Posting approval policies in read-only format using the Service Type and Approval Type but cannot update the policy setup. For more information, see Setting Global Approval Policies and Setting Approval Policies.
WSP-3063 Payroll Enhancement to Client Allocation Formats Form An error message now displays if you enter a duplicateAllocation Code in a client allocation format in any of the columns in the Report Columns panel in the Client Allocation Formats form. For example: [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Setting Global Approval Policies and Setting Approval Policies.
WSP-3251 Payroll Enhancement to Employee Voucher Form With the introduction of the Remote Position Classification field to designate an alternative position classification for remote employees of the same position, which is set on the Positions form (see Enhancement to Positions Formfor more information), the Workers Comp tab on the Employee Voucher form now displays this designation to ensure that the accurate Class Code displays. For example: [Image: screenshot] > Note: Note the following that occurs in the Worksite Locations form: - If the Remote Location field is not enabled on the Worksite Locations form and there is no Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the standard Position Classification to determine the W/C class. - If the Remote Location field is not enabled on the Worksite Locations form but there is a Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the standard Position Classification to determine the W/C class. - If the Remote Location field is enabled on the Worksite Locations form and there is no Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the standard Position Classification to determine the W/C class. - If the Remote Location field is enabled on the Worksite Locations form and there is a Remote Position Classification configured on the Positions form, the system uses the Remote Position Classification to determine the W/C class. > Note: Note the following that occurs in the Client Details form: - If the Calculation Options field is set to Select or Resident State Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form, the system recognizes the Remote Location field setting for the employee’s assigned Worksite Location set on the Work tab in the Employee Details form. - If the Calculation Options field is set to Time Sheet Location Based on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form, the system recognizes the Remote Location field setting for the employee’s time sheet detail entry/entries locations. For more information, see Reviewing Workers Comp Tab Details.
PP-1635 System Enhancement to CC File Storage CC.FILES older than seven years will be deleted from the system. Carriers will still retain copies of the files on their own storage devices.
PP-1668 System Enhancement to Approvals Dashboard Performance Improvements have been applied to the Approvals Dashboard to significantly improve performance, especially for clients with a large number of employees. For more information, see the in-product help.
PP-2148 System SSO Support for Employee Navigator An external SSO option has been added for integration for upcoming features. For more information, see the in-product help.
PP-2166 System Enhancement to Report Search When clients search for the PEO Client Accounting G/L Detail Report using the search function, only the proper report now displays in the Reports section of the results. Previously, another extraneous report displayed when performing the same search. For more information, see the in-product help.
PP-2173 System Enhancement to PrismONE ID Support Added support for PrismONE ID outbound SSO over OIDC. Please refer to the Establishing SSO Services help form for the table of values for this integration. For more information, see the in-product help.
WSP-3244 System Enhancement to Email Services Form A new email template type, Late Payroll Posting Approval, is now available on the Email Services form. Note: You can access the Email Services form by selecting Email Services in the Actions menu on the System Parameters form. You can use the Late Payroll Posting Approval template type to create an automatic email message that prevents s payroll from being posted on or after the Late Payroll Posting date and time during the finalization process, which prevents the payroll from finalizing until it is approved by a user in accordance with the applicable Approval Policy configuration. Note: Template types are maintained in the Message Templates form. In addition, a new standard message template, LATEPAYROLLPOST, is now available as the default for the Late Payroll Posting Approval template type by selecting Template, which displays the Search Message Templates list. In association with the new LATEPAYROLLPOST message template, the system uses four substitution variables, <<COMPANY.NAME>>, <<CLIENT.NAME>> (includes client ID), <<PAYROLL.NUMBER>>, and <<PAY.DATE>>, for billing purposes. For example: [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Setting Up Automated Email Messages.
WSP-3287 System Enhancement to Client Status Change Form A new (required) field, Client Inactivation Reason, now displays in the Client Status Change form when the New Status field is set to Inactive. You can enter or select a corresponding reason code associated with the client’s inactive status in the Client Inactivation Reason field. (If you select this field, only reasons matching Inactive display in the Search Inactive Reason list.) In addition, only applicable reasons now display in the Select Term Reason list when you select the Client Termination Reason field (required). (The New Status field must be set to Terminated to display this field.) For more information, see Changing the Client Status.
WSP-3288 System Enhancement to Client Term Reasons Form A new field, Valid Status Uses, is now available on the Client Term Reasons form. You can select a Valid Status Uses option for the following client statuses: - Termination Only - Inactivation Only - Both For more information, see Setting Up Automated Email Messages.
PD-19430, PD-20590, PD-20591, PD-20592, PD-20593, PD-20595, PD-20596, PD-20597, PD-20615, PD-20616, PD-20617, and PD-20618 Time Off (formerly PTO) PTO Terminology Update To ensure consistent naming conventions are used across the PrismHR platform, the legacy PTO terminology described below now aligns with the recently updated Time Off Workflow terminology. Note: In association with this terminology update, the PTO User Guide now displays as the Time Off User Guide. The following legacy PTO forms have been renamed to reflect the updated Time Off Workflow terminology, as documented in the Client Administration Guide and the Time Off User Guide (formerly Paid Time Off User Guide): - PTO Absence Codes = Time Off Pay - PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Import = Time Off Auto-Enrollment Rules Import - PTO Auto Enroll Rules = Time Off Auto Enroll Rules - PTO Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance = Time Off Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance - PTO Auto Register Enrollment = Time Off Auto Register Enrollment - PTO Benefit Plans = Time Off Plans - PTO Classes = Time Off Types - PTO Register Types = Time Off Accrual Schedules Note: This adjustment was made in the breadcrumb paths, on-screen form names, global searches, menu structures, user role process descriptions, Work Centers (except for the Time Off Auto-Enrollment Rules Maintenance form), Related Actions Links, and in any error messages or warning messages that pertain to these legacy forms. The following legacy center names in the “Time Off” category on the Work Centers page now display as follows: - PTO Adjustments and Maintenance = Time Off Adjustments and Maintenance - PTO Plan Setup and Enrollment = Time Off Plan Setup and Enrollment - PTO Reporting = Time Off Reporting - PTO Work Center = Time Off Work Center Note: This update also displays in the user role process description, the menu structure, and the dashboard. The following legacy field names were updated: - Accrue on Arrears = Accrue On Arrear Voucher - Add to Balance On First Accrual = Add Hours To Balance on First Accrual - Auto-enroll Through-Date is Day Before Start Date = Auto-enroll Thru Date is Day Before Start Date - Calculation Basis = Accrual Method - Class Code = Time Off Type Code - Class Description = Type Description - Date to use as the PTO Start Date… = Date to use as the Time Off Start Date… - Display a Warning if Employee Uses More Hours Than Available = Payroll Warning if More Hours Used Than Available - Display Used Amt on Check Stub Memo = Display Used Amount on Pay Stub - Fiscal End Month/Day = Last Day of Fiscal Year - Global PTO = Use Global PTO - Lifetime Maximum Carryover = Lifetime Carryover - Negative Carryover = Allow Negative Carryover - Pay Stub Name = Description for Pay Stub - Plan Description = Description - Plan Expires = Obsolete Date - Plan ID = Time Off Plan - Print On Check = Print On Pay Stub - PTO Benefit Plan = Time Off Plan - PTO Class = Time Off Type - PTO Plan = Plan Code - PTO Register Type = Accrual Schedule - PTO Type Code = Schedule Code - Register Types = Accrual Schedule - Stop Init If Exceed Limit = Display Payroll Warning when Maximum Usage Limit Exceeded - Suppress Print Period = Suppress Pay Stub Printing For - Trigger Date = On - Trigger Method = Accrual Frequency - Updates PTO Register = Updates Time Off Register - Year End Basis = Plan Year Based On For more information, see Accessing Time Off Plan Setup and Enrollment Forms, Creating Time Off Absence Codes, Creating Time Off Accrual Schedules, Defining Time Off Plans, Fields Included in Each Import, Processing Time Off Auto Register Enrollment, Using the Time Off Work Center, and the Understanding Time Off Setup Workflow Process Terminology article on the CRC.

Fixes

Benefits Administration (BA) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
WSP-1975 Previously, on the Employee Deduction Arrears form, when you selected an employee who had at least one existing deduction arrear and then selected the checkbox for any record, the system did not display the checkbox as selected when the browser was resized down. Additionally, the Change Status and the Convert to Adjustment button overlapped. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-2936 Previously, for an employee who had the HDHP Not Required field enabled on the Employee Flexible Spending Accounts form along with HSA Match Override amount entered, then the system allowed HSA Match to pull and exceed annual specified limits. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3217 Previously, when you ran a Benefits Billing Detail Report with multiple filters and selection criteria (like Employee ID, Benefit Plan ID, Insurance, Department, Division, Location, and so on), then the report displayed these information as the report header name, which lead to formatting issues. Now, this is fixed. The report header now displays the count of plans or employees, for example, “Report for 5 Benefit Plans”, “Report for 2 Employee”, and so on.
WSP-3354 Previously, on the Benefits Billing Detail Report form, when you ran a report with Defined Ranges selected as Prior 2 Months, the system calculated the date range incorrectly. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-2889 Previously, for a client set up with Departments Restrict Eligibility option selected for Eligible Benefits Determinant field on the Benefits tab of the Client Details form, the Benefits Eligibility Report displayed blank results even if Departments were set up with eligible benefits. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3409 Previously, when you opened the Retirement Plan Enrollment modal form, the Import Retirement Plan Adjustments button had alignment issues. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3410 Previously, on the Benefit Rules form, the system did not display the Import Benefit Rules quicklink button. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3411 Previously, on the Carrier Plan Billing Report form, when you enter a future date in the As of Date field and run the report, the system displayed today’s date in the Coverage Start Date column on the report. Now, this is fixed.

Compliance (CMP) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
CMP-7142 Previously, clients with New York Metropolitan Commuter Transportation (NY MCT, tax code -37) liability reported to an Alternate Employer (Alternate ER), were not included on the NY Form MTA-305 tax reporting file. In some client-reporting scenarios with NY MCT wages for an Alternate Employer, the NY MTA-305 download file was not generated at all. Now, this is resolved. The NY Form MTA-305 reporting logic has been updated so that: - When NY MCT (-37) tax liability is present for an Alternate Employer, the associated client is now correctly included in the NY Form MTA-305 file for that Employer. - The file generation process for NY MCT client reporting now properly handles wages associated with Alternate Employers, ensuring a file is produced when valid NY MCT wages exist. - The NY Form MTA-305 download now aligns with the underlying tax data, reducing discrepancies between taxes billed and calculated liability.
  • When NY MCT (-37) tax liability is present for an Alternate Employer, the associated client is now correctly included in the NY Form MTA-305 file for that Employer.
  • The file generation process for NY MCT client reporting now properly handles wages associated with Alternate Employers, ensuring a file is produced when valid NY MCT wages exist.
  • The NY Form MTA-305 download now aligns with the underlying tax data, reducing discrepancies between taxes billed and calculated liability. | CMP-7166 | Previously, the system could not generate a “zero” WH347 Certified Payroll Report (both the new and legacy version) when all project pay for the selected week ending was paid under Pay Codes for which the Include in Certified Pay Report Detail field was not selected on the Pay Codes form. Both the versions failed, returning the error: “At least 1 template required.” | Now, this is resolved. Also, a “zero” WH347 Certified Payroll Report (both new and legacy version) is now available when there is no project pay and “Process Initialized Vouchers” Instead of “Posted” is selected. | | CMP-7170 | Previously, on the Miscellaneous Global Parameters form, when the Use Employer SUI Rate as Company SUI Bill Rate field was checked, the system did not honor a 0.00 bill rate on State Misc3 for Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML) resulting in overbilling for clients who should not be billed for PFML. | Now, this is resolved. | | CMP-7177 | Previously, when the “StateOrLocalCode” field had a value of “00-17”, the “Rate” field in the PrismHR Tax Client Setup Export (run either standalone or with the daily file) indicated “0.0060”instead of “0.60”. | Now, this is resolved. | | CMP-7186 | Previously, the PrismHR Quarterly JSON output was omitting the leading zeros for the WorkPSDCode and ResidentPSDCode fields in the EmployeeWageDetails array, leading to failure. | Now, this is resolved. | | CMP-7191 | Previously, for Minnesota Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML) employer tax code 24‑54, the system incorrect applied the Fringe Group-Term Life (GTL) wages marked as exempt twice in employer tax calculations resulting in the GTL exempt amount being overstated for tax code 24‑54. | Now, this is resolved. The tax calculation logic for Minnesota has been updated so that GTL exemptions for tax code 24‑54 are applied only once. | | CMP-7195 | Previously, for Minnesota-resident employees with a Minnesota or Remote worksite location (WSL) who work and are paid in San Francisco, CA, the system was incorrectly generating a Minneapolis, MN miscellaneous employer tax (Tax code: 240530650-35 MINNEAPOLIS, MN MISC ER TAX) on the employee payroll voucher leading to over-collection or misstatement of employer tax liabilities. | Now, this is resolved. The tax calculation logic has been updated so that: - Only valid tax codes are generated on the voucher for MN residents working in CA. - The invalid MN employer miscellaneous tax -35 (e.g., 240530650-35 MINNEAPOLIS, MN MISC ER TAX) is no longer created. - The valid San Francisco, CA miscellaneous employer tax (e.g., 050753040-35 SAN FRANCISCO, CA MISC ER TAX) continues to calculate as expected. - Taxes now calculate consistently with the intended Minnesota and California tax rules, including when the MN WSL is set to Remote and all hours are worked in CA. |
  • Only valid tax codes are generated on the voucher for MN residents working in CA.
  • The invalid MN employer miscellaneous tax -35 (e.g., 240530650-35 MINNEAPOLIS, MN MISC ER TAX) is no longer created.
  • The valid San Francisco, CA miscellaneous employer tax (e.g., 050753040-35 SAN FRANCISCO, CA MISC ER TAX) continues to calculate as expected.
  • Taxes now calculate consistently with the intended Minnesota and California tax rules, including when the MN WSL is set to Remote and all hours are worked in CA. ### Document Management (DM) Fixes
Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
DM-2106 When a user attempted to preview a Word or Excel file in Document Management, an error occurred. This is fixed.

Employee Portal (EP) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-3059 If a client did not have any positions set up in the system, the Position field did not display on the New Hire form, but was still set as required and produced an error message. This is fixed.
EERT-3062 When an employee was ineligible for one of their forms on the Taxes form in Employee Portal and attempted to view the Taxes summary form, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EERT-3067 When some employees attempted to access the Direct Deposit form in Employee Portal, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EERT-3074 When an employee added a new direct deposit account with the Remaining method in Employee Portal, the inactive Remaining method direct deposits were correctly removed, but a blank line was left behind on the Employee Details record in Prism. This is fixed.
EERT-3140 Certain special characters were allowed in Prism passwords, but these characters were not allowed in Employee Portal passwords, which caused a password to be incorrectly flagged as invalid when an employee attempted to reset their password in Employee Portal. This is fixed.
EERT-3188 When an employee attempted to log in to the Employee Portal and their worksite location did not have a State listed in the record, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EERT-3190 When a manager with access to over a thousand employee records accessed the View My Employees form in Employee Portal, sometimes employee names displayed as undefined, even though they displayed correctly on the home screen and employee records. This is fixed.
EP-10042 When a Worksite Manager with access to multiple clients viewed information for a client where they were not an employee, the manager could not view Total Compensation reports for any employees in that client. This is fixed.
EP–10048 Users with an assigned manager role that did not have access to view paystub details were still able to click View Paystub on the Pay History form and view an employee’s paystub. This is fixed.

IAM-2521 Users who already had a Worksite Trusted Advisor account linked to their PrismOne ID were unable to register their account through Employee Portal. This is fixed.

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-3189 When a client set up a vanity URL, this URL did not display on certain updates and notifications. This is fixed.
EERT-3191 When an employee viewed the Employee Confirmation Statement during Benefits Enrollment, the wrong HSA Plan displayed on the form. This is fixed.
EERT-3192 When an employee’s I-9 Section 2 was approved and the WSM marks the approval that the documents were examined remotely, the Remote Verification box was not updated correctly in Prism. This is fixed.

Prism (PD) Fixes

Jira # Category Issue Summary Resolution
PD-19601 General When users selected the User ID filter on the Worksite User Data Security Download form and then selected User ID in the panel that displayed, the Select Users list did not apply to user IDs and instead only returned results that matched the User Name. The selector filter criteria now applies to the User ID and the User Name when users select User ID on the Worksite User Data Security Download form.
PD-20379 General When the HIDE-SUPPORT-TEAM custom feature code was enabled for one client and users navigated to another client, the system sometimes populated the information on the Client Details form with the date from the first client. This is fixed.
PD-20499 General The system did not display an error message when users manually entered a Benefit Group or a Retirement Benefit Group in the New Hire form that had the Stop All Use On and/or Stop New Use On date configured in the past. An error message now displays if users manually enter a Benefit Group or Retirement Benefit Group that has a Stop All Use On and/or Stop New Use On date that is in the past. In addition: - Users cannot manually enter a Benefit Group that is only for a Retirement plan. - Users cannot manually enter a Retirement Group that is only for Benefit plans.
PD-20561 General The linked accrual amount at the end of the fiscal year did not transfer to the balance account in the Employee PTO Register form. This is fixed.
PD-20601 General When users cloned a client in the Clone Client form with leading zeros that used the same client number that did not use leading zeros, the system created duplicate records, including benefit plans, worksite locations, and divisions. The system now restricts cloning a client using a new client number that includes leading zeros, which is the same as an existing client number. In addition an error message now displays, “Client IDs must be unique, excluding leading zeros. New Client ID cannot be created because Client ID already exists.”
PD-20627 General When users created an employer in the Employer Details form using “0” or all zeros as the Employer ID, it caused issues downstream. An error message now displays if users try to create an Employer ID that only contains zeros, “Employer ID cannot contain only zeros.”
WSP-3430 General When a user role was configured with field security for the Last Pay Period Hours field on the Employee Termination form set to Hidden or Disabled, the system still displayed that field. The following now occurs: - When the Last Pay Period Hours field is set to Hidden, the field does not display. - When the Last Pay Period Hours field is set to Disabled, the field displays but is not editable.
PD-19878 Payroll The EE Arrears Received field name in the Non-Bill Accounting panel on the PEO Client Accounting form was misspelled. This is fixed.
PD-20018 Payroll When users created a voucher in the Check History Import form that included FSA deductions and then subsequently deleted that voucher and the register was rebuilt, the system continued to display the FSA deductions in the employee’s Flexible Spending Account. This is fixed.
PD-20585 Payroll When an employee had approved leave, the system auto-accepted it in the timesheet and then if the employee requested additional time in that same pay period, the system produced incorrect leave amounts. This is fixed.
PP-2155 System When a client searched for a bank account on the Bank Accounts form, the Previous button could only be clicked on the right side of the button icon. This is fixed.
PP-2170 System When a client used a custom background color and an employee saved a change and returned to the dashboard, the custom background color did not display properly between the dashboard panels. This is fixed.

Welcome

PrismHR software is specifically designed to help Professional Employer Organizations (PEOs) and Administrative Services Organizations (ASOs) reduce risk, be more efficient, expand business, and be more profitable.

When you choose PrismHR, you are choosing more than just a software platform. You are partnering with a team of professionals who are deeply invested in the PEO and ASO industry and dedicated to providing the best technology and services possible. You are also partnering with other professionals in the industry in the sense that we all learn from each other.

To view release notes for PrismHR, click any of the links in the Table of Contents. Each release is represented with a book that features the month and year. Click these books to expand product names and version numbers for the release. The most recent documents are at the top of the list. Use the Search feature to look for a specific keyword or phrase. Open any PDFs for Download book to view and print release notes documents from the past year.

Documentation Enhancements

Click a link to read about the documentation enhancements included in this release.

Task Sheets

To provide a better customer experience, new or improved task sheets are available in the in-product Help. In the table of contents, you can select the Task Sheets topic (located just below User Guide PDFs) to display a list of the most current task sheets. For example:

[Image: screenshot]

  • Managing Pending Approvals: This article outlines how to perform tasks using the Manage Pending Approvals form, which replaced the Reassign Pending Approvals form.
  • Setting Up Global PTO Plans: This article documents how to set up PTO plans on the system level and automatically assign those plans to employees based on work location.
  • Understanding Time Off Setup Workflow Process Terminology: This article provides a chart that compares the terms used in the legacy PTO Work Center against their counterpart enhanced Time Off Setup Workflow process in PrismHR.
  • Using the Enhanced Dashboard: This article describes the Enhanced Dashboard in PrismHR.

Release Notes: Enhancements and Fixes

You can view release notes in a variety of formats. You can:

  • View the detailed release notes. See: Release Notes
  • Download a PDF containing the detailed release notes. See Release Notes PDF
  • Download an Excel spreadsheet containing the detailed release notes. See: Release Notes Excel Note: The Excel export of release note does not include images. View the Detailed release notes in HTML format to see images.

Compliance (CMP) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
CMP-7003 & CMP-7004 Updates to Illinois Pay Data Report To support Illinois Pay Data reporting requirements for tax year 2024 (Reporting Year 2025) , the IL Pay Data export template has been updated. This report now includes three new reporting elements and supports the EEO Ethnic Code category Middle Eastern or North African. The export now reports: - Column N: PaidHS (Reports whether the employee is salary or hourly) - Column O: BaseHourlyRate (Reports the employees hourly rate when Column N = H. When Column N = S, the rate reported is 0) - Column P: CBAYN: Is the employee covered by a CBA? This field will report as N. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR System Administration User Guide.
- Column N: PaidHS (Reports whether the employee is salary or hourly)
- Column O: BaseHourlyRate (Reports the employees hourly rate when Column N = H. When Column N = S, the rate reported is 0)
- Column P: CBAYN: Is the employee covered by a CBA? This field will report as N.
CMP-7101 & CMP-7205 CA Pay Data - Tax Year 2025 reporting updates For tax year 2025 and later, the California Pay Data Reporting specifications have changed. To align with the updated state requirements, we have updated the EEO-1 Build, Import and CSV templates. The California Pay Data CSV export (EEO Processing / EEO-1 Processing / Client EEO-1 & Pay Data Files (CA Payroll Employee Report)) updates are now complete for Tax Year 2025. The updated export including the newly added data points and MENA classification were released on March 12, 2026 via a hotfix. Note: These changes affect only tax year 2025 and forward; tax year 2024 and prior remain unchanged. Here is the California Pay Data Reporting link. - CSV template modified for CA Pay Data employees & Labor Contractor reporting - New data points added to CA Pay Data Build - To support 2025 California Pay Data Reporting requirements, we’ve enhanced the standard EEO-1 build and Export to include additional data points for California employees. These changes make it easier to classify employees correctly and to calculate weeks worked for the reporting year. ### What’s New - California Labor Contractor Pay Data Report ##### 1. Exemption Status For California employees, based on the FLSA status on the employee’s home position as of the voucher “as of” date, the EEO‑1 build now includes an Exemption Status field that indicates whether the employee is: - Exempt (Y) - Non‑exempt (N) The exemption status is included in the EEO‑1 Build and the EEO‑1 Export file. ##### 2. Employment Type Based on the employee’s type from the voucher “as of” date, the EEO‑1 build now classifies each California employee into one of three Employment Types: - F=Full‑time (derived from internal employee type codes and type classification) - P=Part‑time (derived from internal employee type codes and type classification) - S=Intermittent (assigned when the employee’s type is flagged as Seasonal = Y) This employment type is included in the EEO‑1 Build and the EEO‑1 Export file. ##### 3. Weeks Worked in Reporting Year by Labor Contractor Location The EEO‑1 build now calculates the total number of weeks worked by Labor Contractor location for each California employee during the reporting year, summing all vouchers by Labor Contractor location within the selected date range (the reporting tax year). This will be indicated as a whole number greater than zero without decimal places. The calculated Weeks Worked is included in the EEO‑1 Build and the EEO‑1 Export file. ##### 4. MENA Ethnicity For employees belonging to the MENA (Middle Eastern or North African) ethnic type: - For the Import EEO-1 Data form, the import file can now contain M for the Race/Ethnicity field. - When you generate the EEO‑1 Export file using the Client EEO-1 & Pay Data Files form, these employees will be further subdivided into the following categories under the Race/Ethnicity/Sex column: - B70 = Non-Hispanic/Non-Latino - Male - Middle Eastern or North African - C70 = Non-Hispanic/Non-Latino - Female - Middle Eastern or North African - D70 = Non-Hispanic/Non-Latino - Non-Binary - Middle Eastern or North African For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR System Administration User Guide.
- CSV template modified for CA Pay Data employees & Labor Contractor reporting

These changes make it easier to classify employees correctly and to calculate weeks worked for the reporting year.
- Exempt (Y)
- Non‑exempt (N)
