CMP-7183 Changes to the Tax Deductions form On this form a new field named Suppress PrismHR Tax Client Setup Reporting Only has been introduced as you can see below. [Image: screenshot] - This option is not available if you have already selected the Suppress Reporting to PrismHR Tax & Mastertax field. - When this field is: - Unchecked (Default) - The tax deduction will continue to be included in the PrismHR Tax Agency setup files. - Checked - The standalone Client Setup File & the setup file that can be generated during the daily JSON generation will not include these tax codes in the agency setup records. This will continue to report on the daily and quarterly JSON exports. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR System Administration User Guide.
- This option is not available if you have already selected the Suppress Reporting to PrismHR Tax & Mastertax field.
- When this field is:
- Unchecked (Default) - The tax deduction will continue to be included in the PrismHR Tax Agency setup files.
- Checked - The standalone Client Setup File & the setup file that can be generated during the daily JSON generation will not include these tax codes in the agency setup records. This will continue to report on the daily and quarterly JSON exports.
CMP-7781 Employer PFML Pickup Contribution Taxation The IRS released further guidance on the requirements of Revenue Ruling 2025-04. This rule requires that when an employer voluntarily pays part of the employee’s required PFML contribution, this amount is treated as additional compensation to the employee. This requires that the excess contribution amounts are included in the employee’s gross income and wages for federal employment tax purposes. PrismHR is releasing new functionality to calculate the employer contribution amounts retroactively to 1/1/26. The April release includes the necessary system configuration UI components including: ## Changes to the System Parameters form On this form, in the Global Codes Setup section, under the Benefits group, a new field named PFML ER Pickup Fringe Pay Code has been introduced as you can see below. [Image: screenshot] You can click the hyperlink and select a pay code with a pay class of non‑cash fringe benefit from the Select fringe benefit dialog box or you can manually enter a valid pay code with a pay class of non‑cash fringe benefit here. If you manually enter an invalid (non‑fringe or non‑existing) pay code here, and click Save, you will receive an error message stating is not a non-cash fringe benefit. The invalid value will be cleared from this field. ## Changes to the State Tax Rates (SUTA) form On this form, in the Rate Breakdown section, a new field named PFML Employer Pickup has been introduced. [Image: screenshot] This field will display only if the field named PFML ER Pickup Fringe Pay Code on the Systems Parametrs form as been defined. This field is optional. Enter the amount the employer is contributing in excess of their mandatory contribution amount here. You can only enter numeric values with decimals. For example, if the State PFML rate is .8 with a 50% split between Employee and Employer, and the employer contributes the full .8% with the employee contributing 0%, you will enter .4 in this field. Note: The payroll calculation process will be released in the upcoming 2026 May release. You will not see any changes within payroll until the 2026 May release is complete. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR System Administration User Guide.
RRT-6847 Quarterly Reporting File Format updated for Michigan (MI) to meet the new EFW2 Specifications The State of Michigan has released updated specifications for quarterly reporting. Michigan requires employers and agents filing quarterly wage data to adhere strictly to its EFW2 file format. In line with that, we have updated the Michigan (MI) Quarterly Wage Report to use the EFW2 file format required by the Michigan UIA. The previous MiWAM layout is no longer supported by the state, and this change ensures files generated from Prism continue to be accepted. - The MI Quarterly report now generates an EFW2‑compliant file instead of the legacy MiWAM format. - The file includes the RE (Employer) and RS (Employee) Wage records required by Michigan, aligned with the MiUI EFW2 File Format v1 specification: For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR System Administration User Guide.
- The MI Quarterly report now generates an EFW2‑compliant file instead of the legacy MiWAM format.
- The file includes the RE (Employer) and RS (Employee) Wage records required by Michigan, aligned with the MiUI EFW2 File Format v1 specification:

Employee Portal (EP) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
EP-9893 Enhancement to My Approvals Form When a manager approves or denies an item on the My Approvals form, and that item is on a later page, the session now remains on the same page the manager just reviewed. For example, if the manager is reviewing an item on Page 3, approving or denying the item will no longer return the manager to the first page. If the reviewed item is the last item on the last page, the session will go one page back rather than returning to the first page. This enhancement makes it easier to go through several items on the later pages of the My Approvals form. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-10062 Client Controls for Redirecting to Onboarding A new option has been added to allow managers to use the new version of Onboarding in Portal to enter in New Hires via the New Hire Dashboard button. > Note: Note: This feature has been added to support a future Onboarding release, and is not currently active. The functionality is described here for future reference. If the Client Controls Onboarding Version option is set to New, clicking the New Hire Dashboard button directs the manager to the new Onboarding system on a new tab in their browser. If the Client Controls Onboarding Version option is set to Legacy, clicking the New Hire Dashboard button directs the manager to the New Hire Dashboard in Employee Portal. > Note: Note: The new Onboarding system is not available for Trusted Advisors. If the options is selected to redirect to Onboarding and a Trusted Advisors clicks the New Hire Dashboard button, a message displays indicating Trusted Advisor access to Onboarding is unavailable. > Note: Note: I-9 Approvals are not supported in Employee Portal at present, and must be completed in Onboarding. For more information, see the in-app help.
EP-10939 New Hire Dashboard Security for Worksite Managers Security access to the New Hire Dashboard has been improved to honor Worksite Manager data security settings in Prism. Worksite Managers can now only view new hires that align with their security settings for divisions, locations, departments, and other restrictions within the organization. The dropdown options available when entering a new hire also align with these security restrictions. For example, if a Worksite Manager only has security access to a single department within the company, that manager can only see new hires for that department on the New Hire Dashboard and can only select new hires from that department on the New Hire Entry form. > Note: Note: Once the employee has an employee record in the system, security access is then evaluated based on the employee record. For more information, see the in-app help.

Identity and Access Management (IAM) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
IAM-2031 Enhancement to My Login Settings Form Users can now change their first and last name on the My Login Settings form. Simply click Change next to your name in the Account Settings section to access the Change Your Name form. For more information, see the in-app help.
IAM-2539 Enhancement to Password Reset Process When an administrator views a user record on the User Administration form, if the user has no MFA factors set up, a message now displays letting the admin know that the user will not be able to reset their own password. For more information, see the in-app help.
IAM-2630 User Management Form Service Providers can now delegate PrismONE ID maintenance tasks to support representatives through the new User Management form. This form can be used to securely change user addresses and mobile numbers, send password reset messages, create temporary passwords, and set the user’s status. A new process ID, HRP.USERS*USER.MANAGEMENT.PRISMONE, is now available to grant access to this form. Security access to the User Management form is separate from other user security fields, so administrators can provide lower-tier support representatives with access to this form to safely delegate login support tasks. The User Management form can be accessed through the Actions menu on the Employee Details form. If a user hasn’t completed their PrismONE ID registration, the action item displays as User Management (Pending Registration). If the user does not have a PrismONE ID account or is missing a user record, a message displays on the form indicating which steps a user must take to complete registration. > Note: Note: Please fully read the documentation fully to make sure you understand the capabilities of this item before granting access to this feature. For more information, refer to See PrismONE ID – PrismHR User Admin Access Action Menu.
IAM-2700 Improved PrismONE ID Security for Shared Machines The PrismONE ID system has been enhanced to better detect when a user is on a shared machine and force MFA to improve security for users who forget to fully log out before closing their browser. For more information, see the in-app help.
IAM-2711 Enhancement to Changing User’s Email Address When an administrator attempts to change a user’s email address on the User Management form and enters an email address that already exists in the system, a message displays indicating that an account using this email already exists. For more information, see the in-app help.

Onboarding (OB) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
OBE-9697 Enhancement to Life Event Workflows When Decision Support Tools are enabled on the Enrollment Options form, the selected decision support tool can now display during the Life Event workflow. When a user proceeds to the Life Event portion of Benefits Enrollment, the Decision Support form displays. For more information, see Maintaining Life Event Codes.

Prism (PD) Enhancements

Ticket Category Description Summary Help Content
PD-20629 Client Enhancement to Contacts Form You can now enter or select multipleContact Type IDs in the Contacts form. (After entering or selecting the Contact Type ID, the associated Contact Type displays.) Note: The list of Contact Type IDs that displays is configured in the Contact Types form. For more information, see Maintaining Company Contacts.
WSP-3427 Client Enhancement to Transfer Employee to New Client Form A new mandatory field, To Benefit Group, now displays on the Transfer Employee to New Client form. For example: [Image: screenshot] You can use the To Benefit Group field to assign a benefit group to an employee when transferring to a new client. Note: The system prepopulates the To Benefit Group field if an employee has a benefit group from their old client that matches a benefit group in the new client. Also, if you select this field, the Select Benefit Groups list that displays contains only valid benefit groups for the destination client. For more information, see the in-product help.
PD-20013 Human Resources Enhancement to Approvals Processed Form Users who process an H/R Action approval that failed (Approval Status is “F”) now receive an email that provides the following information, which the system stores in the APPROVALS record: - Message Subject: <HR Action> Approval Error for Employee <employee> - Message Body: Due to a technical issue the <HR Action> for Employee <employee> will need to be resubmitted. Error: <include the error stored in the new field in the approval record>. For more information, see Reviewing Processed Approvals.
PD-23694 Human Resources Enhancement to Planned Time Off Requests Form When you mark an approved leave request as Paid on the Planned Time Off Requests form, the system now displays the updated warning message, “Marking an item Paid does not update the Employee Time Off Register. You will need to enter an Employee Absence Entry in order to update the Time Off Register. Do you wish to continue?” For more information, see Working with Planned Time Off Requests.
PD-14516 New Employee Import Enhancement to New Employee Import Form The New Employee Import form now supports an optional Benefit Salary field, allowing you to load this value during import so the system can calculate benefits eligibility and costs correctly without manual updates. > Note: Note the following: - The system does not import any value when the Benefit Salary field is left blank. - The system displays an error message, “Benefit Salary must be a numeric value,” when you enter a non‑numeric value in the Benefit Salary field. - The system displays the Benefit Salary field on the Pay tab of the Employee Details form when it imports a new employee with a Benefit Salary value. - The system stores the Benefit Salary field with the employee’s pay details and the Prism-Expanded Import file also includes the Benefit Salary field at the end of the file on the Import Field Mapping form. For more information, see Using the New Employee Import Dashboard (Batch Management).
WSP-3311, WSP-3312, WSP-3446 Payroll Enhancement to Payroll Options Form A new field, Delivery Method Override, now replaces the earlier Delivery Method on the Payroll Options form, which you can access by selecting Options from the Actions menu on the Payroll Control form. > Note: Note the following: - You can manually enter or choose a delivery method by selecting from the Select a Delivery Method dialog box. - The system tracks and maintains an audit for any changes that you make to the Delivery Method Override field. You can view the audit details by selecting Audit from the Actions menu on the Payroll Control form. - By default the system displays a null value in the Delivery Method Override field whenever you create a new payroll batch. - When you select Clone Last Batch from the Actions menu on Payroll Control form, the system copies the Delivery Method Override value from the selected batch into the new batch. - The payroll program logic is updated to improve the application of delivery sheets, allowing for a Delivery Method override on individual batch control. The system now logically assess delivery methods, prioritizing the new Delivery Method Override field on the Payroll Options form, followed by Location-specific Special Delivery, All Locations Special Delivery, the historical Delivery Method field, and finally, the Client Detail Delivery Method. This will ensure predictable and logical application of delivery sheets. - Additionally, the payroll program billing logic is updated to treat the new Delivery Method Override field on the Payroll Control form as a true override for the entire batch and when the override is set, no other delivery fees are applied. For more information, see the in-product help.
PD-20609, PD-20610, PD-20611, PD-20612, PD-20613, PD-20631, PD-20632, PD-20633, PD-20634, PD-20635, PD-20636, PD-20637, PD-20638, PD-20639, PD-20644, PD-20645, PD-20646, PD-23651, PD-23681, and PD-23718 Time Off PTO Terminology Update To ensure consistent naming conventions are used across the PrismHR platform, the legacy PTO terminology described below now aligns with the recently updated Time Off Workflow terminology. Note: In association with this terminology update, the PTO User Guide now displays as the Time Off User Guide. The following legacy PTO forms/reports have been renamed to reflect the updated Time Off Workflow terminology, as documented in the Client Administration Guide, Human Resources User Guide, Payroll Administration Guide, Payroll Reports guide, and the Time Off User Guide (formerly Paid Time Off User Guide): - Eligible PTO Hours Report = Eligible Time Off Hours Report - Eligible PTO Report = Eligible Time Off Report - Employee PTO Accruals Report = Employee Time Off Accruals Report - Employee PTO Detail Report = Employee Time Off Detail Report - Employee PTO Register Adjustment = Employee Time Off Register Adjustment - Employee PTO Register Inquiry = Employee Time Off Register Inquiry - Employee PTO Register = Employee Time Off Register - Employee PTO Summary = Employee Time Off Summary - Mass Archive Employee PTO Registers = Mass Archive Employee Time Off Registers - Mass Delete Employee PTO Registers = Mass Delete Employee Time Off Registers - Pay Period PTO Report = Pay Period Time Off Report - PTO Accrual Recalculation = Time Off Accrual Recalculation - PTO Approval Report = Time Off Approval Report - PTO Carryover Loss Report = Time Off Carryover Loss Report - PTO Hours Taken Report = Time Off Hours Taken Report - PTO Register Adjustment Import = Time Off Register Adjustment Import - PTO Register Enrollment = Time Off Register Enrollment Note: This adjustment was made in the breadcrumb paths, on-screen form names, global searches, menu structures, user role process descriptions, Work Centers (except for the Eligible Time Off Report and Employee Time Off Accruals Report forms), Related Actions Links, and in any error messages or warning messages that pertain to these legacy forms. The following legacy tab name was updated on the Employee Voucher form: - PTO = Time Off The following legacy field/option names were updated: - Absence Code = Time Off Pay - Benefit Plan = Time Off Plan - Class Description = Description - Display PTO Comments = Display Time Off Comments - No PTO Details are recorded for this employee = No Time Off Details are recorded for this employee - PTO Absence Code = Time Off Pay Code - PTO Absence Summary Detail Report = Time Off Absence Summary Detail Report - PTO Absence Summary Report by Department = Time Off Absence Summary Report by Department - PTO Absence Summary Report with Accrual Level = Time Off Absence Summary Report with Accrual Level - PTO Absence Summary Report with Accrual Level by Location = Time Off Absence Summary Report with Accrual Level by Location - PTO Absence Summary Report with Buyback = Time Off Absence Summary Report with Buyback - PTO Absence Summary Report with Buyback by Department = Time Off Absence Summary Report with Buyback by Department - PTO Absence Summary Report with Buyback by Location = Time Off Absence Summary Report with Buyback by Location - PTO Absence Summary Report with Buyback by Pay Group = Time Off Absence Summary Report with Buyback by Pay Group - PTO Benefit Plan = Time Off Plan - PTO Class = Time Off Type - PTO Code = Time Off Type - PTO Date = Time Off Date - PTO Detail = Time Off Detail - PTO Payroll Equivalent Report For Current Year = Time Off Payroll Equivalent Report For Current Year - PTO Payroll Equivalent Report For Previous Year = Time Off Payroll Equivalent Report For Previous Year - PTO Plan Delimiter = Time Off Plan - PTO Register Type = Accrual Schedule - PTO Start Date On Or After = Time Off Start Date On Or After - PTO Start Date On Or Before = Time Off Start Date On Or Before - PTO Status = Time Off Status - PTO Type = Accrual Schedule - PTO YTD Absence Report by Hours Used = Time Off YTD Absence Report by Hours Used - PTO YTD Detail Report = Time Off YTD Detail Report - Register Type = Accrual Schedule - Register Type Year End Date = Year End Date - Stop PTO Accruals = Stop Time Off Accruals - Trigger Method = Accrual Frequency For more information, see Performing an Employee Time Off Register Inquiry, Deleting Mass Employee Time Off Registers, Working with Planned Time Off Requests, Reviewing Time Off Tab Details, Processing Time Off Auto Register Enrollment, Adjusting Accrued or Carryover Hours for Employees, Archiving Mass Employee Time Off Registers, Recalculating Time Off Accruals, Importing Time Off Adjustment Information, Time Off Approval Report, Viewing Employee Time Off Register, Employee Time Off Detail Report, Time Off Hours Taken Report, Eligible Time Off Hours Report, Obtaining Time Off Carryover Loss for Employees, Employee Time Off Accruals Report, Employee Time Off Summary Report, Pay Period Time Off Report, and the Understanding Time Off Setup Workflow Process Terminology article on the CRC.
PD-23671 Work Centers Enhancement to Time Off Work Center In association with the PTO Terminology Update introduced in a previous release, PTO Reporting now displays as Time Off Reporting in the Time Off Work Center list. For example: [Image: screenshot] For more information, see Accessing Time Off Reporting Forms.
PP-1702 General Enhancement to COBRA Participant Record Form When searching for an enrollee on the COBRA Participant Record form, users can now choose to search for enrollees with a status date within a certain time frame. Simply select 30 days, 60 days, 90 days, or All in the Status Date Less than field to searching within that time frame. This enhancement improves performance of the search results, especially for companies with a large number of employees. For more information, see the in-app help.
PP-1964 General Enhancement to Organization Chart The Organization Chart now supports unlimited depth to improve downloading and printing options for the chart. In addition, the chart now features improved performance. For more information, see the in-app help.
PP-2572 General User Management Form Service Providers can now delegate PrismONE ID maintenance tasks to support representatives through the new User Management form. This form can be used to securely change user addresses and mobile numbers, send password reset messages, create temporary passwords, and set the user’s status. A new process ID, HRP.USERS*USER.MANAGEMENT.PRISMONE, is now available to grant access to this form. Security access to the User Management form is separate from other user security fields, so administrators can provide lower-tier support representatives with access to this form to safely delegate login support tasks. The User Management form can be accessed through the Actions menu on the Employee Details form. If a user hasn’t completed their PrismONE ID registration, the action item displays as User Management (Pending Registration). If the user does not have a PrismONE ID account or is missing a user record, a message displays on the form indicating which steps a user must take to complete registration. > Note: Note: Please review the in-app documentation for this form, the actions it provides, and the security implications before granting access to users. For more information, see the in-app help.

Fixes

Benefits Administration (BA) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
WSP-3388 Previously, on the Employee Benefits Enrollment form, when you save a benefit enrollment record with Status as Eligible prior to completing the actual enrollment, the system created an enrollment reference record for that plan. Additionally, when the Benefits Enrollment Post process was run later, the system detected the enrollment reference record and interpreted it as an existing enrollment rather than a new one. Now, this is fixed. The process now checks for existing adjustments for the plan/period and only generates new adjustments when none exist, preventing missed first-time adjustments while still avoiding duplicate entries.
WSP-3445 Previously, on the Flexible Spending Accounts Reimbursement form, you could manually enter an Employee ID in the Employee field even if you did not have access to that employee. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-3895 During payroll processing, a system background process was incorrectly updating employee recurring deduction records even when no manual changes were made. These system-generated updates triggered the Employee Recurring Deductions Audit and appeared on the Employee Change Report as if deductions were being added or removed. Now, this is fixed.
WSP-4080 Previously, there was an issue where payroll calculation failed with a No Benefit Rule date found for coverage date error message when an employee’s benefit group with Life Insurance benefit plan was changed to a group whose Benefit Rules did not have an effective date on or before the employee’s original coverage start date. Now, this is fixed.

Compliance (CMP) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
CMP-3801 Previously, the Employee Misc Taxes recalculation utility in PrismHR was ignoring the selected employer filter on the Recalculate Taxes on Vouchers form and generated a report for all employers. Now, this is resolved.
CMP-7056 Previously, PrismHR did not calculate the Oregon (OR) Transit Tax (tax code 38-27) consistently on vouchers for all employees with a OR worksite location. Now, this is resolved.
CMP-7174 Previously, when creating tax adjustments or importing tax adjustments for employee‑paid tax deductions (for example tax codes 24‑40, 06‑40, 39‑22), the system did not honor the Adjust Client Register setting on the Tax Adjustments form. Instead, the Tax Basis defaulted to the tax code setup (for example tax codes configured to calculate/report at the client level), causing the Tax Basis on the employee payroll voucher to be set to “C” even when the adjustment was intended to be processed as “P”. Now, Tax Adjustments entry and Tax Adjustment Import have been updated to correctly honor the Adjust Client Register flag for employee‑paid tax codes and the Tax Basis on the employee payroll voucher reflects it correctly.
CMP-7817 Previously, for employer-paid local taxes such as NY County (-37) and Scranton, PA (-38), when an employee had “Other payments” (e.g., GTL) and was in a remote work state/location (WSL), PrismHR was applying an incorrect taxable limit. The tax was accrued but not billed correctly, causing mismatches between employer tax accruals and billed amounts on the billing voucher and invoice for taxable billing (with and without shelters). Now, this is resolved.
CMP-7850 Previously, in some cases in the PrismHR Quarterly Tax JSON Export the subject wage amount differed between the Client Report and the Employer Report for tax code 05-24. Now, this is resolved. The reports now display a consistent subject wage amount across both outputs.

Document Management (DM) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
DM-2131 When a user accessed Document Management from the Documents tab on the Employee Details form, the download option did not display. This is fixed.
DM-2138 When a user accessed Document Management from the Documents tab on the Employee Details form and attempted to upload documents, no document categories displayed. This is fixed.

Employee Portal (EP) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-3201 When multiple SSO hyperlinks were included in a custom widget, only the first hyperlink in the widget worked properly. Clicking on the other links produced an error. This is fixed.
EERT-3735 When a Worksite Manager viewed the My Employees form or the Paid Time Off form and reduced the size of the screen, some of the filter options were cut off and could not be selected. This is fixed.
EERT-3737 When managers viewed the Personal Info tab of the Employee Details form in Portal, the Birthdate (Age) field rounded up the employee’s age for some employees. This is fixed.
EERT-3752 When clients used a substitution variable for the employee’s position title, the title did not display with the proper case in the welcome email to the new employee. This is fixed.
EERT-3757 When an employee or service provider attempted to view the Pay History form or the Payroll Inquiry form and the hire date was missing on the employee record, an error occurred. This is fixed. A message now displays to the employee that their hire date information is missing, and that they must contact the service provider. Service providers can update the Original Hire Date field on the employee record.
EERT-3759 When a user entered line breaks in the Details field on the Client Events form in Prism, then viewed the client event in Employee Portal, the line breaks would not display properly. This is fixed.
EERT-3773 When employees attempted to access or download their pay vouchers in Employee Portal through certain browsers, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EP-10018 When employees clicked a link in Portal that was meant to single sign on (SSO) into another system, the system sometimes returned users to the Portal dashboard instead of sending them to the intended third‑party application. This is fixed. The SSO process now works even if they already have an active Portal session.
EP-10952 Clients who had not made selections on the “Employees Ability to Cancel PTO” toggle on the Configuration Template had the value default to False, when it should have defaulted to True. This is fixed.
EP-10980 When a manager viewed reports in Payroll History in Portal, some report types such as the PEO Client Accounting report did not display. This is fixed.

Identity and Access Management (IAM) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
IAM-2899 When a user logged in to Employee Portal and attempted to link their account with PrismONE ID or register for PrismONE ID, an error occurred. This is fixed.
IAM-2926 When a user attempted to reset their password, pressing the Enter key would disable the Submit button under certain circumstances. This is fixed.
IAM-2954 When a new user hadn’t completed PrismONE ID registration, the user could not reset their password in the system. This is fixed.

Onboarding (OB) Fixes

Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
EERT-3145 During Onboarding and Benefits Enrollment workflows, notifications were sent with a type that did not match the types allowed in Notification Template. This is fixed.
EERT-3750 When employees viewed the Employee Confirmation form during Benefits Enrollment, the Cost Basis displayed per period when it should display as per month. This is fixed.
EERT-3756 When clients set up a life insurance plan and set the GI Rounding Method field to round up to an increment, the Guaranteed Issue Limit on the plan rounded down instead. This is fixed. In addition, the GI Rounding Method field will now only allow valid rounding methods. For example, if the amounts are entered in thousands, only the rounding methods for thousandths can be selected. If an invalid selection is selected on a current plan, the Invalid text will display next to the selection, but the rounding method will still apply. Customers with AutoDecide selected should reselect a new rounding method.
EERT-3761 When a Group Benefit Plan had special characters in the plan name, the characters displayed with improper formatting on the Confirmation Statement. This is fixed.
EERT-3765 When a future-dated Benefit Group Change was scheduled for an employee, a Critical Illness as Life plan with Guaranteed Issue did display on Offer Type (CRL) during Benefit Enrollment. This is fixed.
EERT-3769 When a client attempted to load or edit Custom Forms for Onboarding that included inline images, an error occurred. This is fixed.
EERT-3807 During Benefit Enrollment, the system displayed the Per Period Cost incorrectly for the minimum Coverage Amount for life plans when using a salary multiplier. This is fixed.
EERT-3816 Life Events time notifications were not generating consistently. This is fixed.
OBE-10325 When Decision Support tools were enabled on the System Parameters form but disabled on the Client Details form, the Client Details setting took priority and disabled the Decision Support tools. This is fixed. The System Parameters setting now takes priority when determining if Decision Support tools should display.

Prism (PD) Fixes

Jira # Category Issue Summary Resolution
PD-20300 General Service providers who proxied in as a worksite trusted advisor were unable to view all employees that a worksite trusted advisor, who was a PTO Approver or Manager, was able to access when their data security was based on Manager Direct Reports, Manager Full Hierarchy, PTO Approver Direct Reports, or PTO Approver Full Hierarchy. Service providers who proxy in as a worksite trusted advisor are now able to view all employees that a worksite trusted advisor is able to access when their security is based on PTO Approver Direct Reports.
PD-20695 General The system displayed an employee’s election details on the Retirement Plan Enrollment form when that employee was enrolled in a retirement plan and then was transferred to another client who did not have a retirement plan using the Transfer Employee to New Client form. This is fixed.
PD-23736 General If a client was cloned from another client and the Client ID contained leading zeroes, saving or tabbing out of the Client ID field would drop the leading zeroes. For example, a Client ID of “001530” would become “1530”. This is fixed.
WSP-3910 General While using Remote Position Classification feature on the Positions form, the system did not correctly reflect the remote position classification for Position EEO Code and the FLSA Exempt on the Employee Details form. In the Employee Details form, the Position EEO Code and the FLSA Exempt status now correctly reflect the employee’s Remote Position Classification, if used, ensuring that remote roles display the appropriate Position EEO Code and Exempt/Non-Exempt flag instead of defaulting to the standard position classification.
WSP-4082 Payroll Previously, manual payroll batches were skipping the “ready to ship” stage in superbatch and disappeared instead. This is fixed. Manual payroll batches now remain on the Superbatch screen, and does not disappear once the “ready to ship” step is reached.
PD-20600 Payroll Loan deductions were taken from newer loans before older loans when there were insufficient gross wages to cover the deductions. This is fixed. Loan deductions are now taken from the older loans first in the order of the deduction sequences.
PD-20733 Payroll When clients chose to hide restricted invoices, users without permission to access all employees in a payroll batch could still infer the pay rates of restricted employees if they had access to all but one employee on the invoice. This is fixed. If a user does not have access to all employees on a payroll batch, the Invoice row is hidden to prevent them from inferring information about restricted employees. If the user has access to all employees on a payroll batch, the Invoice row displays normally.
PD-23625 Payroll When employees added to a payroll were part of a different pay group and only had Supplemental Pay Codes on the timesheet, the voucher did not calculate properly. Adding a Regular Pay type pay code with a value of 0 caused the voucher to calculate correctly. This is fixed. When an employee from a different pay group only has Supplemental Pay Codes on the timesheet, the voucher now calculates as expected.
PD-23725 Payroll When a payroll included a retroactive payment for a pay code that included a Shift Differential, the system calculated an incorrect negative amount, resulting in an incorrect deduction. This is fixed. Retroactive payments for shift differentials are now applied correctly to the payroll.
PP-2011 System When a user accessed a form that displayed a list of employees and ran a report on that form, the employee list could no longer be selected, and would sometimes no longer display. This is fixed.
PP-2013 System When a user first navigates to the Client Workflow grid on the Time Sheet Entry form, the custom height of the table caused it to overlap with the buttons used to save and finalize changes, preventing the user from saving changes properly. This is fixed.
PP-2534 System When an employee made entries on the Cafeteria Plan Contribution form, the first value entered in the Effective Date field did not save properly. This is fixed.
PP-2539 System When the approvals record for a prehire returned a null value, the Approvals form produced an error that locked the prehire record. This is fixed.
PP-2556 System When a user updated the Notes field for a change to the Client Details form, adding the reason for the change generated an audit log on the File Audit form. This is fixed.
PP-2560 System When a user who did not have access to view employee benefits accessed employee details on the Enhanced Dashboard, the employee could view the Employee Benefit Enrollments section of the At a Glance form on the dashboard and access information for individual employees. This is fixed. The Enhanced Dashboard now properly applies security permissions for employee benefits information. The employee must have access to the Employee Benefits Overview form to view benefits information on the chart.
PP-2567 System When a user accessed employee information on the Enhanced Dashboard, the Hire Date field sorted by month instead of by year. This is fixed.

April (R_202604)

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/Release-Notes/2026/04/whatsnew-R_202604.htm Path: Release-Notes/2026/04/whatsnew-R_202604.htm

Welcome

PrismHR software is specifically designed to help Professional Employer Organizations (PEOs) and Administrative Services Organizations (ASOs) reduce risk, be more efficient, expand business, and be more profitable.

When you choose PrismHR, you are choosing more than just a software platform. You are partnering with a team of professionals who are deeply invested in the PEO and ASO industry and dedicated to providing the best technology and services possible. You are also partnering with other professionals in the industry in the sense that we all learn from each other.

To view release notes for PrismHR, click any of the links in the Table of Contents. Each release is represented with a book that features the month and year. Click these books to expand product names and version numbers for the release. The most recent documents are at the top of the list. Use the Search feature to look for a specific keyword or phrase. Open any PDFs for Download book to view and print release notes documents from the past year.

PrismHR Release Highlights

The release highlights consist of the following enhancements, which consist of helpful updates to the current functionality and security improvements:

Highlight — Description

Benefits Administration (BA) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
RRT-6876 Enhancement to Retirement Plans Form A warning message now displays when you update an existing Deduction Code Override and click Save. A prompt displays asking you to acknowledge this update (click Yes to save the update). After clicking Yes, an on-screen report displays the affected employees, with each employee record, deduction type, and code change (original > updated), which requires you to once again confirm this update in the Retirement Plan and its downstream impacts to Recurring Deduction records: - Clicking Yes: Updates all associated records and provides a list of affected employee enrollments. Once updated, the corresponding Deduction Code displays on the Recurring Deductions form for each associated employee, which the system pulls into the payroll. - Clicking No: Does not update the Retirement Plan setup or the employee Recurring Deduction records. For more information, see the Setting Up Deductions and Bill Codes Overrides help topic.
WSP-3821, WSP-3887, WSP-3901 Enhancements to the Employee Benefit Overview Form The following enhancements now reside on the Employee Benefit Overview form: - The Employee Benefit Overview grid now displays a green highlighted outline on the row when you place your cursor on it, making it easier to track selections. [Image: screenshot] - The Coverage Level column under the Employee Benefit Overview grid now displays the Benefit Plan Type when you hover on the text. For example, if there is a benefit plan using the Group Benefit Plan Types, then the hover text displays the Type Code and Type Description (FAM - FAMILY). Similarly, for other benefit plans, the hover text displays the Coverage Amount (25,000.00). [Image: screenshot] - Under the Employee Benefit Overview grid, when you click a Plan ID, then the Employee Benefit Details modal form now displays the Plan Type as Type Code instead of Type Description. [Image: screenshot] For more information, see the Defining Cafeteria Plan Contributions help topic.
WSP-4059 Alternate processing when CFC is ON under certain conditions With this enhancement, if the employee’s status classification is not Terminated and the coverage end date falls on the last day of the month, the system now bypasses the legacy deduction stop-date logic and continues standard deduction processing. Deductions are spread normally through the final month of coverage, and no accelerated adjustment is created. For more information, see the in-app help.
WSP-2743 Changes to the Group Benefit Plans Form After you select a Benefit Plan with Insurance Class of Life Insurance, then under the Age Reduction Schedule section, a new field named Dependent Spouse Age Reduction has been added that allows you to include spouse age reduction behavior and schedule. [Image: screenshot] This field has the following drop-down option: - No - Use Employee Schedule - Separate Spouse Schedule When you select the Separate Spouse Schedule option, then the system displays a conditional dependent age reduction multi-value grid where you can add Age and Percentage of Full Coverage for spouse. For more information, see the Maintaining Coverage Amounts help topic.
WSP-2762, WSP-2763 Changes to the Employee Benefits Enrollment Form On the Employee Benefits Enrollment form, a new read-only field named Coverage Basis has been added under the Coverage Details section for Spouse. [Image: screenshot] This field is conditionally displayed when: - Spouse Coverage Basis is not equal to Spouse Coverage Amount. - Dependent Spouse Age Reduction field is set to Use Employee Schedule or Separate Spouse Schedule on the Group Benefit Plans form. The new attribute in the data mapping for EMPLOYEE.BEN.DETAIL for Spouse Coverage Basis will reflect the current Spouse coverage amounts as the Spouse Coverage Basis amount for new enrollments and existing Life Insurance records at the time of release. For more information, see the Manually Enrolling an Employee in a Benefit Plan help topic.
WSP-2764, WSP-2765 Enhancements to Coverage Detail with Spouse Age Reduction While creating an Employee Benefits Enrollment Detail record for an employee configured with Life Insurance plan for Spouse Age Reduction set as Use Employee Schedule, the system considers the following: - The system displays both the Spouse Coverage Basis and the reduced Spouse Coverage Amount in the Coverage Details section of the Employee Benefit Enrollment form. - If spouse coverage amount is entered then the Spouse Coverage Basis must be set equal to Spouse Coverage Amount. - If the spouse does not meet an age threshold for the reduction schedule and a Spousal Coverage Amount is entered, the Spouse Coverage Amount is stored as the initial coverage amount. - If the spouse meets age threshold for the reduction schedule and a Spousal Coverage Amount is entered, then: - the Spouse Coverage Basis is calculated to reflect the age reduction for the spouse’s age. For example, if spouse is 65 years and reduction to 80% is applied at 65, then for an election of $100,000, the calculated Coverage Basis is $125,000. - if an amount is entered that results in the coverage basis exceeding the Spouse Life Coverage End Amount then an error message is displayed. - While using the Benefits Import tool to import new Benefit Detail Record for Voluntary Life elections, if the Spouse Coverage Amount is imported and the spouse is at or above the first reduction age, then the Coverage Basis is calculated to reflect the appropriate reduction as defined on the plan setup. - If a plan is configured with Employee DOB for Spouse Life field enabled on the Group Benefit Plans form, then the above scenarios should use employee age instead of the Spouse age. Similarly, the system considers the above scenarios while creating an Employee Benefits Enrollment Detail record for an employee configured with Life Insurance plan for Spouse Age Reduction set as Separate Spouse Schedule. For more information, see the Manually Enrolling an Employee in a Benefit Plan help topic.
WSP-2768, WSP-2772, WSP-3352 Enhancement to Payroll Program to Detect Spouse Age Reduction Threshold The payroll process has now been enhanced so that, when a spouse covered under an employee life plan crosses a configured Dependent Spouse Age Reduction threshold, the system now automatically creates a new Life Insurance benefit detail record with the correct Effective Date and reduced coverage amount, using the existing employee age-reduction logic. Please note the following: - The above enhancement applies whether spouse age is calculated from spouse Date of Birth (DOB) or, when configured, from the employee DOB, and continues to respect plans where Dependent Spouse Age Reduction is set to No under the Age Reduction Schedule section on the Group Benefit Plans form. - The Voluntary Life premium calculations is also enhanced so that when a plan is configured to Reduce Coverage and Premium and Dependent Spouse Age Reduction is enabled with either Use Employee Schedule or Separate Spouse Schedule under the Age Reduction Schedule section on the Group Benefit Plans form, then the spouse premiums are reduced in line with the spouse coverage reduction for manual enrollments. - Additional enhancements to the Voluntary Life premium calculations include that when a plan is configured with Reduce Coverage and Premium and Dependent Spouse Age Reduction is enabled with either Use Employee Schedule or Separate Spouse Schedule under the Age Reduction Schedule section on the Group Benefit Plans form, then the spouse premiums are reduced in line with the spouse coverage amount. Please note that when Reduce Coverage and Premium is not selected, then the spouse premiums remain unreduced even when a spouse age reduction schedule is configured. For more information, see the Manually Enrolling an Employee in a Benefit Plan help topic.
WSP-3338 Changes to the Employee Benefits Enrollment Form On the Employee Benefits Enrollment form, under the Coverage Details section, a new tool-tip is added to the Age and Coverage Basis fields for Spouse if you select Dependent Spouse Age Reduction as Use Employee Schedule or Separate Spouse Schedule under the Age Reduction Schedule section on the Group Benefit Plans form. [Image: screenshot] [Image: screenshot] For more information, see the Manually Enrolling an Employee in a Benefit Plan help topic.
WSP-3975 Changes to the Slavic 401K Import Form On the Slavic 401K Import form, the import process is now updated to accept Post-Tax Elections (P) in the import file. Please note the following while importing new retirement plan elections on this form: - You can now import elections for Post Tax deferral types when Post Tax elections are not prohibited by the Retirement Plan setup. - You can now import elections for standard pre-tax deferrals when Employee Catch-up Deduction Code is flagged as prohibited. Please note that no Catch-up amount for pre-tax elections are recorded. - You can now import elections for Roth deferrals when Roth Catch-up Deduction Code is flagged as prohibited. Please note that Catch-up amount for Roth elections are recorded. - However, you cannot import elections for Post Tax deferral types when Post Tax elections are prohibited by the Retirement Plan setup. For more information, see the Performing Slavic 401K Imports help topic.
WSP-4013 Changes to the Benefit Plan Setup Form On the Benefit Plan Setup form, two new read-only fields, Insurance Class and Offer Type has now been added, which displays the information associated with the selected Benefit Plan. [Image: screenshot] Please note the following: - These two new fields are only displayed when you select Plan Class as Group Benefit. - The values displayed in these fields are the same that you enter on the Group Benefit Plans form. For more information, see the Setting Up a Benefit Plan help topic.

WSP-3989 & WSP-3990 Changes to the Employee Garnishments form A new Federal Poverty Guideline field has been added to the Employee Garnishments form as you can see below. [Image: screenshot] - This field is optional. - This field is only available when configuring a State Tax Levy garnishment, allowing you to enter the Federal Poverty Guideline amount for the employee’s pay frequency. - The field accepts numeric values and rounds to two decimal places. When calculating garnishment withholdings for a State Tax Levy during payroll processing, the Federal Poverty Guideline (FPG), if present, is enforced to ensure that the garnishment is not withheld in excess of the employee’s Gross Wage - FPG amount. Note: There is a Known Issue regarding State Tax Levy wherein the subsequent Gross Pay is not always correctly adhering to the Garnishment Calculation Logic for the new Federal Poverty Guideline. This is expected to get fixed in the next 2026 June Release. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Payroll Administration and Processing User Guide.
- This field is optional.

WSP-3390 Enhanced Garnishment Capping Now Supports Daily Pay Schedules Previously, the Enhanced Garnishment Capping functionality did not handle “Daily” scheduled payroll batches. The Enhanced Garnishment Capping feature now correctly enforces weekly flat-amount garnishment caps for employees on daily pay schedules. The system now determines the workweek based on the Work Week Ends On setting (Pay Group takes priority; Client Details is used as a fallback) and cumulatively tracks garnishment deductions across all daily payroll runs within that workweek. Supported garnishment types include a flat amount Creditor Wage Garnishment, Child Support, Spousal Support or a State Tax Levy. If no Work Week Ends On value is configured, garnishment deductions will not be taken for daily-scheduled employees. This applies to both Legacy and Restartable payroll, and works across regular, manual, and special batches processed in any order within the same workweek. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR System Administration User Guide.

CMP-6863 Texas Employer Quarterly SUTA Tax Export supports ICESA The Employer Quarterly SUTA Tax Export (ICESA format) for the state of Texas has been updated to align with the new file specifications published by the Texas Workforce Commission (TWC) in preparation for the Texas Unemployment System (TxUS) launch on June 1, 2026. For full details on the new TxUS file specifications, refer to the TWC TxUS announcement. You fill find this option for the State Texas for File Format TEXAS [SUTA] on the Employer Quarterly SUTA Tax Export form. - The ICESA (Interstate Conference of Employment Security Agencies) export file layout has been restructured to match the updated TWC specifications, including revised field positions across multiple record types. - A Tax Contact Email address field has been added to the export, sourced from Employer / Change / Employer Details. - Employer Excess Wages (taxable overlimit wages) are now included in the file. - Record B has been removed from the file, as per the updated TWC requirements. - The CSV format option remains available for backwards compatibility. ### Details of the updates - Record A - Positions 2 - 5 filled w/ spaces - Positions 15 - 23 filled w/ spaces - Positions 208 - 247 Tax Contact email address, Left justified: use Employer / Change / Employer Details, Tax Contact Email - Positions 248 - 275 filled with spaces - Record B - removed - Record E - Moved Zip to positions 149 - 153 (currently starts in 154) - Moved ZiP ext to positions 154 -158 - Positions 159 - 166 filled w/ spaces - Positions 191 - 275 filled w/ spaces (current CR is at 209) - Record S - Positions 78 - 146 filled w/ spaces - Positions 162 - 211 filled w/ spaces - Record T - Positions 9 - 26 filled w/ spaces - Positions 41 - 54 ER Excess Wages (taxable overlimit wages) - Positions 69 -81 filled w / spaces - Positions 82 - 87 last month of the QTR and the Year - Positions 248 - 275 filled w/ spaces - Record F - Positions 13 - 40 filled w/ spaces - Positions 56 - 275 filled w/ spaces For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Employer Administration User Guide.

CMP-7797 Employer PFML Pickup Contribution Calculation The IRS released further guidance on the requirements of Revenue Ruling 2025-04. This ruling requires that when an employer voluntarily pays part of the employee’s required PFML contribution, this amount is treated as additional compensation to the employee. This requires that the excess contribution amounts are included in the employee’s gross income and wages for federal employment tax purposes. During our 2026 April release, we introduced the following two new fields without any functionality at that time: - On the System Parameters form, in the Global Codes Setup section, under the Benefits group, a new field named PFML ER Pickup Fringe Pay Code was added. - On the State Tax Rates (SUTA) form, in the Rate Breakdown section, a new field named PFML Employer Pickup was added. With this 2026 May release, PrismHR released new functionality to calculate the employer contribution amounts retroactively to 1/1/26. During payroll calculation, PrismHR uses your configured PFML Employer Pickup percentage for the state as defined on the State Tax Rates (SUTA) form and PFML ER Pickup Fringe Pay Code as defined on the System Parameters form to calculate the employer paid PFML amount and automatically posts it as a taxable non-cash fringe income to the employee’s payroll voucher under Other Payments, provided both values are valid. If either value is missing or invalid, no taxable fringe income is posted. The employer paid employee PFML amount is calculated as: (YTD net taxable) multiplied by (PFML ER Pick up Rate) minus (YTD PFML Fringe Pay) > Note: Note: The calculation does not include the PFML wages on the current voucher. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Billing User Guide.
- On the System Parameters form, in the Global Codes Setup section, under the Benefits group, a new field named PFML ER Pickup Fringe Pay Code was added.
- On the State Tax Rates (SUTA) form, in the Rate Breakdown section, a new field named PFML Employer Pickup was added.

CMP-7828 MasterTax v49 now supports NM Workers’ Compensation From April, 2026, the state of New Mexico introduced a separate reporting requirement for Workers’ Compensation Fee (NM0000-132). MasterTax v49 RTS 601 record now supports this as follows: - New Mexico Workers’ Compensation tax amounts from tax codes 32-23 and 32-26 are included in NM0000-132 and reported in the MasterTax v49 RTS 601 record in positions 100 - 113. - The existing MasterTax v49 RTS 601 record for New Mexico SUTA (tax code 32-24) reporting is not modified and continues to produce the same output as before this change. This update ensures MasterTax v49 compliance with the new state requirement by reporting New Mexico Workers’ Compensation tax amounts on its own dedicated record, distinct from New Mexico SUTA. For more information, see the in-product help or PrismHR Employer Administration User Guide.
- New Mexico Workers’ Compensation tax amounts from tax codes 32-23 and 32-26 are included in NM0000-132 and reported in the MasterTax v49 RTS 601 record in positions 100 - 113.

EP-10051 Multifactor Authentication for Direct Deposit Service providers utilizing PrismONE ID can now enable multifactor authentication for the Direct Deposit form in Portal. This option can be selected on the Configuration Template form or the Client Override form when the Direct Deposit component is added to Portal. When an employee accesses the Direct Deposit form in Portal, the system prompts the employee for an Authenticator app code. Once the correct code is submitted, the employee is then navigated to the Direct Deposit form. Using this option, service providers can add an additional layer of security to the payment forms of their configuration templates and client overrides. These include the Registration, Sign In, Forgot Password, and My Settings forms, and include the following changes: - The show/hide feature for passwords now displays as an icon. - Required fields are now marked with an asterisk. - Buttons have been restyled to match the UEX standard. Onboarding (OB) Enhancements

Ticket Description Summary Help Content
OBE-9880 Disabled Notifications for Submitted Workflows Time Based Notifications now exclude employees who have submitted their workflows for Onboarding and Benefits Enrollment from receiving further reminder notifications. This update helps prevent confusion from employees sending in their workflows and still receiving reminders. This change affects current workflows on the Notification Templates form where the Trigger Type field is set to Time Based. Service Providers can set a template to retain the previous behavior of sending out reminders to all employees on the template by selecting the X Days before due date (include submitted) option in the Trigger Condition field for a template. By selecting this option, this template will continue sending reminder notifications to all employees at the specified number of days before the due date. For more information, refer to Notification Templates.
OBE-10352 Send Same-Day Notifications from Client Workflow Grid Service Providers can now send notifications directly from the Client Workflow Grid for open enrollment workflows matching certain criteria. A letter icon displays next to the line item to send the same-day notification when the following criteria are met: - The line item has an effective date. - An open enrollment workflow is present. - The OBE Start Date is set to today’s date or changed to today’s date. Click the letter icon to display a confirmation window, where the user can select to send notifications for the open enrollment workflow. Using this system, service providers can send notifications directly from the Client Workflow Grid without restarting the notification system or accessing any other forms. For more information, refer to Client Workflow Grid.

WSP-3433 Previously, on the Slavic 401K Import form, when you performed the Slavic 401k Import process, the system incorrectly removed existing Post-Tax (non-Roth) elections when the Carry Forward Existing Amounts if NOT in the Import? field was enabled. Now, this is fixed.

Now, this is fixed. The Cafeteria Plan Contribution form on the Employee Benefits Enrollment screen now consistently requires a valid Employee ID before it can be accessed. Jira # Issue Summary Resolution
CMP-7076 Previously, for both SBEA and non-SBEA clients, for employees in Guam, the system did not correctly report their federal income tax withholding for tax code 66-10 on the MasterTax RTS 601 record, if any for the quarter. Now, this is resolved.
CMP-7799 Previously, for employees who live and work in Martins Ferry, Ohio, and another location, and when Martins Ferry OH was entered as the second work location in the timesheet (with another state as the first location), the system did not calculate or withhold the Martins Ferry local tax. CMP-7849 Previously, in some cases, the Periodic JSON file was including payroll records that were included in a processed PTS which is incorrect resulting in over-reporting and wage discrepancies. Now, this is resolved.
CMP-7860 Previously, when an Employer PHR Tax ID override existed, the setup file both with and without tax journal records were ignoring the override. Now, when an Employer PHR Tax ID override exists, the setup file both with and without tax journal records correctly uses the following logic: - The PrismHR Tax Identifier Number is replaced with the Employer PHR Tax ID override. - The Override Employer Suffix Code is appended to the end since there is an override. - The override client ID reflects the Employer Override ID, Employer ID and the Override Employer Suffix Code. - The interface setting includes the PHR Tax ID based on configuration. When disabled, the Override ID only reports the Employer ID & Override Employer Suffix Code. When a new employer has no payroll data, the JSON setup creates a shell with the information available for that employer excluding the agency information.

EERT-3776 When a user opened their California W4 form, the employee’s tax ID did not prefill properly onto the form. This is fixed.
EERT-3782 When a user viewed the Benefits Enrollment Detail form for an employee, the employee’s beneficiaries did not display properly on the form. This is fixed.
EERT-3807 During Benefit Enrollment, the system displayed the Per Period Cost incorrectly for the minimum Coverage Amount for life plans when using a salary multiplier. This is fixed.
EERT-3816 Life Events time notifications were not generating consistently. This is fixed.
OBE-10335 When a disabled Decision Support tool was set to Enabled for a client, the DEC form did not display when an employee accessed their benefits workflow. This is fixed.
OBE-10393 Automatic Open Enrollment did not launch properly for clients. Clients could fix the problem manually by restarting the Notification Control Panel by resetting the OE Notify date, stopping the process, saving, and starting the process again. This is fixed. The Automatic Open Enrollment now launch properly without the clients having to manually reset the process.
OBE-10402 When the same-day feature was enabled for Notifications in Onboarding and Benefits Enrollment, noneligible employees erroneously received notifications. This is fixed.

Prism (PD) Fixes

Jira # Category Issue Summary Resolution
PD-20353 General The system incorrectly displayed “Paid” on the Planned Time Off form for the current voucher for leave requests that were approved after payroll calculation, even though those hours were not present on the voucher or the Employee Time Off Register form. The following now occurs: - Only leave requests included in the payroll/voucher are marked as “Paid” on the Planned Time Off form. - Leave requests approved after payroll calculation remain in “Approved” status. - The Employee Time Off Register only reflects time off that was actually paid.
- Only leave requests included in the payroll/voucher are marked as “Paid” on the Planned Time Off form.
- Leave requests approved after payroll calculation remain in “Approved” status.
- The Employee Time Off Register only reflects time off that was actually paid.
PP-2566 General When a user changed the size of the Enhanced Dashboard, the dashboard reloaded. This is fixed.
PP-2574 General When a user selected the View All Employees option on the Enhanced Dashboard, the columns would no longer sort when selected. This is fixed.
RRT-6935 General When the system routed an HR-action approval (such as a Leave Request, Pay Rate Change, or Termination) to an assigned approver (Manager/PTO Approver) and that approver is later teminated and the pending approval was not reassigned, the approval became “orphaned.” (A nightly batch auto-processed it and, on failure, emailed a notification to an arbitrary, cross-client user who had no access to that employee.) The system no longer sends orphaned-approval “failure/resubmit” emails and now processes orphaned approvals.
WSP-3987 General When users ran the Clone Client process with the Retirement Plan Setup field disabled, the system created retirement plans for the new client on the Benefits tab in the Client Details form without setting up the Retirement Plans on the Benefit Plan Setup form. This is fixed.
PD-20083 Payroll In the Workers’ Compensation -Wage Detail Report, the system reported Expense Reimbursement Pay Class payments as Exempt Wages for every WC Code, regardless of under which position it was paid. Pay Codes that are not subject to workers compensation are only reported under Exempt Wages for the WC Code of the position under which it was paid.
PD-20400 Payroll The system did not enable the Suppress Allocation field correctly when users imported a batch payment file on the Batch Payments form. For example, if users set the Suppress Allocation field to Yes, the system set this field to No after processing the import. This is fixed.
PD-20544 Payroll An error message displayed when users selected an employee in the Employee ID field on the Time Sheet Entry form and then clicked the down arrow intermittently, “This is the last employee on the list,” even though additional employees were still available in the payroll. Users can now navigate successfully through the employees list without triggering the incorrect “last employee” error message.
PD-23669 Payroll When a manager approved PTO for multiple employees and processed a payroll to pay only a group of those employees, all employees with approved PTO would display their PTO as paid on the Planned Time Off Requests form. This is fixed.
PD-23717 Payroll When a salaried employee entered leave hours (for example, Time Off or Holiday), the system did not reduce their regular (REG) hours accordingly in the timesheet on the Time Sheet Entry form. Instead, the reduction calculation was performed incorrectly, especially when multiple pay codes with different rate classes (“Straight” versus “Other”) were involved. This is fixed.
PD-23767 Payroll When a client suppressed the Client Approval for a reverse wire client in the SuperBatch form, the system did not update the wire file during ACH processing. This is fixed.
PP-1783 Payroll When a user sorted the Timesheet Report by the Pay Code field, the Grand Totals field would sometimes not display. This is fixed.
PP-2544 Payroll When a user created a new Service Provider user record and added Payroll Representative in the Account Management Roles section, the Suppress Payroll Warnings section displayed under the User Roles section instead of under the Account Management Roles section. This is fixed.
PP-2568 Payroll When a user cleared selections on the Pay Period Accrual Thresholds section of the Time Off Plans form, selected a Pay Period again, and entered an accrual threshold, the Pay Period field would revert back to the default Select state. This is fixed.
RRT-6846 Payroll When an employee had multiple loans being deducted in one payroll and the employee had Supplemental Pay in that payroll, the system made a deduction for a loan that was fully paid on the Regular voucher in the same payroll, which caused an over-deduction for the loan total. This is fixed.
WSP-3927 Payroll Users were able to add a code to multiple columns in the Client Allocation Formats form. An error message now displays when users try to add a code to multiple columns, “Allocation Code cannot be used more than once in the report columns.”
WSP-4336 Payroll The system did not post the deduction import amounts in the Time Sheet Deduction Import form for all employees in the import. In addition, the payroll vouchers posted these values as a lesser amount, with the decimal point over-adjusted two places to the left. This is fixed.
PP-2522 System On the Time Off Auto-Enrollment Rules Import form, the section border at the top of the form displayed incorrectly. This is fixed.
PP-2543 System When a user created a user record on the PrismONE Users form and selected a User Type, an erroneous entry “HRP OB/BE Administrator” displayed as a User Type option. This is fixed.
PP-2547 System When the record for a PrismONE ID user was completed and saved, the system would still display PrismONE ID selections on the blank Users form. This is fixed.
PP-2548 System When a user created a new DUC user record and filled out fields on the PrismONE Users form, resizing the browser window changed the Registration Status to Pending. This is fixed.
PP-2549 System When a DUC user resized the screen on the PrismONE Users form, the User ID field, Employee fields, and Current Access section disappeared, and the User Type menu displayed. This is fixed.
PP-2550 System When a DUC user accessed the Password and Recovery form and clicked No on the Save message, the Password and Recovery section disappeared. This is fixed.
PP-2551 System When a DUC user attempted to select fields on the Users form with the tab key, the fields were not selected in sequential order. This is fixed.
PP-2553 System When a user opened the browser dev tools while viewing the Users form, several fields on the Users form disappeared. This is fixed.
PP-2582 System In the File Audit, the After Value field in a Discount/Debit Amount did not display a decimal point. This is fixed.
PP-2592 System When a user received a PrismONE registration code, the expiration time for the code was set to four hours instead of the time set in the system configuration settings. This is fixed.
PP-2598 System When an administrator viewed an existing, non-PrismONE User ID on the PrismONE Users form and entered an email address to initiate the PrismONE ID registration process, the Save button was not enabled properly. This is fixed.

May (R_202605)

Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Content/Release-Notes/2026/05/whatsnew-R_202605.htm Path: Release-Notes/2026/05/whatsnew-R_202605.htm

Welcome

PrismHR software is specifically designed to help Professional Employer Organizations (PEOs) and Administrative Services Organizations (ASOs) reduce risk, be more efficient, expand business, and be more profitable.

When you choose PrismHR, you are choosing more than just a software platform. You are partnering with a team of professionals who are deeply invested in the PEO and ASO industry and dedicated to providing the best technology and services possible. You are also partnering with other professionals in the industry in the sense that we all learn from each other.

To view release notes for PrismHR, click any of the links in the Table of Contents. Each release is represented with a book that features the month and year. Click these books to expand product names and version numbers for the release. The most recent documents are at the top of the list. Use the Search feature to look for a specific keyword or phrase. Open any PDFs for Download book to view and print release notes documents from the past year.

New Features

We would like to bring your attention to the following list of new features for PrismHR.

List of New Features

Click a link to display the detailed release notes for the new feature

  • Payroll Audit Report: You can use the Payroll Audit Report to review a payroll before it is finalized and posted. After payroll has been initialized/calculated, the report compares the current payroll against the prior payroll and displays changes, outliers, and potential issues that warrant review. The Payroll Audit Report helps reduce the time spent on manual payroll review and also helps payroll processors quickly identify what may have changed since the last pay period. (See Payroll Audit Report.) Important! The output recorded in the Payroll Audit Report is generated using artificial intelligence (AI), so ensure you review all output for accuracy, completeness, and appropriateness before using it.
  • Time Sheet Deduction Import form: You can use the Time Sheet Deduction Import form to import timesheet deductions for a payroll. (See Importing Timesheet Deductions.)
  • User Defined Fields Import form: You can use the User Defined Fields Import form to enter global and user-defined fields that are related to specific forms/files. (See Importing User-Defined Fields.)

Release Notes: Enhancements and Fixes

You can view release notes in a variety of formats. You can:

  • View the detailed release notes. See: Release Notes
  • Download a PDF containing the detailed release notes. See Release Notes PDF
  • Download an Excel spreadsheet containing the detailed release notes. See: Release Notes Excel Note: The Excel export of release note does not include images. View the Detailed release notes in HTML format to see images.
